summary: Spatial understanding is a necessary step in moving multimodal large language models (MLLMs) toward reasoning about the 3D physical world. Their visual pretraining data, however, is almost entirely 2D, so the visual tokens processed by MLLMs often lack inherent 3D structural information. A growing number of methods inject such structure by transferring representations from external vision or geometry models, and collectively establish that such transfer helps. Behind these methods lies a largely underexplored question: what makes a visual representation good for spatial understanding? To answer it, we first separate what is transferred from how it is transferred, and then trace the resulting differences back to properties of the representations themselves. What we transfer comes from 3D geometry models, self-supervised image and video models, vision-language models, and generative models, in the form of latent features or explicit depth and point maps. We transfer it either by distillation, using it as a supervision target, or by fusion, feeding it as an additional input. We find that a representation's 3D structure correlates strongly with how much it helps, measured by cross-view consistency for latent features and by depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. We further show that the form of a representation dictates the mechanism it needs. Latent features gain as much from fusion as from distillation; explicit geometry gains little from fusion, and most of its distillation gain depends on a geometry decoding head. Guided by these findings, we distill both latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. Taking only RGB video as input, it consistently improves over its base model on both static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks.

AI.title_zh: 什么使视觉表征适合于多模态大语言模型中的空间理解？
AI.abstract_zh: 空间理解是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）迈向对3D物理世界进行推理的必要一步。然而，它们的视觉预训练数据几乎完全是2D的，因此MLLMs所处理的视觉token往往缺乏内在的3D结构信息。越来越多的方法通过从外部视觉或几何模型迁移表征来注入此类结构，并共同确立了这种迁移是有帮助的。在这些方法背后，存在一个在很大程度上尚未被充分探索的问题：什么使视觉表征适合于空间理解？为回答这一问题，我们首先将“迁移什么”与“如何迁移”区分开，然后将由此产生的差异追溯至表征本身的属性。我们所迁移的内容来自3D几何模型、自监督图像与视频模型、视觉-语言模型以及生成模型，其形式为潜在特征或显式的深度图与点图。我们通过蒸馏、将其用作监督目标，或通过融合、将其作为额外输入来迁移它。我们发现，表征的3D结构与它所带来的帮助程度高度相关，对于潜在特征以跨视角一致性衡量，对于显式几何以深度与重建精度衡量。我们进一步表明，表征的形式决定了它所需的机制。潜在特征从融合中获得的增益与从蒸馏中获得的增益相当；显式几何从融合中获得的增益很小，且其蒸馏增益的大部分依赖于一个几何解码头。在这些发现的指导下，我们将潜在特征与显式几何同时蒸馏进一个单一的MLLM中。仅以RGB视频作为输入，它在静态3D与动态4D空间推理基准上均持续优于其基座模型。

title: A Differentiable 3D Scene Graph Metric via Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry
summary: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly supervised with local object and predicate classification losses. Although effective for slot-wise label prediction, this formulation does not provide a graph-level semantic distance between a predicted scene graph and its ground truth: semantically mild label errors and structurally disruptive relational errors can be treated similarly, and subject-predicate-object facts are not compared as scene-level units. We propose Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry, a graph-level supervision objective that measures the semantic and structural discrepancy between 3D scene graphs. Our key idea is to reinterpret the conventional classifier outputs of a 3D scene graph predictor as an aligned probabilistic scene graph field, where object and predicate predictions jointly define contextual subject-predicate-object facts. This formulation yields a differentiable metric-based training objective with an efficient factorized implementation and can be applied to existing 3D scene graph prediction architectures without modifying their network design. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate that our supervision improves downstream graph-conditioned 3D scene generation, while ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of the proposed graph-level terms and user studies show better graph descriptiveness, relation plausibility, and structural preservation.

AI.title_zh: 通过上下文Hellinger三元组几何实现的可微3D场景图度量
AI.abstract_zh: 3D场景图预测通常以局部物体与谓词分类损失进行监督。尽管这种形式对于逐槽位（slot-wise）的标签预测是有效的，但它并不提供预测场景图与其真实标注之间的图级语义距离：语义上轻微的标签错误与结构上破坏性的关系错误可能被同等对待，并且主语-谓词-宾语事实并未作为场景级单元进行比较。我们提出上下文Hellinger三元组几何（Contextual Hellinger Triplet Geometry），一种图级监督目标，用于度量3D场景图之间的语义与结构差异。我们的核心思想是将3D场景图预测器的常规分类器输出重新解释为一个对齐的概率场景图场，其中物体与谓词预测共同定义具有上下文的主语-谓词-宾语事实。该形式产生了一个可微的、基于度量的训练目标，具有高效的因子化实现，并且可应用于现有的3D场景图预测架构而无需修改其网络设计。在3DSSG上的实验表明，我们的监督改进了下游的以图为条件的3D场景生成，同时消融研究证实了所提出的图级项之间的互补作用，用户研究则显示出更好的图描述性、关系合理性和结构保持性。

title: SWORD: Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance for 3D Scene Graph Prediction
summary: 3D scene graph prediction is commonly optimized with object-node and relation-edge classification losses. These objectives encourage exact object and relation label recovery, but they do not directly optimize semantic proximity to the ground-truth scene graph: two wrong graphs can receive comparable penalties even when one is much closer in object roles and relation contexts. A direct graph-distance loss is difficult in general, since graph matching and graph edit distance require correspondence search and edit-cost design. Our key observation is that prior supervised 3D scene graph prediction protocols are conducted on fixed object-node indices and supervised edge slots. This can turn a scene graph comparison into a well-defined aligned graph-distance problem. To this end, we propose SWORD, a Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance that builds block-normalized object and relation ground distance metrics from training scene graph annotations through a deterministic base-to-context order, without external semantic priors. SWORD lifts these metrics to Wasserstein distances over aligned node and null-augmented edge marginals, providing semantic graph-distance supervision beyond exact-label penalties while preserving the ground-truth graph as the unique zero-distance solution in aligned marginal probability space. We prove that SWORD is a strict metric on aligned marginal probabilistic scene graphs, preserves scene-graph-grounded substitution ordering, controls additive graph-grounded semantic observables, and yields a surrogate upper-bounding decoded semantic error.

AI.title_zh: SWORD：用于3D场景图预测的基于场景的Wasserstein物体—关系距离
AI.abstract_zh: 3D场景图预测通常以物体节点和关系边的分类损失进行优化。这些目标鼓励精确恢复物体和关系标签，但它们并不直接优化与真值场景图的语义接近程度：两个错误的图可能获得相近的惩罚，即使其中一个在物体角色和关系上下文上要接近得多。直接的图距离损失一般而言难以实现，因为图匹配与图编辑距离需要对应关系搜索和编辑代价设计。我们的关键观察是：此前的有监督3D场景图预测流程是在固定的物体节点索引和有监督的边槽位上进行的。这可以将场景图比较转化为一个定义良好的对齐图距离问题。为此，我们提出SWORD，一种基于场景的Wasserstein物体—关系距离，它通过确定性的从基元到上下文的顺序，从训练场景图标注中构建块归一化的物体与关系真值距离度量，而不依赖外部语义先验。SWORD将这些度量提升为对齐节点边缘分布与经空值增广的边边缘分布上的Wasserstein距离，从而在对齐边缘概率空间中保留真值图作为唯一的零距离解的同时，提供超越精确标签惩罚的语义图距离监督。我们证明SWORD在对齐边缘概率场景图上是一个严格度量，保持了以场景图为依据的替换序关系，控制加性的以图为依据的语义可观测量，并给出一个作为解码语义误差上界的替代量。

title: OccWAM: Occupancy World-Action Models with Joint Scene-to-Ego Flow Matching
summary: Occupancy world models provide a structured, metric representation of future driving scenes, making them a promising basis for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing occupancy-aware planners typically couple occupancy prediction and action generation through either hierarchical coupling or parallel multi-task learning. Hierarchical methods use occupancy either as a fully predicted future preceding action generation or as an action-conditioned rollout for trajectory evaluation, whereas parallel multi-task methods predict occupancy alongside planning through a separate branch or auxiliary objective. These interfaces retain either an explicit generation order or a role asymmetry, limiting reciprocal interaction between world prediction and action generation during trajectory formation. We propose OccWAM, an occupancy-native world-action model that jointly generates dense future occupancy and continuous ego trajectories via flow matching conditioned on scene representations. Building on this joint formulation, we introduce scene-to-ego world-action flow matching, a two-stage formulation. The first stage predicts scene-centric occupancy together with an absolute ego trajectory, providing a stable representation of future scene evolution. The same predicted world is then re-indexed into the future ego frames induced by the initial trajectory, where ego motion is represented through adjacent pose increments and a second joint flow refines ego-centric occupancy and motion for action-aligned planning. Unlike video-based world-action models, OccWAM preserves explicit semantic geometry for direct planning reasoning without pixel synthesis. Extensive experiments on Bench2Drive and nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in closed-loop driving, open-loop planning, and future occupancy prediction.

AI.title_zh: OccWAM：具有联合场景到自车流匹配的占用世界-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 占用世界模型为未来驾驶场景提供了结构化、度量化的表示，使其成为端到端自动驾驶的一个有前景的基础。然而，现有的占用感知规划器通常通过分层耦合或并行多任务学习将占用预测与动作生成耦合起来。分层方法要么将占用作为先于动作生成的完整预测未来，要么将其作为动作条件化的推演用于轨迹评估；而并行多任务方法则通过单独的分支或辅助目标在规划的同时预测占用。这些接口要么保留了显式的生成顺序，要么保留了角色不对称性，从而限制了世界预测与动作生成在轨迹形成过程中的相互交互。我们提出OccWAM，一种以占用为本的世界-动作模型，它以场景表示为条件，通过流匹配联合生成密集的未来占用和连续的自车轨迹。在这一联合表述的基础上，我们引入场景到自车世界-动作流匹配，这是一种两阶段表述。第一阶段预测以场景为中心的占用以及绝对自车轨迹，为未来场景演化提供稳定的表示。随后，同一个预测出的世界被重新索引到由初始轨迹诱导出的未来自车坐标系中，在此自车运动通过相邻位姿增量来表示，第二个联合流进一步细化以自车为中心的占用与运动，以实现与动作对齐的规划。与基于视频的世界-动作模型不同，OccWAM保留了显式的语义几何，用于直接进行规划推理，而无需像素合成。在Bench2Drive和nuScenes上的大量实验表明，其在闭环驾驶、开环规划和未来占用预测方面均取得了最先进的性能。

title: Hierarchical Curriculum Learning for Surgical Video Generation: Focusing on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach Robotic Thyroidectomy Datasets
summary: High-fidelity surgical video generation is increasingly important for surgical education, simulation, and downstream AI training, as conventional simulation pipelines are limited by cost, realism, and scenario diversity. Adapting generic text-to-video diffusion models to surgical procedures remains difficult, however, due to complex anatomical structures, intricate tool-tissue interactions, the inherently hierarchical nature of surgical workflows, and the scarcity of curated training data outside a few well-studied procedures. We propose a surgical video generation framework that combines hierarchical procedural annotation with curriculum transfer learning. Surgical procedures are decomposed into three levels (phase, task, and action) and a pretrained text-to-video diffusion model is progressively adapted from coarse to fine-grained surgical context, supported by a dynamic sampling strategy that handles variable-resolution and variable-length surgical clips. We instantiate the framework on Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach robotic thyroidectomy, a procedure for which no curated benchmark currently exists. Relative to the preceding task-level model, the final action-level model reduces FVD by 20.1% and FID by 15.7%, and a matched-budget ablation indicates that these gains arise from the curriculum design rather than from additional training. A user study with six clinicians rates visual realism highly while highlighting remaining gaps in anatomical accuracy and clinical reliability. The proposed framework offers a step toward AI-driven surgical simulation in procedures where curated data are scarce.

AI.title_zh: 面向手术视频生成的层次化课程学习：聚焦双侧腋乳入路机器人甲状腺切除术数据集
AI.abstract_zh: 高保真手术视频生成对于外科教育、仿真以及下游 AI 训练日益重要，因为传统的仿真流程受限于成本、真实感和场景多样性。然而，由于解剖结构复杂、器械与组织的交互错综复杂、手术工作流本身具有层次性，以及在少数被充分研究的手术之外缺乏经过整理（curated）的训练数据，将通用的文本到视频扩散模型适配到手术操作仍然困难。我们提出了一种手术视频生成框架，将层次化手术过程标注与课程迁移学习相结合。手术操作被分解为三个层级（阶段 phase、任务 task 和动作 action），预训练的文本到视频扩散模型从粗粒度到细粒度手术上下文逐步适配，并由一种动态采样策略支撑，以处理可变分辨率和可变长度的手术视频片段。我们在双侧腋乳入路（Bilateral Axillo-Breast Approach）机器人甲状腺切除术上实例化了该框架，目前尚不存在针对该手术的经过整理的基准。相对于前一阶段的任务级（task-level）模型，最终的动作级（action-level）模型将 FVD 降低了 20.1%，将 FID 降低了 15.7%，并且一项匹配预算的消融实验表明，这些提升源于课程设计而非额外的训练。一项有六位临床医生参与的用户研究对视觉真实感给出了高评价，同时指出了在解剖准确性和临床可靠性方面仍存在的差距。所提出的框架为在整理数据稀缺的手术中迈向 AI 驱动的手术仿真提供了第一步。

title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
summary: Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.

AI.title_zh: RoTA-Bench：通过交互式投影对齐评估三维空间推理
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型能否将二维观测转化为支持精确动作的三维理解？这需要推断物体几何形状、预判旋转的效果，并通过视觉反馈改进动作。我们提出 RoTA-Bench，通过交互式三维到二维投影对齐来评估这些能力。给定一个目标轮廓，模型观察一个经过旋转的物体，并在有限的动作预算内选择一系列相继的旋转，以恢复目标投影。我们的自动化流水线从二维图标构建保持轮廓的三维物体，并使用可逆初始化来保证任务可解，由此产生 674 个任务以及一个分层抽样的 100 任务测试集。在实证上，我们发现：(i) 人类与模型之间仍存在显著差距：GPT-5.6-Sol 仅在 17% 的任务上成功，而 20 名本科生参与者共同将测试集完整完成四次，成功率为 100%；(ii) 图像空间与姿态空间的进展可能发生背离：在匹配状态下，模型比人类更常出现轮廓重叠度提升而姿态对齐变差的情况（19.4% 对 10.9%）；以及 (iii) 细粒度控制对交互历史敏感：移除交互历史后，模型 96.8% 的动作停留在粗糙的 30 度步长上，并显著降低所观察到的任务成功率。这些发现凸显了将视觉证据转化为精确三维控制的挑战，其难度超越了对单张图像的识别或匹配。

title: MemAct: Streaming Spatial Understanding with Memory and Active Exploration
summary: Spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents navigating and interacting with the physical world. As observations arrive incrementally, agents must reason in a streaming manner. Yet streaming understanding must also be closed-loop: task-relevant evidence may require both recalling past observations and actively acquiring new views. Existing streaming approaches largely emphasize processing incoming observations, leaving task-driven active exploration underexplored. We introduce MemAct, a framework for streaming spatial understanding with memory and action. A shared vision--language model incrementally writes structured historical memory, retrieves records and past frames on demand, and acquires additional evidence through movement and turning. Retrieved evidence and action observations inform subsequent decisions, enabling the agent to continue exploring or answer within a unified reasoning loop. We develop the MemAct suite, a data generation pipeline and collection across real and simulated environments, with approximately 1M training examples for spatial reasoning, memory writing, retrieval, and exploration. Its MemAct-bench comprises 20,000 main QA pairs evaluating current-observation understanding, historical evidence use, and active exploration, plus 2,000 separate Timing questions. MemAct combines supervised fine-tuning for memory and interaction with counterfactual action optimization using cumulative evidence gains, action costs, and terminal answer quality to improve exploration and stopping decisions. Experiments show that MemAct outperforms existing spatial understanding and streaming baselines and approaches frontier multimodal models on MemAct-bench while retaining streaming inference efficiency.

AI.title_zh: MemAct：基于记忆与主动探索的流式空间理解
AI.abstract_zh: 空间理解对于具身智能体在物理世界中导航与交互至关重要。随着观测逐步到达，智能体必须以流式方式进行推理。然而，流式理解也必须是闭环的：与任务相关的证据可能既需要回忆过去的观测，也需要主动获取新的视角。现有的流式方法在很大程度上侧重于处理不断到来的观测，而对任务驱动的主动探索探讨不足。我们提出 MemAct，一个基于记忆与动作的流式空间理解框架。一个共享的视觉-语言模型增量地写入结构化历史记忆，按需检索记录与过去帧，并通过移动与转向获取额外证据。检索到的证据与动作观测为后续决策提供信息，使智能体能够在统一的推理循环中继续探索或作答。我们构建了 MemAct 套件，这是一套跨真实与模拟环境的数据生成流程与数据集，包含约 100 万个用于空间推理、记忆写入、检索与探索的训练样本。其 MemAct-bench 包含 20,000 个主问答对，用于评估当前观测理解、历史证据使用与主动探索，另有 2,000 个单独的 Timing 问题。MemAct 将用于记忆与交互的监督微调与反事实动作优化相结合，后者使用累积证据增益、动作成本与最终答案质量，以改进探索与停止决策。实验表明，MemAct 在 MemAct-bench 上优于现有的空间理解与流式基线，并接近前沿多模态模型，同时保持流式推理效率。

title: Acting Through Registers
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) use generative visual representations to condition robot actions, yet how these representations organize action-relevant information remains poorly understood. We identify persistent high-norm spatial outliers in WAM representations and find that their action relevance persists even after normalization and K/V projection attenuate their extreme magnitude. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RegisterWAM, which adds learnable non-spatial registers to the world model and uses them directly for action conditioning. Registers alone do not fully eliminate spatial outliers; pairing them with observation flow-matching (FM) loss supervision suppresses spatial outliers while concentrating high-norm responses in registers. Beyond this reorganization, observation FM loss supervision also improves action learning without registers, motivating an additional noised-observation FM objective that learns current-scene recovery from corrupted inputs. The resulting model achieves 81.64\% success on LIBERO-Plus without additional embodied pretraining data or foundation models, reaches 93.0\% average success on RoboTwin 2.0, and improves real-world manipulation performance.

AI.title_zh: 通过寄存器执行动作
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models, WAMs）使用生成式视觉表示来为机器人动作提供条件，然而这些表示如何组织与动作相关的信息仍鲜有理解。我们在 WAM 表示中发现了持续存在的高范数空间离群值，并发现即使在归一化和 K/V 投影削弱了它们的极端幅值之后，其与动作的相关性依然存在。受此观察启发，我们提出了 RegisterWAM，它向世界模型中加入可学习的非空间寄存器，并直接将其用于动作条件化。仅靠寄存器并不能完全消除空间离群值；将其与观测流匹配（flow-matching, FM）损失监督相结合，可抑制空间离群值，同时将高范数响应集中于寄存器之中。除这种重组织之外，观测 FM 损失监督还能在没有寄存器的情况下改进动作学习，这促使我们提出一个额外的加噪观测 FM 目标，用于从受损输入中学习当前场景的恢复。所得模型在没有额外具身预训练数据或基础模型的情况下，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 81.64\% 的成功率，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 93.0\% 的平均成功率，并提升了真实世界操作性能。

title: From Pixels to Executable Physics: Behavior-Grounded World Models for Embodied Action Consequence Prediction
summary: In outdoor environments, varying terrain and contact conditions can cause identical action commands to produce different motion outcomes for quadruped robots. Predicting these outcomes is essential for reliable navigation and informed path selection. Existing video world models can generate visually plausible futures, yet often struggle to capture robot dynamics and terrain interactions, leading to overly optimistic predictions of action outcomes. We present DR-WM, a physically consistent world model that incorporates robot-terrain contact dynamics to predict the consequences of quadruped actions. Starting from an initial RGB image, our method reconstructs scene geometry and integrates dense, dimensionless priors over terrain contact properties, calibrated using real-world action-response data. The resulting terrain model supports the simulation of physics with spatially varying contact properties such as friction. Given the initial state of the robot and candidate action sequences, we simulate its future motion and use the resulting camera trajectories and rendered geometry to guide the training of a video world model. The generated future observations are then used to update the terrain reconstruction, enabling iterative model rollouts without additional real-world images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DR-WM substantially outperforms geometry-only baselines and baselines with uniform physical parameters on key physical metrics characterizing action outcomes, while achieving the best performance among the evaluated baselines. These physically grounded predictions support more informed action selection: across 90 challenging scenarios, an 8B vision-language model augmented with DR-WM outperforms an unassisted 32B vision-language model on five of six evaluation metrics.

AI.title_zh: 从像素到可执行物理：面向具身动作后果预测的行为锚定世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 在户外环境中，变化的地形与接触条件会使相同的动作指令对四足机器人产生不同的运动结果。预测这些结果对于可靠导航与有依据的路径选择至关重要。现有的视频世界模型能够生成视觉上看似合理的未来，但往往难以捕捉机器人动力学与地形交互，导致对动作结果的预测过于乐观。我们提出 DR-WM，一种物理一致的世界模型，它纳入机器人-地形接触动力学以预测四足动作的后果。从一张初始 RGB 图像出发，我们的方法重建场景几何，并整合关于地形接触属性的稠密、无量纲先验，这些先验使用真实世界的动作-响应数据进行校准。由此得到的地形模型支持对具有空间变化接触属性（如摩擦）的物理进行仿真。给定机器人的初始状态与候选动作序列，我们仿真其未来运动，并利用得到的相机轨迹与渲染几何来指导视频世界模型的训练。生成的未来观测随后被用于更新地形重建，从而无需额外的真实世界图像即可实现迭代式的模型推演。大量实验表明，DR-WM 在刻画动作结果的关键物理指标上大幅优于仅几何基线与采用均匀物理参数的基线，同时在所评估的基线中取得最佳性能。这些物理锚定的预测支持更有依据的动作选择：在 90 个具有挑战性的场景中，一个由 DR-WM 增强的 8B 视觉-语言模型在六项评估指标中的五项上优于未受辅助的 32B 视觉-语言模型。

title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
summary: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.

AI.title_zh: 4LC：用于动态世界建模中高效条件化的4D潜在缓存
AI.abstract_zh: 在动态世界建模的视频生成中，应当高效地复用观测到的静态与动态内容，从而为在不同时间和视角下的重复生成提供条件。我们提出4LC，一种具有复合视觉表示和灵活时空访问接口的4D潜在缓存。作为一种潜在缓存，4LC直接复用静态与动态内容的视觉表示以提供生成条件，避免逐请求的RGB渲染与重新编码。作为一种复合缓存，4LC将来自多个视觉编码器（例如VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT）的视觉表示绑定到共享的几何与运动上，使复合表示能够以丰富的信息描述动态世界。此外，我们设计了一种灵活的时空接口，它可在独立指定的时间和视角下直接读取缓存，并跨多个观测组合读出结果，为多样的下游任务提供通用的条件化格式。基于4LC，我们开发了4LC-Video，通过源观测、时空请求和历史复用的不同配置，来处理多种视频生成任务，包括相机控制、时间控制、新视角合成、场景重访和长期生成。我们的实验表明，使用单个4LC-Video模型而无需针对特定任务进行微调，即可在各项任务中实现更高效的条件获取、有效的时空可控性以及场景一致性。

title: RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control
summary: Operational mobile networks are rich in observations but poor in interventions: they continuously generate large volumes of passive telemetry, while controlled action--response trajectories remain comparatively scarce and costly to collect. This observation--intervention asymmetry is a central obstacle to building practical world models for RAN control. We address this problem with RAN-JEPA, an action-conditioned world model that separates representation learning from intervention learning. The model first learns a predictive latent representation from observation-only network data, adapts that representation to the target deployment domain, and then learns action-conditioned latent dynamics from controlled sleep/wake trajectories while keeping the encoder fixed. We evaluate RAN-JEPA using public operator performance data for pretraining and a real-equipment four-cell 5G testbed for domain adaptation, post-training, and control. Across four future 15-minute intervals, RAN-JEPA achieves lower action-conditioned prediction error than a GPT-2 world-model baseline and a mechanistic rule, while remaining close to a strong persistence reference. What-if evaluation further shows that the model produces distinct and coherent future trajectories under matched SLEEP and KEEP plans. In closed-loop control, RAN-JEPA consistently supports higher sleep ratios than the two baselines at comparable congestion cost. These results show that observation-first, action-conditioned learning can turn abundant passive telemetry and limited intervention data into a practical predictive model for energy-aware RAN control.

AI.title_zh: RAN-JEPA：面向节能移动网络控制的作用条件世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 实际运行的移动网络观测丰富但干预匮乏：它们持续产生大量被动遥测数据，而受控的作用—响应轨迹相对稀少且采集成本高昂。这种观测—干预不对称性是构建实用 RAN 控制世界模型的核心障碍。我们用 RAN-JEPA 来解决这一问题，这是一种将表征学习与干预学习分离的作用条件世界模型。该模型首先从仅含观测的网络数据中学习预测性潜在表征，将该表征适配到目标部署域，然后在保持编码器固定的情况下，从受控的休眠/唤醒轨迹中学习作用条件的潜在动力学。我们在评估 RAN-JEPA 时，使用公开的运营商性能数据进行预训练，并使用真实设备的四小区 5G 测试床进行域适配、后训练和控制。在四个未来 15 分钟区间上，RAN-JEPA 的作用条件预测误差低于 GPT-2 世界模型基线和一种机理规则，同时与一个强持续性参考接近。What-if 评估进一步表明，该模型在匹配的 SLEEP 与 KEEP 方案下会产生不同且连贯的未来轨迹。在闭环控制中，RAN-JEPA 在拥堵代价相当的情况下，始终支持比两个基线更高的休眠比例。这些结果表明，观测优先、作用条件的学习能够将丰富的被动遥测数据和有限的干预数据转化为用于能量感知 RAN 控制的实用预测模型。

title: ATOM: Abstract Transition and Option Modeling - Experience-Informed Hierarchical Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures. To be submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: We propose ATOM (Abstract Transition and Option Modeling), a hierarchical navigation framework that combines higher-level graph planning with reusable lower-level option policies for efficient repeated navigation in large-scale 3D environments represented by hierarchical structures such as 3D scene graphs (3DSGs). ATOM operates on a hierarchical graph representation, implemented using, for instance, the Rooms and Places layers of a 3DSG, where each directed abstract transition is associated with a navigation option. For each transition, ATOM computes and stores a reusable option policy along with its state-dependent cost-to-go. Across repeated navigation tasks, ATOM maintains a smoothed empirical distribution over option initiation states and uses it to progressively refine the corresponding abstract transition cost. Ablation studies show that ATOM reduces cumulative repeated-planning time by 97.5% relative to a monolithic MDP baseline while maintaining trajectories within approximately 7% of a Global Places A* shortest-path reference. Experience-informed refinement further reduces abstract transition-cost estimation error by 10.3%. Physical experiments validate ATOM on an F1Tenth vehicle, successfully completing all five navigation queries with 43% of inter-region option executions reusing previously generated solutions.

AI.title_zh: ATOM：抽象转移与选项建模——经验引导的层次化导航
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 ATOM（抽象转移与选项建模，Abstract Transition and Option Modeling），这是一个层次化导航框架，将高层的图规划与可复用的低层选项策略（option policies）相结合，用于在以层次化结构（例如 3D 场景图（3DSG））表示的大规模 3D 环境中高效地进行重复导航。ATOM 在层次化图表示上运行，例如使用 3DSG 的 Rooms and Places 层实现，其中每个有向抽象转移都与一个导航选项相关联。对于每个转移，ATOM 计算并存储一个可复用的选项策略及其依赖于状态的剩余代价（cost-to-go）。在重复的导航任务中，ATOM 维护一个关于选项起始状态的平滑经验分布，并用它逐步细化相应的抽象转移代价。消融研究表明，相对于单体式 MDP 基线，ATOM 将累积的重复规划时间减少了 97.5%，同时使轨迹保持在 Global Places A* 最短路径参考的约 7% 范围内。经验引导的细化进一步将抽象转移代价估计误差降低了 10.3%。物理实验在 F1Tenth 车辆上验证了 ATOM，成功完成了全部五个导航查询，其中 43% 的区域间选项执行复用了先前生成的解。

title: Box-WAM: Box Trajectories as Compact State Representations for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) are a category of policy models that ex- plicitly predict both actions and future world states. They have been shown to outperform action-only models across various robotic manipulation tasks. How- ever, representing the future with full-frame video prediction can be computation- ally expensive during both training and inference. This raises a central question: what compact state representation preserves the planning and supervision bene- fits of future prediction? In this paper, we propose BoxWAM, which replaces dense future frames with oriented bounding box trajectories of task-relevant ob- jects. By explicitly imagining object-centric future motion, our method provides a lightweight prediction target that captures the key physical changes induced by robot actions. We show that box trajectory prediction substantially reduces com- putational cost while improving action prediction performance, suggesting that object-centric compact states can serve as an efficient alternative to video-based world action modeling for robotic manipulation. Result videos can be found on https://box-wam.github.io

AI.title_zh: Box-WAM：将框轨迹作为世界动作模型的紧凑状态表示
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（World action models，WAMs）是一类显式预测动作与未来世界状态的策略模型。已有研究表明，其在多种机器人操作任务上优于仅预测动作的模型。然而，用全帧视频预测来表示未来，在训练和推理阶段都可能带来高昂的计算开销。这引出一个核心问题：什么样的紧凑状态表示能够保留未来预测所带来的规划与监督收益？在本文中，我们提出 BoxWAM，用任务相关物体的有向边界框轨迹替代稠密的未来帧。通过显式想象以物体为中心的未来运动，我们的方法提供了一种轻量的预测目标，能够捕捉由机器人动作所引起的关键物理变化。我们表明，框轨迹预测在显著降低计算成本的同时提升了动作预测性能，这表明以物体为中心的紧凑状态可以作为机器人操作中基于视频的世界动作建模的一种高效替代方案。结果视频可在 https://box-wam.github.io 查看

title: Act4R: Action-conditioned 4D reconstruction for kinematics-free control
summary: Precise control of movement across various robotic embodiments is a longstanding challenge. Modeling complex robotic structures requires significant time, dedicated sensors, and manual labeling. Recent advancements in 4D representation learning offer an interesting alternative: can we leverage 4D features lifted from 2D observations to densely map a robot's spatial movement based on the action signal? To this end, we propose Act4R, a framework that builds on 3D foundation model to predict a robot's 3D scene flow with any given action. Act4R introduces a Spatial-Action Encoder, which encodes the current 2D robot state and its action signals into embeddings that represent future robot state in 3D. Then, both the current and future spatial embeddings are decoded into point maps to estimate action-conditioned scene flow. To effectively learn the mapping between action and future state, Act4R introduces spatial-action fusion in its transformer-based encoder, and a spatial alignment loss that guides the encoder for future flow prediction. After training on some samples of a given embodiment, Act4R can perform inverse control by optimizing the signal to achieve the desired scene flow. We evaluate Act4R on a public real-world dataset and synthetic data collected in simulator. Experiments on various robotic platforms show that Act4R outperforms the previous SoTA in scene flow prediction. Our method also performs better in inverse control, both on the action accuracy metric and in closed-loop control in simulation.

AI.title_zh: Act4R：面向无运动学控制的动作条件 4D 重建
AI.abstract_zh: 在各种机器人本体上精确控制运动是一项长期挑战。对复杂机器人结构进行建模需要大量时间、专用传感器和人工标注。近期 4D 表征学习的进展提供了一种有趣的替代方案：我们能否利用从 2D 观测中提升得到的 4D 特征，基于动作信号稠密地映射机器人的空间运动？为此，我们提出 Act4R，一个建立在 3D 基础模型之上的框架，用于在给定任意动作的情况下预测机器人的 3D 场景流。Act4R 引入了一个空间-动作编码器（Spatial-Action Encoder），它将当前的 2D 机器人状态及其动作信号编码为表示未来机器人 3D 状态的嵌入。随后，当前和未来的空间嵌入都被解码为点图（point maps），以估计动作条件场景流。为了有效学习动作与未来状态之间的映射，Act4R 在其基于 transformer 的编码器中引入了空间-动作融合，以及一个引导编码器进行未来流预测的空间对齐损失。在给定本体的部分样本上训练后，Act4R 可以通过优化信号以实现期望的场景流，从而执行逆控制。我们在一个公开的真实世界数据集和模拟器中收集的合成数据上评估了 Act4R。在各种机器人平台上的实验表明，Act4R 在场景流预测上优于先前的 SoTA。我们的方法在逆控制方面也表现更好，无论是在动作准确率指标上，还是在模拟中的闭环控制上。

title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
summary: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

AI.title_zh: World-T3：将测试时训练作为实时视频世界模型的持久记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型的最新进展已能够实现看似合理的交互式环境，但长时程生成对视觉记忆提出了根本性要求：随着模型持续生成，先前观察到的世界必须保持一致。现有的自回归方法往往隐含地依赖生成模型自身来保留此类信息，导致在有效上下文之外出现空间记忆衰减。我们提出 World-T3，一种相机控制的视频世界模型，其具备测试时训练记忆，可将过去的观察整合进专门的模型参数中。为稳健地更新该记忆，我们提出一种递归最小二乘规则，通过基于位姿键控的在线记忆更新来增量地吸收新的视觉特征。我们的 TTT 记忆通过相机位姿从快速权重状态中读出先前观察到的场景特征，从而无论 rollout 长度如何，都能以恒定存储和每步计算量实现一致的生成。为借助这一稳健记忆促进实时交互式生成，我们进一步通过双教师分布匹配将自回归模型蒸馏为少步生成器。在长时程重访基准上，相对于在该两项指标上均为最强的基线，World-T3 将重访 PSNR 从 13.52 dB 提升至 18.31 dB，并将绝对旋转误差从 3.344 降至 1.075，同时在单块 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上以 1280 x 704 分辨率维持 20.6 FPS。

title: IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback
summary: Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

AI.title_zh: IsoVRBench：无需人类反馈的视频奖励建模
AI.abstract_zh: 视频奖励模型是在人类对视频的偏好上训练和评估的，而这些视频往往同时在提示对齐（prompt alignment）、视觉保真度（visual fidelity）、运动（motion）和生成器身份（generator identity）等属性上存在差异。因此，聚合准确率无法揭示奖励模型能够可靠区分哪些视频属性。我们通过受控干预（controlled interventions）构建偏好对，每次只改变生成视频的一个属性，同时保持其余属性固定。由此构造出的偏好对，天然提供了关于视频在某一特定维度上如何差异的偏好，而无需任何人工标注。我们提出 IsoVRBench，一个视频生成奖励建模基准，包含横跨八种干预的 8,000 个此类偏好对，并表明当前最先进的模型能够区分生成器之间宽泛的质量差异，却会漏掉诸如时序顺序（temporal order）等重要特征。最佳的奖励模型在帧重排（reordered frames）任务上仅达到 60.8%，而人类为 100%，且现有基准上的排名无法预测这一失败。使用这些合成的隔离干预对（isolated intervention pairs）作为训练数据，可带来：1）IsoVRM，一个奖励模型，其在 VBench-2.0 上比用更大规模人工标注偏好数据集训练的对应模型高出 3.8 个百分点；2）IsoWan，用 IsoVRM 后训练（post-trained）得到的视频生成器，在人类偏好上优于其使用人类数据训练的对应模型；3）与人类数据结合时收益可叠加。由于干预对是自动生成而非收集而来的，该基准和训练数据可以随着生成器的演进而轻松扩展。

title: Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication
summary: Multi-player interactive world models aim to simulate shared environments from multiple players' perspectives, but achieving robust generation while scaling to more players remains challenging. Existing approaches that rely on fully-connected communication (e.g., Solaris) incur quadratic attention costs as the number of players grows, while centralized approaches (e.g., $γ$-World) suffer from interference between unrelated events in a shared global representation. To address these challenges, we present Multics, a multi-player video generation framework with hierarchical communication that structures information exchange across player, group, and global levels. This hierarchy introduces group tokens into self-attention as intermediate group-level representations that aggregate locally relevant player information. These tokens connect to global tokens for cross-group communication, while the hierarchical topology limits direct mixing between unrelated local events. Group-token parameters are shared across group slots, allowing the same communication module to accommodate varying numbers of players without introducing new group-specific parameters. We further propose budget-constrained dynamic grouping based on recent camera trajectories, which adaptively groups relevant players while limiting unnecessary communication. Experiments demonstrate that Multics achieves state-of-the-art performance in 4- and 6-player settings, with improved cross-player consistency, player-specific action and camera controllability, and interference robustness. Moreover, Multics generalizes from 4-player training to 6-, 8-, and 10-player inference without retraining, while reducing self-attention computation compared with fully-connected communication.

AI.title_zh: Multics：具有分层通信的生成式多玩家世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 多玩家交互式世界模型旨在从多个玩家的视角模拟共享环境，但在扩展到更多玩家的同时实现稳健生成仍然具有挑战性。依赖全连接通信的现有方法（例如 Solaris）会随着玩家数量增长而产生二次方注意力开销，而集中式方法（例如 $γ$-World）则会在共享全局表示中遭受无关事件之间的干扰。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 Multics，一种具有分层通信的多玩家视频生成框架，其在玩家、组和全局层级上组织信息交换。该分层结构将组 token（group token）作为中间组级表示引入自注意力，以聚合局部相关的玩家信息。这些 token 连接到全局 token 以进行跨组通信，而分层拓扑限制了无关局部事件之间的直接混合。组 token 参数在各组槽位之间共享，使得同一通信模块无需引入新的组特定参数即可适应不同数量的玩家。我们进一步提出基于近期相机轨迹的预算约束动态分组，它自适应地对相关玩家进行分组，同时限制不必要的通信。实验表明，Multics 在 4 玩家和 6 玩家设置下取得了最先进的性能，具有改进的跨玩家一致性、玩家特定动作与相机可控性，以及干扰稳健性。此外，Multics 无需重新训练即可从 4 玩家训练泛化到 6、8 和 10 玩家推理，同时与全连接通信相比减少了自注意力计算量。

title: SonicWorld: Source-Centric Latent Dynamics for Spatial Audio Reasoning
summary: Dynamic spatial audio reasoning requires a model to associate changing acoustic observations with the correct source and recover its spatial state at a queried time or interval, a challenge intensified by overlapping speech and source motion. To study this problem, we introduce Sonic-Bench, comprising 2.8K first-order Ambisonics clips and 28.8K target-specific question-answer pairs across 480 simulated indoor scenes. The benchmark covers localization, distance estimation, and motion reasoning in single- and dual-source settings. We further propose SonicWorld, which integrates physical, learned acoustic, and semantic features into persistent source states through learned transitions and recurrent updates, and projects them into an Omni LLM for spatial reasoning. Compared with Spatial-Omni on the Sonic-Bench test split, SonicWorld improves direction accuracy from 31.98% to 34.69% and reduces azimuth error from 57.22° to 48.01°. In zero-shot transfer to Spatial LibriSpeech, SonicWorld retains strong localization performance, achieving 73.98% direction accuracy and 19.29° azimuth error, compared with 27.14% and 70.74° for Spatial-Omni.

AI.title_zh: SonicWorld：面向空间音频推理的以声源为中心的潜在动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 动态空间音频推理要求模型将不断变化的声学观测与正确的声源相关联，并在被查询的时刻或时间段恢复其空间状态，而重叠语音与声源运动加剧了这一挑战。为研究该问题，我们提出了 Sonic-Bench，其包含 2.8K 个一阶 Ambisonics 音频片段和 28.8K 个针对特定目标的问题-答案对，覆盖 480 个模拟室内场景。该基准涵盖单声源和双声源设置下的定位、距离估计和运动推理。我们进一步提出 SonicWorld，它通过学习到的状态转移和循环更新，将物理特征、学习到的声学特征和语义特征整合为持续的声源状态，并将其投影到 Omni LLM 中进行空间推理。在 Sonic-Bench 测试划分上，与 Spatial-Omni 相比，SonicWorld 将方向准确率从 31.98% 提升至 34.69%，并将方位角误差从 57.22° 降至 48.01°。在零样本迁移到 Spatial LibriSpeech 时，SonicWorld 保持了较强的定位性能，达到 73.98% 的方向准确率和 19.29° 的方位角误差，而 Spatial-Omni 为 27.14% 和 70.74°。

title: D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control
summary: Frontier large language models (LLMs) now reason about space well enough to program robots, yet the world models behind robot policies are implicit, held in network weights or predicted video, and cannot be inspected or corrected directly. We present D-World, an explicit world-language-action model built on the Sense, Plan and Act decomposition. A perception agent writes the scene as an executable digital twin using generated vision and geometry code. A planning agent searches for actions in simulation and, after each executed action chunk, revises the twin's object states and named physical parameters against what the robot measured. A parameter revision is accepted only if replaying the latest chunk does not increase any measured residual beyond its tolerance, and every chunk is checked in the updated twin before it runs. Structural mismatches return to perception for reconstruction. We call this measurement-grounded cycle of correction and revision recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which the LLM stays frozen while the world it acts in improves. We model the choice of actions that both advance the task and expose model error as a dual control problem and show that the cost of incorporating evidence into the twin sets the threshold at which probing pays, so cheap local revision counteracts the turn-off of cautious controllers. Each episode runs a real-to-sim-to-real loop, and its recorded twins can be refitted and re-rendered offline into higher-fidelity environments for post-training. Because perception and planning communicate only through the twin and language, either can be replaced by a learned model, and since inference dominates the loop, the loop speeds up with faster models. On a dual-arm robot, towel and toaster tasks show local revisions, such as one reducing the bread's rendered-depth residual from 22.4 to 1.5 mm, that let execution continue without reconstruction.

AI.title_zh: D-World：一种在对偶控制下具有递归自我改进能力的显式世界-语言-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 前沿大语言模型（LLM）如今已能对空间进行足够好的推理，从而为机器人编程，但机器人策略背后的世界模型却是隐式的，存在于网络权重或预测视频之中，无法被直接检查或修正。我们提出 D-World，一种基于“感知（Sense）、规划（Plan）与行动（Act）”分解构建的显式世界-语言-动作模型。感知智能体利用生成的视觉与几何代码，将场景写成一个可执行的数字孪生。规划智能体在仿真中搜索动作，并在每个已执行的动作块（action chunk）之后，依据机器人所测量的结果，修正孪生中的物体状态与具名物理参数。只有当重放最新的动作块不会使任何被测残差超出其容差时，参数修正才会被接受；而每个动作块在运行之前都会在更新后的孪生中接受检查。结构性不匹配则返回感知环节进行重建。我们将这种以测量为依据的修正与修订循环称为递归自我改进（RSI），在其中 LLM 保持冻结，而它所行动于其中的世界得到改进。我们将选择既能推进任务又能暴露模型误差的动作这一问题建模为对偶控制问题，并表明将证据纳入孪生的代价决定了探测行为变得值得的阈值，因此廉价的局部修订可以抵消谨慎控制器被关闭（turn-off）的问题。每个回合都运行一个真实-仿真-真实（real-to-sim-to-real）循环，其记录的孪生可以被离线重新拟合与重新渲染，成为更高保真度的环境，用于后训练。由于感知与规划仅通过孪生和语言进行通信，二者都可以被学习模型所替代；并且由于推理主导该循环，循环会随着更快的模型而加速。在一台双臂机器人上，毛巾与烤面包机任务展示了局部修订的效果，例如某次修订将面包的渲染深度残差从 22.4 降至 1.5 mm，从而使执行无需重建即可继续。

title: PatientWM: Towards Generalizable Clinical World Models via Unified Patient States
summary: Clinical decisions depend on anticipating how a patient's condition will evolve as treatment is adjusted and new evidence becomes available. Existing medical world models capture patient-state evolution, but often define the evolving state around a particular modality or task, limiting reuse as inputs or prediction targets change. These models also retain history through observation sequences or recurrent or latent summaries rather than exposing preceding patient states and clinical actions as an ordered transition context. This distinction matters because similar current measurements may follow different recent changes, treatment exposures, and observed responses. To tackle these limitations, we propose PatientWM, a clinical world-model framework built around a unified patient state and sequential latent history. Availability-aware encoders integrate observations available at each decision time into the patient state, while typed decoders produce task-specific clinical readouts without defining the state around any single target. PatientWM further conditions each next-state prediction on the current state and supplied action together with a bounded, ordered history of preceding latent patient states and clinical actions, preserving recent treatment and response context. Experiments across MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and three external clinical datasets show superior performance in clinical prediction, multi-step forecasting, and action-planning evaluation. Transfer experiments further demonstrate the generalizability of PatientWM's patient state. Together, these results establish its ability to forecast clinical evolution and support planning.

AI.title_zh: PatientWM：迈向通过统一患者状态实现可泛化的临床世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 临床决策依赖于预判患者的病情将如何随治疗调整和新证据的出现而演变。现有的医学世界模型能够刻画患者状态的演化，但往往围绕某一特定模态或任务来定义演化中的状态，从而在输入或预测目标发生变化时限制了复用。这些模型还通过观测序列或循环/潜在摘要来保留历史，而不是将先前的患者状态与临床动作作为有序的转移上下文呈现出来。这一区别很重要，因为相似的当前测量值可能对应着不同的近期变化、治疗暴露和已观察到的反应。为解决这些局限，我们提出 PatientWM，一个围绕统一患者状态和序列化潜在历史构建的临床世界模型框架。可用性感知编码器将每个决策时刻可获得的观测整合进患者状态，而类型化解码器产生任务特定的临床读出，且不将状态围绕任何单一目标来定义。PatientWM 进一步将每一次下一状态预测条件化于当前状态与所提供的动作，以及一个有界的、有序的先前潜在患者状态与临床动作的历史，从而保留近期治疗与反应上下文。在 MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV 和三个外部临床数据集上的实验表明，其在临床预测、多步预测和动作规划评估中表现更优。迁移实验进一步证明了 PatientWM 患者状态的可泛化性。总体而言，这些结果确立了其预测临床演变并支持规划的能力。

title: Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention
summary: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

AI.title_zh: 通过持续观察与及时干预实现主动式物理AI
AI.abstract_zh: 物理AI（Physical AI）通常围绕明确指定的任务来构建：给定一个目标或指令，系统进行感知、推理并行动。然而在许多现实场景中，重要任务在人们明确表述之前，就已从不断变化的世界状态中涌现出来。我们将这一互补性问题作为主动式物理AI（Proactive Physical AI）来研究，其中AI系统持续观察物理世界，识别值得干预的情境，并在恰当时机发起适当的行动。我们开发了ProAgent，这是一个端到端系统，围绕两个组件构建：一个Jev风格的主动时机模型（称为StreamingJev），用于判定是否需要干预以及何时干预；以及一个响应模型（Response Model），用于为人生成响应，或调用可用的设备能力以进行物理执行。为支持大规模学习，我们开发了一条自动化数据流水线，将视频转换为用于主动时机的监督信号。实验表明，在明确目标和常设角色两种设定下，均展现出较强的主动性能，与源骨干基线相比，既实现了更准确的干预时机，又具有更少的误触发。真实机器人评估进一步证明了ProAgent识别新兴需求并将其转化为适当物理行动的能力。

title: InfoVis: Unified Slide Image Generation and Editing
summary: Generating and editing presentation slides requires models to combine accurate text rendering, instruction following, visual grounding, aesthetic design, and precise editing within one canvas. Existing work covers only subsets of these capabilities and lacks large-scale slide-native supervision and diagnostic evaluation. We formulate four slide-centric tasks and build a scalable data engine with over 13M continual-pretraining records and 1.9M supervised fine-tuning records. We also introduce VisSlideBench, a benchmark of 1,527 manually screened instances that covers all four tasks with task-specific, multidimensional evaluation. Its automatic rankings agree with blinded, dimension-wise human rankings. Using these resources, we train InfoVis, a unified 9B slide generation and editing model. On VisSlideBench, InfoVis leads every evaluated open-source model on all eleven metrics and scores 7.94 overall against 7.99 for Nano-Banana-2. Starting from FLUX.2-klein-base-9B, slide-specific post-training adds 1.6 points overall, with the largest generation gains in content faithfulness; the remaining gap to proprietary models is smallest in content faithfulness and largest in aesthetic quality. Built on InfoVis, our document-to-slide workflow achieves the second-highest Aesthetics score on the external SlidesGen-Bench. We will release the model, code, data, and benchmark.

AI.title_zh: InfoVis：统一的幻灯片图像生成与编辑
AI.abstract_zh: 生成和编辑演示幻灯片要求模型在同一画布内结合准确的文本渲染、指令遵循、视觉定位、美学设计和精确编辑。现有工作仅覆盖这些能力中的部分子集，且缺乏大规模幻灯片原生监督和诊断性评测。我们形式化了四个以幻灯片为中心的任务，并构建了一个可扩展的数据引擎，包含超过 1300 万条持续预训练记录和 190 万条监督微调记录。我们还提出了 VisSlideBench，这是一个包含 1,527 个经人工筛选实例的基准，覆盖全部四个任务，并提供任务特定的多维度评估。其自动排名与盲评的、按维度进行的人工排名一致。利用这些资源，我们训练了 InfoVis，一个统一的 9B 幻灯片生成与编辑模型。在 VisSlideBench 上，InfoVis 在全部十一项指标上领先所有被评估的开源模型，总体得分为 7.94，而 Nano-Banana-2 为 7.99。从 FLUX.2-klein-base-9B 出发，针对幻灯片的后期训练使总体得分提升 1.6 分，其中生成部分在内容忠实度上的提升最大；与专有模型之间的剩余差距在内容忠实度上最小，在美学质量上最大。基于 InfoVis，我们的文档到幻灯片工作流在外部 SlidesGen-Bench 上取得了第二高的 Aesthetics 得分。我们将发布模型、代码、数据和基准。

title: Geospatial Vector Geometry as a Native Spatial Modality for Vision-Language Models
summary: Geospatial reasoning links VLMs to real-world action and decision making. Reliable reasoning requires accurate spatial information and effective spatial representations. However, current VLMs obtain this information mainly from language and vision. At larger geographic scales, limited visual observations make it difficult to establish accurate spatial references and recover precise spatial relations. This leads to a bottleneck for VLM spatial perception and reasoning. This paper proposes that geospatial vector geometry can become a native spatial modality within a VLM and introduces GeoVec-VLM. First, we develop a structured geometry representation that preserves the spatial structure and arrangement of vector objects, building an explicit spatial basis. Second, we introduce a geometry interaction strategy that brings this basis into multimodal computation, where it interacts with visual content and language references according to the queried spatial relations. Together, these designs allow perception and reasoning to operate on shared geometric references. Across five spatial reasoning tasks, GeoVec-VLM improves mean accuracy by about 11\% relative to the strongest baseline, maintains its gains under geographic transfer, and shows greater geometric consistency. Our results show that geospatial vector geometry offers a promising internal spatial basis for VLM spatial reasoning. https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM

AI.title_zh: 地理空间矢量几何作为视觉语言模型的原生空间模态
AI.abstract_zh: 地理空间推理将 VLM 与现实世界的行动和决策联系起来。可靠的推理需要准确的空间信息和有效的空间表示。然而，当前的 VLM 主要从语言和视觉中获取这些信息。在更大的地理尺度上，有限的视觉观测使得建立准确的空间参考和恢复精确的空间关系变得困难。这导致 VLM 空间感知与推理的一个瓶颈。本文提出，地理空间矢量几何可以成为 VLM 内部的一种原生空间模态，并提出了 GeoVec-VLM。首先，我们开发了一种结构化几何表示，它保留矢量对象的空间结构与排列，从而构建显式的空间基础。其次，我们引入了一种几何交互策略，将该基础带入多模态计算，使其根据所查询的空间关系与视觉内容和语言指涉进行交互。这些设计共同使感知与推理能够在共享的几何参考上运行。在五项空间推理任务上，GeoVec-VLM 相对于最强基线将平均准确率提高约 11\%，在地理迁移下保持其增益，并表现出更强的几何一致性。我们的结果表明，地理空间矢量几何为 VLM 空间推理提供了一种有前景的内部空间基础。https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM

title: Relational Learning as World Modeling
summary: Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. Given executions from an unseen world, TabWM uses them as context to predict the sparse structured edits caused by a new action without parameter updates. Across 512 held-out worlds, complete-edit F1 rises from 0.016 with no observed executions to 0.685 with 64, where a correct edit must match its operation, relational location, and value. Because these predictions are explicit relational edits, they can be applied recursively to imagine candidate futures and compare actions before they are taken. Broader search over these predicted futures improves the realized return of selected action sequences. Together, these results suggest that relational dynamics can be learned in context, broadening relational learning from modeling system state to modeling how that state changes under action.

AI.title_zh: 关系学习作为世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 关系学习通常从数据库状态出发进行预测，但决策提出了一个不同的问题：该状态在某个动作下将如何变化？在运营系统中，答案取决于可能并不在数据库本身中可见的系统特定动力学。我们将每个这样的系统视为一个关系“世界”，并探究模型能否从观测到的执行中推断其行为方式。我们提出 TabWM（Tabular World Model，表格世界模型）与 WorldRel，后者是一个用于预训练的可执行关系世界的生成器。给定来自一个未见世界的执行，TabWM 将其用作上下文，在无需参数更新的情况下预测由新动作引起的稀疏结构化编辑。在 512 个留出世界中，完整编辑 F1 从无观测执行时的 0.016 上升到有 64 个观测执行时的 0.685，其中一次正确编辑必须在其操作、关系位置和值上均匹配。由于这些预测是显式的关系编辑，它们可以被递归应用以想象候选未来，并在动作被执行之前比较动作。在这些预测未来上进行更广泛的搜索可提升所选动作序列的实际回报。总体而言，这些结果表明关系动力学可以在上下文中被学习，从而将关系学习从对系统状态建模拓展到对该状态在动作下如何变化进行建模。

title: EvoSpatial: Experience-Driven Skill and Tool Evolution for Spatial Reasoning Agents
summary: Tool-augmented vision-language agents compose perception and measurement to reason about spatial relationships, but effective execution also requires tracking geometric assumptions and checking intermediate evidence. Preserving this experience across tasks requires retaining procedural knowledge together with the computations it governs. We introduce EvoSpatial, an experience-driven framework that evolves a library of linked skills and tools. Our key insight is that successful and failed spatial trajectories reveal both how to compute and when to trust the result. EvoSpatial retrieves skills, reuses tools, and synthesizes reusable computational functions (generated helpers) during reasoning. After answer submission, supervised outcome feedback guides skill refinement and tool consolidation for subsequent tasks. Across 20 benchmarks, EvoSpatial attains the highest average score among the compared spatial agents, exceeding SpatialClaw by 4.0 percentage points. Further experiments show cross-benchmark transfer and improved reasoning through skill-guided distillation without external skills at evaluation. These results support accumulating spatial experience for both inference-time reuse and trajectory-based training.

AI.title_zh: EvoSpatial：面向空间推理智能体的经验驱动技能与工具演化
AI.abstract_zh: 工具增强的视觉-语言智能体通过组合感知与测量来推理空间关系，但有效执行还需要追踪几何假设并核查中间证据。要在任务之间保留这种经验，就需要将过程性知识与它所支配的计算一并保留。我们提出 EvoSpatial，一个经验驱动的框架，它演化出一个由相互关联的技能与工具构成的库。我们的关键洞见是：成功的与失败的空间轨迹同时揭示了如何计算以及何时信任结果。EvoSpatial 在推理过程中检索技能、复用工具，并合成可复用的计算函数（生成的辅助函数）。在提交答案之后，有监督的结果反馈会引导技能精炼与工具整合，以服务于后续任务。在 20 个基准上，EvoSpatial 在所比较的空间智能体中取得了最高平均分，超过 SpatialClaw 4.0 个百分点。进一步的实验显示了跨基准迁移，以及在评估时不使用外部技能的情况下通过技能引导的蒸馏所提升的推理能力。这些结果支持为推理时复用与基于轨迹的训练而积累空间经验。

title: What Limits Cross-Task Generalization in World Action Models?
comment: 34 pages, 10 figures, under review in ICLR 2027
summary: Cross-task generalization remains difficult for world action models (WAMs), even when their predicted futures depict plausible manipulation. This gap can be attributed directly: we make this gap directly testable by decoupling a WAM into a world model and an inverse-dynamics model (IDM), then holding the IDM fixed while replacing the source of future images. We introduce Align Once, Evaluate Everywhere (AoE), a camera-space inverse-dynamics model pretrained on large-scale robot data, which provides this recovery interface for different future sources across tasks and environments. Through it, we find that actions recovered from recorded futures of unseen tasks execute almost as well as replayed demonstrations, whereas futures predicted by world models collapse across benchmarks. The failures are not generic: they concentrate on the gripper and interaction geometry while generation capacity is spent on task-irrelevant background. This diagnosis suggests that supervision should target exactly these regions. We therefore introduce the vision-to-action (VITA) loss, which passes generated futures through the frozen AoE and penalizes discrepancies in the recovered actions, redirecting generation toward action-relevant detail. Across two world models and three manipulation benchmarks, this simple change raises the execution success of generated futures from near zero to 47.0%. The same loss also transfers to WAMs and yields consistent gains in native control.

AI.title_zh: 是什么限制了世界动作模型中的跨任务泛化？
AI.abstract_zh: 对于世界动作模型（WAM）而言，跨任务泛化依然困难，即使其预测的未来呈现出看似合理的操作动作。这一差距可以直接归因：我们通过将一个 WAM 解耦为一个世界模型和一个逆动力学模型（IDM），然后在替换未来图像来源的同时保持 IDM 固定，使这一差距变得可直接检验。我们提出 Align Once, Evaluate Everywhere（AoE），一个在大规模机器人数据上预训练的相机空间逆动力学模型，它为跨任务和跨环境的不同未来来源提供了这一恢复接口。通过它，我们发现：从未见任务的记录未来中恢复出的动作，其执行效果几乎与重放的示范相当，而由世界模型预测出的未来则在各基准上崩溃。这些失败并非泛化的失败：它们集中在夹爪和交互几何上，而生成能力却被耗费在与任务无关的背景上。这一诊断表明，监督应当恰好针对这些区域。因此，我们提出视觉到动作（VITA）损失，它将生成的未来通过冻结的 AoE，并对恢复出的动作中的差异施加惩罚，从而将生成重新导向与动作相关的细节。在两个世界模型和三个操作基准上，这一简单改动将生成未来的执行成功率从接近零提升到 47.0%。同一损失也可迁移到 WAM 上，并在原生控制中带来一致的增益。

title: REEL: Learning to Retrieve, Evaluate, and Evolve Visual Memory for Any Long-Horizon Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Memory-based long-video generation aims to combine user control with long-range visual consistency. We organize this process into three functional components: a planner, an adapter, and a generator. Representative multi-shot systems couple memory to generator-specific interfaces or use predefined agent workflows, rather than independently training a memory policy for cross-shot objectives. We introduce REEL, a general-purpose visual-memory planner. Through a unified tool interface, REEL learns to retrieve references, create missing visual evidence, and update persistent memory. Backend-specific adapters translate its evidence plans into supported conditioning inputs, allowing the same policy to guide different black-box video generators. To train REEL, we construct two high-quality datasets, REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k, covering diverse interaction patterns and prompt types. Training proceeds in three stages: supervised fine-tuning, single-shot Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and multi-shot GRPO. Multi-shot GRPO carries policy-generated memory across consecutive shots, so later outcomes guide earlier reference selection and memory updates. REEL-Bench tests identity preservation and intended state changes under text-only requests and timed reference-image uploads. On JoyAI-Echo~1.5 and MiniMax-H3, REEL improves cross-shot consistency on ST-Bench by 15.1\% and 20.7\%, and Core-100 on our proposed REEL-Bench by 2.41 and 8.32 points, respectively, over the no-memory baseline.

AI.title_zh: REEL：学习为任意长时程多镜头视频生成检索、评估与演化视觉记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 基于记忆的长视频生成旨在将用户控制与长程视觉一致性结合起来。我们将这一过程组织为三个功能组件：规划器（planner）、适配器（adapter）和生成器（generator）。具有代表性的多镜头系统将记忆耦合到生成器特定的接口上，或使用预定义的智能体工作流，而不是针对跨镜头目标独立训练一个记忆策略。我们提出 REEL，一个通用的视觉记忆规划器。通过统一的工具接口，REEL 学习检索参考、创建缺失的视觉证据并更新持久记忆。后端特定的适配器将其证据规划转换为受支持的条件输入，从而使同一策略能够引导不同的黑盒视频生成器。为训练 REEL，我们构建了两个高质量数据集 REEL-SFT-4k 和 REEL-RL-1k，涵盖多样的交互模式与提示类型。训练分三个阶段进行：监督微调、单镜头群组相对策略优化（GRPO）以及多镜头 GRPO。多镜头 GRPO 将策略生成的记忆在连续镜头之间传递，因此后续结果会指导先前的参考选择与记忆更新。REEL-Bench 在纯文本请求和定时参考图像上传下测试身份保持与预期状态变化。在 JoyAI-Echo~1.5 和 MiniMax-H3 上，与无记忆基线相比，REEL 在 ST-Bench 上将跨镜头一致性分别提升 15.1\% 和 20.7\%，在我们提出的 REEL-Bench 上，Core-100 分别提升 2.41 分和 8.32 分。

title: PRB-WM: Physics-Regularized Beta World Models for Predictive Link Adaptation on Real Time-Varying Underwater Acoustic Channels
comment: Submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. 15 pages, 13 figures, 3 tables, 2 algorithms
summary: Adaptive modulation and coding (AMC) improves the spectral efficiency of underwater acoustic (UWA) links, but its feedback is inevitably stale: sound propagates slowly, and by the time channel state information (CSI) arrives, the fast time-varying multipath channel has moved on. Predictive link adaptation therefore needs more than a point forecast: it needs a distribution over each candidate action's consequences. We propose PRB-WM, a physics-regularized Beta world model for predictive per-subcarrier link adaptation on real time-varying UWA channels. A persistence-anchored stochastic latent-space dynamics model learns how the channel evolves; a counterfactual outcome head evaluates, for every candidate modulation and coding scheme (MCS), a Beta-binomial distribution of bit errors on shared imagined futures; and a chance-constrained receding-horizon model predictive controller maximizes expected spectral efficiency subject to a bounded probability of violating the bit error rate (BER) target. To the best of our knowledge, PRB-WM is the first world model for UWA communications. In closed-loop replay of six measured sea-trial links from the public UWA Channel Library against a 24-method pool spanning the full methodological spectrum, PRB-WM attains a mean goodput 87% above the strongest baseline, ranks first on all six time-varying links at the longest lookahead, and is the only method whose realized frame risk decreases systematically with lookahead, meeting the BER-violation contract where no baseline does. Ablations confirm that rollout sampling dispersion is essential to the chance constraint and that the physics anchor is necessary for trainability.

AI.title_zh: PRB-WM：面向真实时变水声信道预测式链路自适应的物理正则化Beta世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 自适应调制与编码（AMC）可提升水声（UWA）链路的频谱效率，但其反馈不可避免地过时：声音传播缓慢，等信道状态信息（CSI）到达时，快速时变多径信道已经发生了变化。因此，预测式链路自适应需要的不仅仅是一个点预测：它需要每个候选动作后果上的一个分布。我们提出PRB-WM，一种物理正则化的Beta世界模型，用于在真实时变UWA信道上进行预测式的逐子载波链路自适应。一个以持续值为锚的随机潜空间动力学模型学习信道如何演化；一个反事实结果头在共享的想象未来上，为每一种候选调制与编码方案（MCS）评估误比特的Beta-二项分布；一个机会约束滚动时域模型预测控制器在违反误比特率（BER）目标的概率有界的条件下最大化期望频谱效率。据我们所知，PRB-WM是首个用于UWA通信的世界模型。在公开UWA Channel Library中六条实测海试链路的闭环回放中，面对涵盖完整方法论谱系的24种方法池，PRB-WM取得的平均有效吞吐量比最强基线高出87%，在最长的前瞻步数下于全部六条时变链路上排名第一，并且是唯一一种其实际帧风险随前瞻步数系统性地下降的方法，满足BER违反契约，而没有任何基线能够做到。消融实验证实，推演采样的离散度对于机会约束不可或缺，且物理锚对于可训练性是必要的。

title: CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing reference videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes is an important path toward controllable video generation for filmmaking: these scenes provide modifiable, renderable visual proxies that enable explicit control over scene layout, subject actions, and camera behavior. To evaluate agents' ability to reconstruct editable dynamic 3D scenes from dynamic reference videos, we introduce CineRecon, a benchmark comprising 50 reference videos and 360 annotated evaluation clips. The reference videos span film, real-world footage, and games. Given a complete video, an agent uses tools to construct, animate, render, and refine its reconstruction. We evaluate this task under three representation settings: Proxy, Simplified, and Detailed. These settings increase geometric and appearance requirements while retaining the same requirements for spatial relations, camera behavior, and subject dynamics. This design tests whether agents can reproduce the events in a video when detailed appearance is unnecessary, and how performance changes as representation requirements increase. For evaluation, we construct checklists that associate observable properties and events with specific entities and times. A vision-language judge compares timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames across 11 categories, grouped into camera, static, and dynamic consistency dimensions. We evaluate 12 models using their corresponding agent harnesses and find failures across all three dimensions. Subject motions and interactions remain difficult to reproduce even under the Proxy setting.

AI.title_zh: CineRecon：面向智能体电影化重建的前沿模型基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 将参考视频重建为可编辑的动态3D场景，是通向电影制作中可控视频生成的重要路径：这些场景提供了可修改、可渲染的视觉代理，从而能够对场景布局、主体动作和相机行为进行显式控制。为评估智能体从动态参考视频重建可编辑动态3D场景的能力，我们提出了 CineRecon，这是一个包含 50 个参考视频和 360 个标注评估片段的基准。参考视频涵盖电影、真实世界素材和游戏。给定一个完整视频，智能体使用工具来构建、动画化、渲染并改进其重建结果。我们在三种表示设置下评估该任务：Proxy、Simplified 和 Detailed。这些设置在提高几何与外观要求的同时，保持对空间关系、相机行为和主体动态的要求不变。该设计检验了在不需要详细外观时，智能体能否再现视频中的事件，以及随着表示要求的提高性能如何变化。在评估方面，我们构建了检查清单，将可观察的属性与事件同特定实体和时间相关联。一个视觉语言评判器在 11 个类别上比较时间戳对齐的参考帧与渲染帧，这些类别被归入相机、静态和动态一致性维度。我们使用各模型对应的智能体框架评估了 12 个模型，并发现三个维度上均存在失败。即使在 Proxy 设置下，主体运动和交互仍然难以再现。

title: G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation
summary: World models capture environment dynamics and support counterfactual reasoning for planning. In image-goal navigation, where the target often lies beyond the current field of view, the agent must not only model environmental dynamics but also maintain a persistent spatial memory of the scene. Existing approaches either introduce spatial context by fine-tuning pretrained models on the target task, which underexploits their spatial priors, or rely on external 3D reconstruction, which is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose the Geometry Grounded World Action Model (G$^2$WAM) for image-goal navigation. G$^2$WAM encodes spatial cues through a learned scene-coordinate localization module that anchors the current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame, yielding a stable and consistent spatial context that enables efficient navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction. Following the world-action-model paradigm, G$^2$WAM jointly predicts future states and actions, eliminating the need for costly cross-entropy method (CEM) style planning. In addition, G$^2$WAM operates entirely in latent space, avoiding the computational burden of pixel-level reconstruction and substantially reducing inference cost. Across four trajectory prediction benchmarks, G$^2$WAM reduces average ATE and RPE by 40.1% and 35.2%, respectively. In closed-loop navigation experiments, it improves the success rate from 54.0% to 63.0% and the success weighted by path length (SPL) from 36.4% to 59.2%, while maintaining high efficiency.

AI.title_zh: G$^2$WAM：面向高效且几何接地的图像目标导航的世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型能够捕获环境动态并支持用于规划的反事实推理。在图像目标导航中，目标通常位于当前视野之外，智能体不仅必须对环境动态建模，还必须维持对场景的持久空间记忆。现有方法要么通过在目标任务上微调预训练模型来引入空间上下文，这未能充分利用其空间先验；要么依赖外部三维重建，而这对于真实世界部署而言计算代价高昂。在本文中，我们提出用于图像目标导航的几何接地世界动作模型（G$^2$WAM）。G$^2$WAM 通过一个学习到的场景坐标定位模块来编码空间线索，该模块将当前帧、目标帧和历史帧锚定在一个共同参考系中，从而产生稳定且一致的空间上下文，使得无需显式三维重建即可实现高效导航。遵循世界动作模型范式，G$^2$WAM 联合预测未来状态与动作，消除了对昂贵的交叉熵方法（CEM）式规划的需求。此外，G$^2$WAM 完全在潜空间（latent space）中运行，避免了像素级重建的计算负担，并大幅降低了推理成本。在四个轨迹预测基准上，G$^2$WAM 将平均 ATE 和 RPE 分别降低 40.1% 和 35.2%。在闭环导航实验中，它将成功率从 54.0% 提升至 63.0%，并将路径长度加权成功率（SPL）从 36.4% 提升至 59.2%，同时保持高效率。

title: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.

AI.title_zh: 启发式方法尚不足够：面向视频扩散加速的校准与校正缓存
AI.abstract_zh: 特征缓存通过在不同去噪步骤之间复用中间输出，已成为加速视频扩散模型的主流免训练策略。然而，现有的自适应方法依赖于与实际生成质量不匹配的启发式差异度量，采用忽略异质相位动态的单一全局阈值，并且从不将其预算估计与真实近似误差进行验证，从而使系统性偏差得以传播而未被校正。我们提出\textbf{AlignCache}，一个闭环缓存框架，通过三个紧密耦合的组件，将调度决策与其对最终生成视频的真实影响直接对齐：（1）相位自适应预算路由，将去噪轨迹划分为结构上不同的相位，每个相位由独立阈值和感知陈旧性的守卫（staleness-aware guard）控制；（2）闭环阈值校准，利用在无分类器引导输出层面上的反事实误差测量，通过EMA反馈回路在线调整决策边界；以及（3）动量增强的草稿合成，将方向-幅度门控的残差外推与锚点引导的无条件校正相结合。通过将调度从静态风险累积器转变为反馈驱动的自校正控制器，AlignCache在先进的视频生成模型上始终实现更优的加速-质量权衡。我们的代码可在https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache获取。

title: Trust-Calibrated VLA Policy Post-Training with Evolving Imagination
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often pretrained via imitation learning, making reinforcement learning (RL) post-training important when deployment moves beyond demonstration coverage. Existing refinement paradigms expose a reliability--efficiency tension: model-free refinement avoids simulator bias but is interaction-intensive, whereas model-based refinement can exploit unreliable imagination even as its simulator adapts. We propose Model-Evolving Reinforcement Learning (MERL), a trust-calibrated framework that couples policy optimization with an online-updated simulator comprising a world model and a reward proxy head. Across stages, simulator reliability controls the imagined-data ratio and rollout horizon; within rollouts, chunk-level trust controls replay selection and optimization weight. For recursive imagination without exact grounded continuations, a residual predictor estimates trust without querying future ground truth. On perturbed LIBERO-PRO tasks, MERL reaches 79.7% average success, improves high-threshold learning speed by 10.9% over the matched model-free control, and outperforms same-protocol external baselines across three training seeds. Fixed-data adaptation from 50 demonstrations per task achieves 80.0% average success on two physical-robot tasks.

AI.title_zh: 信赖度校准的VLA策略后训练与演进式想象
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action，VLA）模型通常通过模仿学习进行预训练，因此当部署超出示范数据覆盖范围时，强化学习（reinforcement learning，RL）后训练变得十分重要。现有的精炼范式呈现出可靠性与效率之间的张力：无模型精炼避免了模拟器偏差，但交互密集；而基于模型精炼即使在其模拟器不断自适应时，也可能利用不可靠的想象。我们提出模型演进强化学习（Model-Evolving Reinforcement Learning，MERL），这是一个信赖度校准的框架，将策略优化与一个由世界模型和奖励代理头组成的在线更新模拟器相耦合。在不同阶段，模拟器可靠性控制想象数据比例与 rollout 长度；在 rollout 内部，块级信赖度控制回放选择与优化权重。针对无法获得精确有依据延续的递归想象，一个残差预测器在不查询未来真实标签的情况下估计信赖度。在受扰动的 LIBERO-PRO 任务上，MERL 达到 79.7% 的平均成功率，相较匹配的无模型对照组将高阈值学习速度提升 10.9%，并在三个训练随机种子下优于相同协议的外部基线。每任务基于 50 条示范的固定数据适配在两个物理机器人任务上达到 80.0% 的平均成功率。

title: MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-fidelity visuals, yet their outputs still often exhibit physically implausible phenomena, including discontinuous dynamics and implausible event interactions. Existing representation alignment methods mainly transfer generic video features or short-range motion cues, treating physical plausibility as a single-level representation problem. To address this issue, we propose MiMaAlign, a hierarchical micro-macro alignment framework that transfers complementary dynamics-oriented and event-oriented knowledge into different abstraction depths of a pretrained video diffusion model. Specifically, micro-level continuous dynamics alignment imposes constraints by aligning diffusion features with a continuous-time motion representation learned by a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE), while macro-level event-commonsense alignment provides representations of object interactions and event semantics through an instruction-prompted vision-language model (VLM). With training-only auxiliary objectives, we align the complementary supervision from the two teachers with shallower and deeper generator features, respectively, enabling the generator to internalize the corresponding physical priors. Empirical evaluations show that, on CogVideoX-2B, MiMaAlign achieves a relative improvement of up to 21.0% in the Physical Commonsense (PC) score on the VideoPhy benchmark over the baseline, and also delivers substantial gains on the highly challenging VideoPhy2 benchmark, while maintaining general video quality on VBench and being supported by blind user comparisons.

AI.title_zh: MiMaAlign：用于物理上合理的视频生成的层次化微观-宏观对齐
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型在生成高保真视觉内容方面已取得显著进展，但其输出仍常常表现出物理上不合理（physically implausible）的现象，包括不连续的动力学以及不合理的事件交互。现有的表示对齐方法主要迁移通用视频特征或短程运动线索，将物理合理性视为单一层次的表示问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出 MiMaAlign，一种层次化的微观-宏观对齐框架，将互补的面向动力学与面向事件的知识迁移到预训练视频扩散模型的不同抽象深度中。具体而言，微观层面的连续动力学对齐通过将扩散特征与由神经常微分方程（Neural Ordinary Differential Equation，Neural ODE）学习得到的连续时间运动表示进行对齐来施加约束，而宏观层面的事件常识对齐则通过一个指令提示的视觉-语言模型（vision-language model，VLM）提供物体交互与事件语义的表示。借助仅在训练时使用的辅助目标，我们分别将来自这两个教师的互补监督与较浅和较深的生成器特征对齐，使生成器能够内化相应的物理先验。实证评估表明，在 CogVideoX-2B 上，MiMaAlign 在 VideoPhy 基准上的物理常识（Physical Commonsense，PC）分数相较基线实现了最高 21.0% 的相对提升，并且在极具挑战性的 VideoPhy2 基准上也带来了显著增益，同时在 VBench 上保持了通用视频质量，并得到了盲测用户比较的支持。

title: Foresee: Making Procedural Futures Tangible through Generative Previews
summary: Procedural guidance can show users how to act without explaining what an action enables later. We present Foresee, an interface combining next-step guidance with consequence previews, method comparisons, and cross-step access. A hybrid pipeline combines structured rendering, image editing, and video generation. A literature-informed framework and six-participant formative study shaped its design. A 24-participant study compared AR guidance, AR with generated video, and Foresee across digital painting, gameplay, and cocktail making. Exploratory painting comparisons showed higher correct completion without a recorded error than AR and higher post-task quiz accuracy than generated-video guidance under task-wise correction. Interviews revealed that users could overlook valued explanations, match visible outcomes without understanding later possibilities, or wait for concrete demonstrations when symbolic cues were unclear. These findings inform generative previews that explain what actions enable or constrain while supporting ongoing execution.

AI.title_zh: 预见：通过生成式预览使程序性未来变得可感知
AI.abstract_zh: 程序性指导可以向用户展示如何行动，却不解释某一行动在之后能带来什么。我们提出了 Foresee，一种将下一步指导与后果预览、方法比较以及跨步骤访问相结合的界面。一个混合流水线结合了结构化渲染、图像编辑与视频生成。一个基于文献的框架以及一项有六名参与者参与的形成性研究塑造了其设计。一项有 24 名参与者参与的研究在数字绘画、游戏玩法与调制鸡尾酒三种任务中比较了 AR 指导、带生成视频的 AR 以及 Foresee。探索性的绘画比较显示，在未记录错误的情况下，其正确完成率高于 AR；在按任务进行纠正的条件下，其任务后测验准确率高于生成视频指导。访谈揭示，用户可能会忽略有价值的解释，可能会在不理解后续可能性的情况下匹配可见结果，也可能在符号线索不清晰时等待具体演示。这些发现为生成式预览提供了启示，使其能够解释行动所带来的可能或限制，同时支持正在进行的执行。

title: GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at ACM MM 2026 (34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia)
summary: 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.

AI.title_zh: GHOST：用于开放词汇三维场景图生成的几何约束混合扩散
AI.abstract_zh: 三维场景图生成需要理解物体语义与度量空间关系。然而，现有的开放词汇方法往往在空间谓词上表现不佳，因为语言相似度反映的是语义共现，而非显式几何。我们提出GHOST，一种用于开放词汇三维场景图生成（Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion）的几何约束混合扩散框架。GHOST联合建模连续节点几何与离散边谓词，遵循从几何到约束再到谓词的去噪过程，以确保关系预测在几何上保持一致。它引入了基于语言的约束归纳，将谓词嵌入映射为可微的几何约束，用以指导布局细化与谓词重加权。几何-拓扑协同去噪器（Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser）进一步通过噪声自适应交互与朝向感知建模来耦合节点与边推理。在3DSSG上的实验表明，该方法在闭集与开放词汇两种设定下均取得最先进性能，其中在空间谓词上相较RelationField提升超过17个点。

title: CivWorldBench: Evaluating Language World Models in Structured Multi-Agent Sandbox Worlds
summary: The growing use of language models for forecasting motivates a broader evaluation of their world-model capabilities. Such evaluation must go beyond predictive accuracy to assess hidden-state inference and intervention prediction. Real-world forecasting benchmarks offer limited access to hidden-state ground truth and controlled experiments. We introduce CivWorldBench, a benchmark built on a multi-agent strategy game engine with recorded internal states, controlled observations, and paired intervention rollouts. Its 1,900 decision points from 475 worlds support three task levels: association forecasting, belief inference, and intervention prediction. Reference predictors support attributable evaluation of capability gaps, with an expert harness and empirical ceiling estimates contextualizing scores. Stored trajectories make intermediate predictions verifiable, while agent-play experiments test whether world-model capabilities support decision-making. The main panel comprises eleven frontier language models. Composite benchmark scores correlate with real-world forecasting leaderboards on matched model panels, more closely than with a general-capability index, supporting its use as a proxy for real-world forecasting capability. Strong association forecasts do not consistently extend to belief inference or intervention prediction, and effect magnitudes remain poorly calibrated despite informative direction predictions. Process verification reveals errors missed by final-answer evaluation, and structured reasoning improves intervention prediction for the strongest model in the process study. Agent-play experiments identify useful assisted plans and motivate evaluating decision-relevant capabilities beyond association forecasting. These findings identify hidden-state inference, intermediate-state prediction, and effect calibration as priorities for world-model training.

AI.title_zh: CivWorldBench：在结构化多智能体沙盒世界中评估语言世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 语言模型在预测中的日益广泛使用，促使人们对其世界模型能力开展更广泛的评估。此类评估必须超越预测准确性，进而评估隐藏状态推断与干预预测。现实世界的预测基准在获取隐藏状态真值与受控实验方面提供的机会有限。我们推出 CivWorldBench，这是一个构建于多智能体策略游戏引擎之上的基准，带有记录的内部状态、受控观测以及配对的干预推演（rollout）。其来自 475 个世界的 1,900 个决策点支持三个任务层级：关联预测、信念推断与干预预测。参考预测器支持对能力差距进行可归因评估，并配有专家测试框架（expert harness）与经验上限估计来为分数提供背景。存储的轨迹使中间预测可被验证，而智能体对局（agent-play）实验则检验世界模型能力是否支持决策。主面板由十一个前沿语言模型组成。在匹配的模型面板上，综合基准分数与现实世界预测排行榜的相关性高于与通用能力指数的相关性，这支持其作为现实世界预测能力代理指标的用途。较强的关联预测并不能一致地延伸至信念推断或干预预测，且尽管方向性预测具有信息量，效应量级仍校准不佳。过程验证揭示了最终答案评估所遗漏的错误，而在过程研究中，结构化推理改善了最强模型的干预预测。智能体对局实验识别出有用的辅助计划，并激励人们评估超越关联预测的、与决策相关的能力。这些发现将隐藏状态推断、中间状态预测与效应校准确定为世界模型训练的重点。

title: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
summary: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density.
