To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.

AI.title_zh: 用于免训练扩散加速的 Tikhonov 稳定化 Bezier 表示预测
AI.abstract_zh: 扩散模型，尤其是 Diffusion Transformers，能够实现很强的图像与视频生成质量，但由于反复进行去噪器评估，其推理代价依然高昂。特征缓存通过复用或预测中间表示，在不重新训练生成器、也不修改采样器的情况下，提供了一种便于部署的加速策略。然而，现有的“先缓存再预测”（cache-then-forecast）方法往往依赖 Taylor 型有限差分外推，在较长缓存区间上可能变得不稳定，并且通常预测局部模块输出，其误差可能通过后续的去噪器模块逐步累积。我们提出 \textbf{BeziCast}，一个免训练的扩散加速框架，利用低阶 B'ezier 轨迹来预测靠近输出的去噪表示。BeziCast 通过 Tikhonov 稳定化拟合来估计 B'ezier 控制点，提供了一种平滑、容量受控的时间参数化，避免了显式的高阶导数估计，并将轨迹容量与缓存查询密度解耦。为缓和激进外推，我们进一步推导出等价预测权重，并引入一种受凸包启发的防护机制，用于检测高风险预测并将其柔和地拉向保守的单纯形投影估计。在先进图像与视频扩散模型上的大量评估证明了 BeziCast 的有效性。特别是，BeziCast 将 FLUX.1 加速最高达 (4.79\times)，将 HunyuanVideo 加速最高达 (4.11\times)，同时相比竞争性加速基线显著更好地保持了生成质量。

title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
summary: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.

AI.title_zh: RAP-WAM：通过预测性排练与动作扰动学习世界-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 近期的世界动作模型（world action models）借助视频生成先验，联合预测未来观测与机器人动作。将这些先验适配到控制任务时，需要确定未来预测应如何引导策略学习。RAP-WAM 将预测性排练与动作扰动（predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations, RAP）与未来监督查询（future-supervised queries）以及耦合动作投影（Coupled Action Projection）相结合，用于策略学习。预测性排练在模型生成的输入上进行训练，同时保留记录的目标，并将反复出现的误差累积为空间先验。我们对动作施加扰动，并测量视频预测中的变化。基于动作响应的时空信用分配（action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment）将这些响应、预测误差和排练先验结合起来，以分配视觉监督；对响应进行空间聚合则确定未来动作步骤上的监督强度。无需单独的评分网络或部署时的探针。该基础模型从视频预训练主干网络学习，而无需在外部具身数据上进行中间预训练。我们评估了固定的基础模型及其经智能体精炼、以任务为条件的系统。在 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上，它们的平均成功率分别为 12.85% 和 15.62%，Score 分别为 17.86 和 20.59。在 15 个真实机器人任务中，完整系统实现了 89.00% 的任务宏平均成功率，超过五个基线中最强者 37.67 个百分点。在 315 个固定输出仿真窗口中，45.21% 的 response-top20 位置落在 error-top20 之外，揭示了超出预测误差的信息。

title: World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models
summary: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

AI.title_zh: 世界模型需要一个物理注册表：为物理上合理的世界模型学习内部预测状态
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型必须生成物理上合理的未来，而不仅仅是逼真的帧。现有方法通常使用语义、物理或预测信息来引导视觉生成流，但这留下了一个根本性问题：对场景演化的预测应当位于生成器内部的何处？标准视频 token 联合编码外观与动态，但没有提供用于学习和读取预测动态的独立状态。我们以物理注册表（Physical Registry）回答这一问题：视频 DiT 内部具有时间基础的注册表槽位，它们由以观测为条件的预测初始化，与视频 token 共同演化，并接受未来表征监督，从而使预测动态成为生成器一个显式、可读取的状态。在 Physics-IQ Verified 上对预测状态接口进行的受控比较中，物理注册表在 I2V/V2V 上相较原始微调提升了 9.9/8.7 个点，是我们所比较的接口中提升最大的。在所有 Cosmos 与 WAN 主干网络上，物理注册表都提升了 Physics-IQ Verified 分数。仅增加 0.45% 的参数，它就使 Cosmos 3 Nano 16B 超过了 Cosmos 3 Super 64B 已发表的 I2V 分数（43.56 对 42.7）。在 WorldModelBench 上，它也为全部四个被评估的主干网络提升了物理一致性（physical adherence）与总分。由于注册表会变得因候选而异，同时仍保持可读取，物理注册表选择器（Physical Registry Selector, PRS）可以在完整去噪完成之前，依据涌现未来的中间注册表读出与共享预测的偏离程度对其进行排序。在四个主干网络上，这种选择在没有完整视频外部评分的情况下将 I2V 分数提升了 5.6-15.9%。这些结果共同支持一个更广泛的原则：动态预测应当作为一个与视频表征共同演化的显式模型状态存在。项目页面：https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

title: From Sound to Sense: An Anatomy of Semantic Supervision for Speech-Driven Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Speech-driven visual grounding in remote sensing (RSVG) removes the typing bottleneck of text-based interaction and is intended to preserve prosodic intent, enabling hands-free target acquisition in time-critical missions. The direct-audio paradigm, mapping raw speech straight to a bounding box and bypassing automatic speech recognition (ASR), was recently adopted by RSTalker, but what such grounders actually learn about language remains unmeasured. SemEcho grafts a frozen Whisper speech pathway onto a VLTVG grounding host so that speech and text share one decoder, making the paired text, free by construction since speech corpora in this task are synthesized from DIOR-RSVG expressions, a training-time teacher and a fair, same-host text upper bound. On this instrument we dissect three semantic injection channels (feature-mimicry distillation, word-level CTC supervision, and two-stage ASR pretraining) with linear semantic probes, and release Audio-DIOR-R (80,973 training clips; 10 timbres x K=3; Qwen3-TTS synthesis with online sox noise lambda in [0, 0.4]) and Audio-DIOR-Comp, a re-split holding out 17 attribute-category combinations under a 2x2 acoustic-semantic protocol. Our anatomy yields four findings. (i) Whether direct alignment beats a domain-trained ASR cascade is decided by recognizer quality: against a weak in-domain cascade (CTC 0.53) direct wins by 9.0 Acc@0.5 points with transcription errors concentrated on spatial-relation words, but a strong in-domain cascade (CTC 0.029) reaches the text upper bound (80.8 vs. 81.0) and beats even the strongest direct model by 8.8 points; the anti-ASR premise holds only against weak recognizers.

AI.title_zh: 从声音到语义：遥感影像中语音驱动视觉定位的语义监督解构
AI.abstract_zh: 遥感影像中的语音驱动视觉定位（RSVG）消除了基于文本交互的键入瓶颈，旨在保留韵律意图，从而在时间紧迫的任务中实现免手动的目标获取。直接音频范式将原始语音直接映射到边界框并绕过自动语音识别（ASR），最近被 RSTalker 采用，但此类定位器实际学到了关于语言的什么内容仍未被测量。SemEcho 将冻结的 Whisper 语音通路嫁接到 VLTVG 定位宿主上，使语音与文本共享同一个解码器，从而让配对文本——由于该任务中的语音语料库是由 DIOR-RSVG 表达合成的，其配对文本在构造上是免费获得的——成为训练时的教师以及公平的同宿主文本上界。在这一工具上，我们用线性语义探针剖析了三条语义注入通道（特征模仿蒸馏、词级 CTC 监督和两阶段 ASR 预训练），并发布了 Audio-DIOR-R（80,973 个训练片段；10 种音色 × K=3；使用 Qwen3-TTS 合成并施加在线 sox 噪声 λ ∈ [0, 0.4]）与 Audio-DIOR-Comp，后者是在 2×2 声学-语义协议下留出 17 个属性-类别组合的重新划分。我们的解构得出四点发现。(i) 直接对齐是否优于领域训练的 ASR 级联，取决于识别器质量：面对弱域内级联（CTC 0.53），直接方法以 9.0 个 Acc@0.5 百分点胜出，且转写错误集中在空间关系词上；但强域内级联（CTC 0.029）可达到文本上界（80.8 对 81.0），并比最强的直接模型还高出 8.8 个百分点；反 ASR 的前提仅在面对弱识别器时成立。

title: PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. Project page: https://zgca-hmi-lab.github.io/PINT
summary: Generalist robot manipulation can benefit from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for semantic reasoning and video generation models (VGMs) for world modeling. However, existing unified models that directly fuse them through shared attention at multiple layers can make it harder to draw on their specialized capabilities. We introduce PINT, a unified model that coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared chunk-level Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. PINT inserts learnable Intent Tokens into the VLM sequence to form this representation, conditioning both the VGM and an Action Expert (AE). It replaces only the VGM's prompt conditioning and retains the VGM at inference, where the AE reads its representations through one-way attention. Rather than prescribing what Predictive Intent should encode, PINT learns it jointly from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE, which provide complementary views of the same upcoming task execution. Training uses two stages: Stage 1 freezes the VGM so that future video prediction shapes Predictive Intent with task-relevant future dynamics, while Stage 2 fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM and AE. Without embodied pretraining, PINT achieves strong in-distribution (ID) performance and substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, reaching 15.5% on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard compared with 1.8% for Fast-WAM and 3.2% for StarVLA, and 79.5% on LIBERO-Plus compared with 51.5% and 75.0%, respectively. Across five real-world bimanual tasks, PINT reaches 68% ID and 24% OOD success, compared with 35%/9% for pretrained Motus and 67%/35% for pretrained $π_{0.5}$.

AI.title_zh: PINT：一种具有共享预测意图的机器人操作统一模型
AI.abstract_zh: 通用机器人操作可以受益于用于语义推理的预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）以及用于世界建模的视频生成模型（VGM）。然而，现有那些通过在多个层上共享注意力直接将二者融合的统一模型，可能会使其更难利用各自的专门能力。我们提出 PINT，一种统一模型，它通过一个共享的块级预测意图（Predictive Intent）来协调语义推理、世界建模与动作生成，同时保留各专家特有的通路。PINT 将可学习的意图令牌（Intent Tokens）插入 VLM 序列以形成该表示，并以此同时条件化 VGM 和一个动作专家（Action Expert，AE）。它仅替换 VGM 的提示条件化，并在推理时保留 VGM，其中 AE 通过单向注意力读取其表示。PINT 并非预先规定预测意图应当编码什么，而是从 VLM、VGM 和 AE 的原生预测目标中联合学习它，这些目标为同一即将执行的任务提供了互补的视角。训练分为两个阶段：阶段 1 冻结 VGM，使未来视频预测以与任务相关的未来动态来塑造预测意图；阶段 2 固定已学到的意图并适配 VGM 和 AE。在没有具身预训练的情况下，PINT 取得了很强的分布内（ID）性能，并大幅提升了分布外（OOD）泛化能力，在 RoboTwin 2.0-Hard 上达到 15.5%，而 Fast-WAM 为 1.8%、StarVLA 为 3.2%；在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 79.5%，而二者分别为 51.5% 和 75.0%。在五个真实世界双臂任务中，PINT 达到 68% 的 ID 成功率和 24% 的 OOD 成功率，而预训练的 Motus 为 35%/9%，预训练的 $π_{0.5}$ 为 67%/35%。

title: ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning
summary: Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. In addition, it uses stage-aligned verification to localize failures to planning, perception, or reasoning. Dependency-based recovery recomputes only affected states while reusing unaffected ones. Extensive experiments show that ReTAC achieves the highest overall score among the compared methods across three mainstream MLLMs and two widely adopted benchmarks. Further analyses show that gains from additional computation depend not only on how much is used, but also on where it is allocated and which valid intermediate states are preserved.

AI.title_zh: ReTAC：面向视频空间推理的残差测试时智能体计算
AI.abstract_zh: 测试时智能体计算（test-time agentic computation）可以通过规划、工具使用、迭代感知与反思来提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），但不加区分的计算可能重复已完成的工作、引入噪声证据，并扰动正确的预测。我们提出，此类计算应当是残差式的：仅将额外计算分配给基础模型尚未解决的需求，并且在发生局部失败后，仅重新计算受影响的状态。我们在 ReTAC 中实例化了这一构想，ReTAC 是一个用于视频空间推理的免训练多智能体框架。ReTAC 围绕未解决的需求来组织补充计算。它规划有序步骤以获取缺失的空间证据，并将这些观察结果与兼容的原生证据结合以进行推理。此外，它使用与阶段对齐的验证，将失败定位到规划、感知或推理环节。基于依赖关系的恢复仅重新计算受影响的状态，同时复用未受影响的状态。大量实验表明，在三个主流 MLLM 和两个广泛采用的基准上，ReTAC 在所比较的方法中取得了最高的总体得分。进一步的分析表明，额外计算带来的收益不仅取决于使用了多少计算，还取决于计算被分配在何处，以及哪些有效的中间状态被保留下来。

title: RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models
summary: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.

AI.title_zh: RAR：面向时间一致交互式世界模型的速率自适应推演
AI.abstract_zh: 基于视频的交互式世界模型旨在实现实时、用户可控的环境。然而，大多数现有系统都以固定时间速率进行训练与推演，这同时限制了运行时速率自适应能力与物理时域覆盖范围——我们将这一局限称为时间速率耦合。具体而言，当运行时生成吞吐量与所学得的时间速率不一致时，所生成的世界会无意中演化得更慢或更快。此外，使用单一时间速率会在时间粒度与物理时域之间造成固有的权衡：在固定上下文窗口下，更高的速率能捕捉更精细的运动，但覆盖的持续时间更短。为解决这两项局限，我们提出了速率自适应推演（Rate-Adaptive Rollout，RAR），一个使交互式世界模型能够以可控时间速率进行推演的框架。其核心是 Stride-RoPE，它将不同速率下采样的潜在帧对齐到共享的物理时间坐标上，从而实现一致的多速率推演、未见速率泛化，以及在不丢弃历史的情况下进行在线速率切换。同时，RAR 使用多步幅视频采样，实现细粒度动力学与长时域演化的联合学习。在动作控制与相机控制的环境中，RAR 实现了时间一致的多速率推演与在线速率切换，同时保持高速率生成质量，并在匹配的训练预算下扩展物理时域。RAR 还可迁移至预训练世界模型，同时保持感知质量。

title: HeteroVDiff: Pipelining Video Diffusion across Mobile NPU and GPU with Shared Weights
summary: Video generation is moving from the cloud to phones for privacy and offline use, and applications often ask for several clips at a time, so on-device video generation is a throughput problem before it is a latency problem. Contemporary mobile SoCs carry both a GPU and a neural processing unit (NPU) on shared DRAM, yet existing on-device video diffusion systems run the denoiser on one engine while the other sits idle or only decodes the finished latent afterwards. Heterogeneous designs built for mobile LLMs do not carry over: they synchronise the two engines at every operator and partition weight tensors between them instead of sharing one stored copy. We first measure the platform limits that decide what can run on this class of SoC: how large one buffer may be, whether both runtimes can map the same buffer, and how much activation memory the NPU toolchain lets one graph hold. Guided by these measurements, we store the base weights once in INT8 in the layout the NPU reads natively; the GPU consumes the same bytes directly as integer dot-product operands, so neither runtime rearranges weights on load. We then flatten the denoising trajectory into its full sequence of block executions and cut it once at a block boundary, so the GPU runs the prefix and the NPU the suffix. The cut is placed from measured rather than modelled rates, including the decoder that only the NPU can run, and taken while both engines run together because each engine's speed changes when the other is active. We present HeteroVDiff, which serves a multi-expert video diffusion model across the NPU and GPU with 48% less weight memory than giving each engine its own copy. Generating videos back to back on a Galaxy S25 with decoding inside the pipeline, HeteroVDiff sustains 1.35x the stream throughput of NPU-only execution, and on VBench-2.0 it matches FP32 in the total score over all 18 dimensions.

AI.title_zh: HeteroVDiff：跨移动 NPU 与 GPU 的共享权重流水线视频扩散
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成正出于隐私与离线使用的考虑从云端迁移到手机，而应用往往一次请求若干段视频，因此端侧视频生成首先是一个吞吐量问题，其次才是延迟问题。当代移动 SoC 在共享 DRAM 上同时搭载 GPU 和神经网络处理单元（NPU），然而现有的端侧视频扩散系统只在一个引擎上运行去噪器，而另一个引擎处于空闲状态，或仅在之后对已完成的 latent 进行解码。为移动端 LLM 构建的异构设计无法沿用：它们在每一个算子处同步两个引擎，并在两者之间划分权重张量，而不是共享一份存储副本。我们首先测量了决定这类 SoC 上什么可以运行的平台限制：单个缓冲区可以有多大、两个运行时能否映射同一缓冲区，以及 NPU 工具链允许单个图持有多少激活内存。在这些测量的指导下，我们将基础权重以 INT8 只存储一次，并采用 NPU 原生读取的布局；GPU 直接以整数点积操作数的形式消费相同的字节，因此两个运行时在加载时都不需要重排权重。随后，我们将去噪轨迹展平为其完整的块执行序列，并在一个块边界处将其切分一次，使 GPU 运行前缀、NPU 运行后缀。切分点根据实测速率而非建模速率来放置，其中包含只有 NPU 才能运行的解码器，并且是在两个引擎同时运行时确定的，因为每个引擎的速度会在另一个引擎活跃时发生变化。我们提出 HeteroVDiff，它跨 NPU 和 GPU 服务一个多专家视频扩散模型，相比为每个引擎各给一份副本，权重内存减少 48%。在 Galaxy S25 上连续生成视频且解码位于流水线内部时，HeteroVDiff 持续达到仅 NPU 执行流吞吐量的 1.35 倍，并且在 VBench-2.0 上，其在全部 18 个维度上的总分与 FP32 相当。

title: Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding
summary: Visual grounding is a central challenge for GUI agents, requiring an instruction to be mapped to a target within a crowded screenshot. Coordinate generation with single-point supervision reduces a spatially extended target to one position, despite the presence of many valid click locations. Region-based patch scoring alleviates this ambiguity, but its spatial decisions remain tied to visual-token footprints that may span the target, neighboring controls, and background. To address these limitations, we propose Seg2Click, which reformulates GUI grounding as executable-region prediction: identifying where a click can validly execute the given instruction. Using bounding-box supervision, Seg2Click predicts an executable-region mask and computes the final click point through a deterministic rule. This formulation captures the spatial extent of valid click locations and enables finer localization beyond the visual-token grid, making it well suited to small, densely arranged controls without requiring a verifier or zoom-in pass. Experiments across five backbone configurations from two model families demonstrate the effectiveness of Seg2Click. Seg2Click-9B achieves 92.06\%, 94.10\%, and 55.22\% on ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-v2, and ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively, while matched-backbone comparisons show improvements over both coordinate generation and patch-based grounding. Code will be available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click.

AI.title_zh: Seg2Click：为GUI视觉定位学习像素级动作掩码
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉定位是GUI智能体的核心挑战，它要求将一条指令映射到拥挤截图中的目标上。以单点监督进行的坐标生成将一个空间上延展的目标缩减为一个位置，尽管存在许多有效的点击位置。基于区域的图块评分缓解了这种歧义，但其空间决策仍受限于可能跨越目标、相邻控件和背景的视觉词元（visual token）覆盖范围。为解决这些局限，我们提出Seg2Click，它将GUI定位重新表述为可执行区域预测：识别在何处点击能够有效执行给定指令。利用边界框监督，Seg2Click预测一个可执行区域掩码，并通过确定性规则计算最终点击点。这一表述捕捉了有效点击位置的空间范围，并能够实现超越视觉词元网格的更精细定位，使其非常适合小型、密集排列的控件，且无需验证器或放大（zoom-in）过程。在来自两个模型家族的五个主干配置上进行的实验证明了Seg2Click的有效性。Seg2Click-9B在ScreenSpot、ScreenSpot-v2和ScreenSpot-Pro上分别达到92.06%、94.10%和55.22%，而同主干对比显示其相较坐标生成和基于图块的定位均有改进。代码将发布于 https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click 。

title: VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation
summary: Autoencoders are the core component of latent video generative models, compressing high-dimensional videos into compact latent spaces for downstream generation. However, existing video autoencoders are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, providing limited supervision for learning structured latent representations. We argue that videos should not be treated merely as signals to be reconstructed, but rather as 2D projections of dynamic 3D worlds that exhibit explicit and well-structured geometric properties. Building on this insight, we propose \textbf{V}ideo \textbf{G}eometry \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{A}utoencoder (\textbf{VGGA}), a geometry-aware video autoencoder that explicitly incorporates geometric constraints into the reconstruction process. Specifically, VGGA grounds the learned representations along three complementary geometric dimensions: \emph{Structural Depth}, \emph{Motion Correspondence}, and \emph{Projective Warping}. These objectives are unified within a Video Geometry Decoder, which employs a shared spatio-temporal upsampling trunk to jointly optimize geometric learning and RGB reconstruction. Through these geometry-grounded objectives, VGGA encourages the latent representations to capture the underlying 3D structure and motion of dynamic scenes. VGGA consistently improves video generation across both geometry-centric and human-motion domains, reducing gFVD by 28.1\% on RealEstate10K and 37.7\% on Taichi-HD. Notably, these substantial generation improvements are achieved while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, demonstrating that geometry-grounded representation learning yields a more effective latent space for video generation.

AI.title_zh: VGGA：面向视频生成的几何接地自编码器
AI.abstract_zh: 自编码器是潜在视频生成模型的核心组件，将高维视频压缩为紧凑的潜在空间以供下游生成使用。然而，现有的视频自编码器主要针对像素级重建进行优化，为学习结构化的潜在表示提供的监督有限。我们认为，视频不应仅仅被视为待重建的信号，而应被视为动态3D世界的2D投影，其呈现出显式且结构良好的几何属性。基于这一洞见，我们提出了\textbf{V}ideo \textbf{G}eometry \textbf{G}rounded \textbf{A}utoencoder（\textbf{VGGA}），一种几何感知的视频自编码器，将几何约束显式地纳入重建过程。具体而言，VGGA 沿三个互补的几何维度对所学习的表示进行接地：\emph{结构深度}（Structural Depth）、\emph{运动对应}（Motion Correspondence）和\emph{投影变形}（Projective Warping）。这些目标被统一在一个视频几何解码器（Video Geometry Decoder）中，该解码器采用共享的时空上采样主干，联合优化几何学习与RGB重建。通过这些几何接地的目标，VGGA 促使潜在表示捕捉动态场景底层的3D结构与运动。VGGA 在几何中心领域和人体运动领域均持续提升视频生成效果，在 RealEstate10K 上将 gFVD 降低 28.1\%，在 Taichi-HD 上降低 37.7\%。值得注意的是，这些显著的生成改进是在保持可比重建质量的同时实现的，表明几何接地的表示学习能够为视频生成产生更有效的潜在空间。

title: EgoAlign: Situated 3D Understanding without Situation Descriptions
summary: Situated 3D Question Answering requires models to interpret a 3D scene relative to an agent's pose. Existing methods commonly convey that pose through a natural-language situation description, which may be unavailable or costly to obtain in real-world deployments. While some methods additionally incorporate numerical pose, we find that randomly shuffling the agent pose causes little performance degradation, indicating limited functional dependence on the numerical pose. To address this gap, we introduce EgoAlign, a simple 3D language model that represents a scene in an agent-centric coordinate frame, together with a dedicated egocentric alignment stage comprising four complementary tasks: object category recognition, egocentric direction prediction, metric distance estimation, and spatial relation prediction. This stage teaches the model to consistently interpret scene geometry relative to the agent's pose before task-specific fine-tuning. EgoAlign achieves the strongest performance on SQA3D, Real-3DQA, and MSQA among compared methods while remaining highly efficient. More importantly, removing textual situation descriptions yields comparable or better downstream performance, whereas shuffling EgoAlign's numerical pose causes substantial degradation. These results show that EgoAlign establishes agent-centric spatial context directly from numerical pose without requiring textual situation descriptions.

AI.title_zh: EgoAlign：无需情境描述的具身3D理解
AI.abstract_zh: 情境化 3D 问答（Situated 3D Question Answering）要求模型相对于智能体的位姿来理解 3D 场景。现有方法通常通过自然语言情境描述来传达该位姿，而在真实世界部署中，这种描述可能无法获得或获取成本高昂。尽管一些方法额外引入了数值位姿，但我们发现随机打乱智能体位姿仅导致很小的性能下降，这表明模型对数值位姿的功能性依赖有限。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了 EgoAlign，一个简单的 3D 语言模型，它以智能体为中心的坐标系来表示场景，并配有一个专门的自我中心对齐阶段，该阶段包含四项互补任务：物体类别识别、自我中心方向预测、度量距离估计和空间关系预测。该阶段教会模型在任务特定微调之前，一致地相对于智能体位姿理解场景几何。在所比较的方法中，EgoAlign 在 SQA3D、Real-3DQA 和 MSQA 上取得了最强性能，同时保持高效。更重要的是，移除文本情境描述后，下游性能相当或更好，而打乱 EgoAlign 的数值位姿则会导致显著性能下降。这些结果表明，EgoAlign 直接根据数值位姿建立以智能体为中心的空间上下文，而无需文本情境描述。

title: Geometric Parrots: Rule Absence vs. Rule Fragility in Spatial and Physical Reasoning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer many geometric and physical reasoning questions correctly, yet still behave inconsistently in interaction, for example, abandoning a correct answer when confronted with a confident but incorrect user assertion. Standard single-turn accuracy cannot distinguish such capitulations from beneficial corrections because it scores each response in isolation. We introduce GRIP, a controlled benchmark with 34 procedurally generated reasoning domains, 100,000 images, and 600,000 questions spanning geometric, spatial, visual, and physical reasoning. Each scene is generated by deterministic code, and every answer is derived directly from the underlying scene state, providing exact ground truth without human annotation. On GRIP, we propose Dual-Loop Evaluation. A closed loop probes each image with a five-step compositional question ladder to localize where reasoning fails. An open loop then re-elicits the model's answer under controlled challenges, including peer-model responses and unsupported user assertions. Because ground truth is known exactly, answer changes can be signed as corrections (wrong-to-right) or capitulations (right-to-wrong), separating two failure modes: rule absence and rule fragility. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bilaljawaid980/GRIP-Benchmark, with further details at https://bilaljawaid980.github.io/grip-benchmark/.

AI.title_zh: 几何鹦鹉：视觉语言模型在空间与物理推理中的规则缺失与规则脆弱性
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够正确回答许多几何与物理推理问题，但在交互中仍会表现得不一致，例如在面对一个自信但错误的用户断言时放弃正确答案。标准的单轮准确率无法区分这类屈服与有益的纠正，因为它对每个回答单独评分。我们提出 GRIP，一个受控基准，包含 34 个程序化生成的推理领域、100,000 张图像和 600,000 个问题，涵盖几何、空间、视觉和物理推理。每个场景由确定性代码生成，每个答案直接源自底层场景状态，从而提供无需人工标注的精确真值。在 GRIP 上，我们提出双环评估（Dual-Loop Evaluation）。闭环以五步组合式问题阶梯探查每张图像，以定位推理失败之处。开环随后在受控挑战下重新引出模型的答案，这些挑战包括同级模型的回答以及无依据的用户断言。由于真值完全已知，答案变化可被标记为纠正（错到对）或屈服（对到错），从而区分两种失败模式：规则缺失与规则脆弱性。数据集可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/bilaljawaid980/GRIP-Benchmark 获取，更多细节见 https://bilaljawaid980.github.io/grip-benchmark/。

title: Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction
summary: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES.

AI.title_zh: 移动固体交互下的交互式4D体积液体预测
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了交互式4D体积液体预测（Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting）这一任务：在给定固体物体如何在其内部运动作为条件的情况下，预测未来稠密3D液体速度场的时空演化。该任务为需要对运动条件下的液体响应进行推理的系统提供了一个上游物理预测原语，包括机器人液体操控、数字孪生以及刚体-流体视频生成。现有工作在预测静态或预设固体几何周围的流动以及合成视觉上合理的流体运动方面已做出努力。然而，这些方法对交互式液体动力学的覆盖有限，因为它们无法预测运动固体如何引发未来全域液体响应。在该预测场景中，流体动力学效应集中在不断演化的液-固界面附近，但预测目标却是全局的时空推演。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个两级循环预测框架TIDE/TIDES：TIDE隔离出局部化的界面驱动预测，而TIDES则加入输运感知耦合与显式稳定化，以减少推演过程中累积的误差。在适配的邻近基线、受控组件消融、运动/尺寸分布外（OOD）测试以及长时程评估中，TIDES取得了最佳预测性能，且消融实验确认局部化交互、输运耦合与稳定化是关键贡献因素。总之，我们的任务表述、基准以及TIDE/TIDES研究为移动固体条件下的稠密液体预测建立了受控的基础。代码公开于https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES。

title: Esports World Model Dataset
summary: Interactive world models must capture how multiple participants jointly change a shared environment while observing different parts of it. Competitive games make this challenge concrete: players cooperate and compete, while fog of war, team vision and camera placement determine what each can see. Modeling these interactions requires data that connect individual observations and actions to shared state and events. We introduce the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a collection of human gameplay spanning StarCraft II, Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2, with 3,053 games and maps and approximately 4,880 player-view hours, including estimated hours for the ongoing CS2 extension. It includes 4,628 completed StarCraft II views, all ten perspectives for 303 Dota 2 matches, and up to ten views per round in CS2. Across these views, replay-clock alignment connects rendered video with game-native actions, structured state and events from the same match. The three games expose complementary observation conditions: private fog of war, shared team vision and first-person viewpoints. In StarCraft II, player-specific entity records further distinguish live observations from remembered snapshots and link co-observed entities across opposing views. Together with temporal alignment, these records allow researchers to distinguish legitimate information differences from disagreement about shared state. By connecting human decisions, shared dynamics and player-specific information, EWM supports research toward jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments populated by teammates and opponents learned from human play.

AI.title_zh: 电子竞技世界模型数据集
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式世界模型必须刻画多个参与者在观察共享环境的不同部分时，如何共同改变这一共享环境。竞技类游戏使这一挑战具体化：玩家既合作又竞争，而战争迷雾、团队视野和镜头位置决定了每一方能看到什么。对这类交互进行建模，需要将个体观察与动作同共享状态与事件连接起来的数据。我们提出了电子竞技世界模型数据集（Esports World Model Dataset，EWM），这是一个涵盖《星际争霸 II》、《Dota 2》和《反恐精英 2》的人类游戏玩法集合，包含 3,053 局游戏与地图、约 4,880 玩家视角小时，其中还包括对正在进行的 CS2 扩展部分的估算小时数。它包含 4,628 个已完成的《星际争霸 II》视角、303 场《Dota 2》比赛的全部十个视角，以及 CS2 中每回合最多十个视角。在这些视角之间，回放时钟对齐将渲染视频与来自同一场比赛的游戏原生动作、结构化状态和事件连接起来。这三款游戏呈现出互补的观察条件：私有战争迷雾、共享团队视野以及第一人称视角。在《星际争霸 II》中，针对具体玩家的实体记录进一步区分实时观察与记忆快照，并跨对立视角链接被共同观察到的实体。结合时间对齐，这些记录使研究者能够区分合法的信息差异与关于共享状态的分歧。通过连接人类决策、共享动态和玩家特定信息，EWM 为迈向联合控制的多玩家世界模型，以及由从人类游戏中学习到的队友和对手所构成的交互式环境的研究提供支持。

title: Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image
summary: We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. Every edit is verified before being incorporated into the reconstruction. This process gradually turns occluded parts of the scene into direct observation, allowing objects to be reconstructed when they are best exposed rather than hallucinated from the original image alone. The scene is then rebuilt in reverse removal order, so that the supporting objects are naturally placed before the objects they support. Since a single-view image only reveals part of an object, we treat the observed points as a lower bound on its size: an asset may grow to cover its points, but can not shrink away from them. Finally, we physically settle the reconstructed scene to remove floating objects and interpenetrations, followed by an agentic audit that corrects remaining placement errors. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor scenes show that Unravel recovers more objects, places them more faithfully, and produces scenes that are more physically-plausible than existing methods.

AI.title_zh: Unravel：从单张图像中恢复交互式三维场景
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Unravel，一个无需训练的框架，可将单张图像转换为交互式三维场景，其中每个物体都是独立且可移动的资产。现有的生成器要么生成一个无法移动任何物体的纠缠几何体，要么在一次前馈过程中预测所有物体，而其中错误的猜测无法被检测或修复。Unravel 则采取了不同的方法：它首先将场景拆解，然后再重新组装。从输入图像出发，一个智能体式（agentic）的编排框架迭代地逐层剥离图像，并采用点云作为恢复空间关系的主要模态。具体而言，一个视觉-语言模型规划哪些物体是完全可见的，一个图像编辑器将它们移除并恢复被遮挡的区域。每一次编辑在被纳入重建之前都会被验证。这一过程逐渐将场景中被遮挡的部分转变为直接观测，使得物体能够在暴露最充分时被重建，而不是仅凭原始图像被幻觉生成出来。随后场景按相反的移除顺序重建，从而使支撑物体自然地先于它们所支撑的物体被放置。由于单视图图像只揭示物体的部分信息，我们将观测到的点视为其尺寸的下界：一个资产可以扩展以覆盖其点，但不能收缩而偏离这些点。最后，我们对重建的场景进行物理沉降，以移除悬浮物体和相互穿插，随后进行智能体式审计以纠正剩余的放置错误。在多样化的室内场景上的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，Unravel 能恢复更多物体、更忠实地放置它们，并生成物理上更合理的场景。

title: Directional Pullback Regularization for Long-Horizon Rollout of Latent World Models in Autonomous Driving
summary: Learned world models for autonomous driving operate in unconstrained latent spaces, yet the physical systems they represent are governed by strict non-holonomic constraints: ground vehicles cannot realize instantaneous pure lateral motion. We study long-horizon latent rollout modeling for autonomous driving and ask whether rollout quality can be improved by assigning a motion-aware geometry to latent transitions, rather than by redesigning the predictor architecture. Starting from an unconstrained latent rollout baseline, we introduce Directional Pullback Regularization (DPR), a training time method that defines a kinematics-aware anisotropic Riemannian metric in decoded state space and pulls it back through the decoder Jacobian to the latent manifold. The resulting latent-space metric assigns higher cost to latent directions that decode to lateral vehicle motion, while preserving the original encoder-dynamics-decoder backbone. This yields a clean three-way comparison among an Unconstrained Latent Rollout model (ULR), an Euclidean Pullback Regularization ablation (EPR), and the full directional method (DPR). We evaluate all models on open-loop ego-motion rollout over a common 10-second test horizon, using training rollout lengths of 1, 3, 5, and 10 steps. Across all four training regimes, DPR achieves lower 10-second final displacement error than both ULR and EPR. The strongest relative accuracy gain appears for models trained with 3-step rollout supervision, where DPR reduces the 10-second final displacement error by approximately 44 percent relative to ULR. The strongest overall control-relevant tradeoff is obtained for longer rollout-trained models, especially at 10 steps, where DPR simultaneously improves displacement error, lateral motion consistency, and forward motion preservation relative to both ULR and EPR.

AI.title_zh: 面向自动驾驶中潜在世界模型长时程推演的定向拉回正则化
AI.abstract_zh: 用于自动驾驶的学习型世界模型在无约束的潜在空间中运行，然而其所表示的物理系统受严格的非完整约束支配：地面车辆无法实现瞬时的纯横向运动。我们研究面向自动驾驶的长时程潜在推演建模，并追问：能否通过为潜在状态转移赋予一种运动感知的几何结构，而非通过重新设计预测器架构，来提升推演质量。从一个无约束潜在推演基线出发，我们提出定向拉回正则化（Directional Pullback Regularization, DPR），这是一种训练时方法，它在解码后的状态空间中定义一种运动学感知的各向异性黎曼度量，并通过解码器雅可比将其拉回至潜在流形。由此得到的潜在空间度量对解码为车辆横向运动的潜在方向赋予更高的代价，同时保留原有的编码器-动力学-解码器主干。这产生了一个清晰的三方比较：无约束潜在推演模型（ULR）、欧几里得拉回正则化消融（EPR）以及完整的方向性方法（DPR）。我们在共同的10秒测试时域上，对所有模型进行开环自运动推演评估，训练推演长度分别为1、3、5和10步。在所有四种训练设置下，DPR均比ULR和EPR取得更低的10秒最终位移误差。最强的相对精度提升出现在以3步推演监督训练的模型上，其中DPR相对于ULR将10秒最终位移误差降低约44%。最强的整体控制相关权衡出现在以更长推演长度训练的模型上，尤其是在10步时，DPR相对于ULR和EPR同时改善了位移误差、横向运动一致性和前向运动保持。

title: Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.

AI.title_zh: 频率-步进缓存：为高效自回归视频扩散分离同步与修复
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归（AR）视频生成能够实现长时程合成，但需要对大型扩散 Transformer 反复进行前向传播。免训练缓存通过复用中间计算来降低这一成本，然而现有控制器往往将两个决策耦合在一起：何时对缓存进行精确同步，以及在两次同步之间修复多少计算。我们提出频率-步进缓存（Frequency-Step Cache, FSC），将这两种角色分离。FSC 在由密到疏的轨迹上调度精确的全计算锚点，而一个基于频率分辨漂移与 token 年龄的轻量级潜空间风险则通过整步重放、选择性 token 重计算或完全修复来控制锚点之间的修复。在 SkyReels-V2 上，整步复用提供了大部分加速，而选择性 token 计算作为保真度修复最为有效。一项受控消融表明，在相同延迟下，将单一反应式信号同时用于同步与修复会降低保真度，并且在 FramePack 和 Matrix-Game 上观察到同样的分离优势。在多个自回归视频主干网络上，FSC 改善了速度-质量权衡。在 SkyReels-V2 上，FSC-Speed 达到 2.36 倍加速，而 MotionCache 为 2.275 倍，同时 SSIM 提升 0.019、PSNR 提升 0.5 dB。在与 MotionCache 匹配的速度下，FSC-Quality 将 SSIM 提升 0.031、PSNR 提升 1.0 dB，并将 LPIPS 降低 0.024。无需重新调参，FSC-Quality 即可迁移到 SkyReels-V2 14B，达到 2.12 倍加速，而 MotionCache 为 1.79 倍。

title: Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Shuai Li and Jinxu Xiang contributed equally; Ran Zhang is the corresponding author
summary: We present Gen Through the Lens, a camera-controllable image-to-video generation framework that synthesizes videos from a given reference image while enabling realistic and physically consistent camera operations. Unlike previous models that treat camera motion as abstract conditioning or rely on a single coordinate system, our approach explicitly decomposes and fuses control signals across three coordinate spaces: the camera coordinate (modeled by intrinsic parameters), the world coordinate (represented by spatial geometry hints), and the object coordinate (described by 3D bounding boxes of target subjects). Through cross-coordinate conditioning fusion, these heterogeneous cues are unified to guide the generative process, enabling precise control of camera motion, focus, and framing while preserving temporal and spatial coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces controllable and visually consistent results across diverse camera operations, outperforming existing approaches in both realism and editability.

AI.title_zh: 透过镜头生成：基于跨坐标条件融合的相机可控视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了“透过镜头生成”（Gen Through the Lens），一个相机可控的图像到视频生成框架，它能够根据给定的参考图像合成视频，同时支持真实且物理一致的相机操作。与以往将相机运动视为抽象条件或依赖单一坐标系的模型不同，我们的方法显式地在三个坐标空间中分解并融合控制信号：相机坐标（由内参建模）、世界坐标（由空间几何提示表示）以及物体坐标（由目标主体的3D边界框描述）。通过跨坐标条件融合，这些异构线索被统一起来以引导生成过程，从而在保持时间与空间连贯性的同时，实现对相机运动、对焦和取景的精确控制。大量实验表明，我们的方法在多种相机操作下都能产生可控且视觉一致的结果，在真实感和可编辑性上均优于现有方法。

title: Sharper Frames, Worse Rooms: Viewpoint Coverage Dominates Image Quality in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Grounded spatial reasoning about indoor scenes rests on a geometric reconstruction that the multimodal system does not itself produce. Feed-forward multi-view reconstruction models operate under a fixed view budget, making frame selection a critical upstream decision. We show that under this setting the conventional preference for sharp frames can be actively harmful. Across nine handheld room scans, selecting the sharpest 16 of 200 candidate frames is the worst strategy we test, reaching 48\% room dimension error where uniform temporal sampling reaches 3\%. We trace this failure to a coupling between image quality and camera motion: sharp frames tend to occur during slow motion and therefore concentrate the selection in a narrow angular region, leaving $192^\circ$ of the room unobserved in the case we illustrate and over $300^\circ$ in the worst cells. A $2\times2$ factorial experiment that independently manipulates viewpoint spread and per-frame sharpness shows that spread has roughly three times the main effect of quality, and that blurry but well spread selections outperform sharp but clustered selections in 8 of 9 captures. The advantage also diminishes as the frame budget increases and angular coverage saturates, consistent with this mechanism. Finally, we ask whether the failure is detectable at inference: the reconstruction model's multi-view consistency score increases with reconstruction error, while a vision-language model given the same frames reports confidence unrelated to its own spatial estimation error. Under small view budgets, viewpoint coverage is a more important constraint than per-frame image quality, and neither uncertainty signal available at inference reveals this upstream failure.

AI.title_zh: 更清晰的帧，更差的房间：在前馈式三维重建中，视角覆盖主导图像质量
AI.abstract_zh: 关于室内场景的具身空间推理，建立于多模态系统自身并不生成的几何重建之上。前馈式多视角重建模型在固定的视角预算下运行，这使得帧选择成为一个关键的上游决策。我们表明，在此设定下，对清晰帧的惯常偏好可能反而有害。在九个手持式房间扫描中，从 200 个候选帧中选取最清晰的 16 帧是我们测试的最差策略，其房间尺寸误差达到 48\%，而均匀时间采样仅达到 3\%。我们将这一失败归因于图像质量与相机运动之间的耦合：清晰帧往往出现在缓慢运动期间，因此使所选帧集中在狭窄的角度区域内，在我们展示的案例中留下 $192^\circ$ 的房间未被观测，在最差单元中则超过 $300^\circ$。一项独立操纵视角分布与单帧清晰度的 $2\times2$ 析因实验表明，视角分布的主效应大约是三倍于质量的主效应，并且在 9 次采集中的 8 次里，模糊但分布良好的选择优于清晰但聚集的选择。随着帧预算增加以及角度覆盖饱和，这一优势也随之减弱，这与该机制一致。最后，我们追问这一失败在推理时是否可被检测：重建模型的多视角一致性得分随重建误差上升，而一个获得相同帧的视觉-语言模型所报告的置信度与其自身的空间估计误差无关。在较小的视角预算下，视角覆盖是比单帧图像质量更重要的约束，而推理时可获得的两种不确定性信号都无法揭示这一上游失败。

title: Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation
summary: Generating coherent videos grounded in a unified underlying world remains a major challenge, particularly under large viewpoint changes, where existing methods often struggle to maintain stable representations of individual objects. To this end, we introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem first represents each selected object as a persistent 3D memory aligned to a shared world frame, assigning it a dedicated state. Based on these memories, we design a dual-stream 3D conditioning architecture that combines object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis. Moreover, these object memories constrain the model's attention with 3D structural information, thereby preserving object surfaces and relative spatial layouts. Extensive experiments on world-generation and object-centric benchmarks demonstrate that Totem generates videos depicting a more object-consistent 3D world under challenging camera trajectories, while supporting versatile applications.

AI.title_zh: Totem：面向世界一致视频生成的以对象为中心的3D记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 生成以统一底层世界为基础的一致视频仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在大视角变化下，现有方法往往难以维持对单个物体的稳定表示。为此，我们提出了 Totem，一个面向世界一致视频生成的以对象为中心的3D记忆框架。Totem 首先将每个选定的物体表示为对齐到共享世界坐标系的持久3D记忆，并为其分配专门的状态。基于这些记忆，我们设计了一种双流3D条件化架构，将物体记忆与场景几何相结合以进行目标视角合成。此外，这些物体记忆以3D结构信息约束模型的注意力，从而保持物体表面与相对空间布局。在世界生成和以对象为中心的基准上的大量实验表明，Totem 在具有挑战性的相机轨迹下生成的视频描绘了物体一致性更高的3D世界，同时支持多种应用。

title: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
summary: Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.

AI.title_zh: 面向导航的以数据为中心的递归自我改进：通过策略同步的语言-动作双重自举
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉语言导航要求智能体遵循自然语言指令到达目标位置，因此高质量的语言监督至关重要。由于人工标注成本高昂，先前工作已探索了可扩展的数据合成方法。然而，现有方法通常要么为导航和指令生成使用单独的模型，要么通过任务特定组件将两个任务耦合；大多数方法还会在更新之前用固定模型标注整个轨迹语料库，这可能导致生成的监督滞后于不断演化的策略。因此，我们提出 RSI-Nav，一个面向导航的以数据为中心的递归自我改进框架，通过策略同步的语言-动作双重自举，在共享模型中统一了视觉-语言到动作的指令遵循与视觉-动作到语言的指令生成。具体而言，在监督微调建立基本能力之后，RSI-Nav 以小分片方式逐步处理无标注轨迹。当前模型为这些轨迹生成指令，执行这些指令以评估目标完成情况和路径效率，保留合格样本，并在处理下一分片之前立即更新自身。这种逐分片更新使新生成的监督与不断演化的策略保持一致。我们还引入了空间理解数据，因为更强的空间推理有益于导航。大量实验表明，RSI-Nav 在 R2R-CE 上达到 68.6% SR，在 RxR-CE 上达到 72.4% SR，同时在递归演化后提供了更强的指令生成效用，并适度提升了空间理解能力。

title: SurgCast: Action-Conditioned Future Skeletons for Controllable Surgical World Models
summary: Surgical world models must turn prospective robot actions into visually faithful, structurally consistent instrument motion. We introduce SurgCast, which predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses the forecast to control video generation. Dual-path injection combines skeleton geometry with derived, instrument-specific motion descriptors through geometric residuals and conditioning modulation. Both paths complement native action conditioning and are retained in a four-step causal student. On SutureBot and SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, the teacher and student improve all seven reported quality and instrument-consistency metrics over their respective direct-action baselines; teacher FVD decreases by 37.6% and 67.3%. Ablations show that future actions improve skeleton prediction and that combining both injection paths performs best across all six metrics under predicted skeletons. These results support using predicted articulated structure and its motion semantics as a control interface for surgical video prediction. Project videos and examples are available at https://surgcast.netlify.app/.

AI.title_zh: SurgCast：用于可控手术世界模型的以动作为条件的未来骨架
AI.abstract_zh: 手术世界模型必须将预期中的机器人动作转化为视觉上逼真、结构上一致的器械运动。我们提出 SurgCast，它根据当前结构、机器人状态和未来动作预测未来的器械骨架，然后利用该预测来控制视频生成。双路径注入通过几何残差和条件调制，将骨架几何与导出的、器械特定的运动描述符相结合。两条路径均对原生动作条件形成补充，并被保留在一个四步因果学生模型中。在 SutureBot 和 SRTH-Porcine-Cholei 上，教师模型和学生模型在全部七项所报告的质量与器械一致性指标上均优于各自直接以动作为条件的基线；教师模型的 FVD 分别下降 37.6% 和 67.3%。消融实验表明，未来动作能改进骨架预测，并且在预测骨架下，结合两条注入路径在全部六项指标上表现最佳。这些结果支持将预测得到的关节结构及其运动语义用作手术视频预测的控制接口。项目视频和示例见 https://surgcast.netlify.app/。

title: StreamingWAM: Streaming World Action Modeling via Chunk-Wise Staircase Flow Matching
summary: World Action Models (WAMs), often built upon pretrained video-generation world models, have emerged as a promising framework for general-purpose and open-ended robot control. However, their real-world deployment often suffers from discontinuous and jerky execution. Existing methods typically address this issue by either improving inference efficiency or enhancing action continuity across prediction chunks, without jointly addressing both challenges. To bridge this gap, we propose StreamingWAM, a streaming-diffusion framework for WAM-based robot control. StreamingWAM combines a noise ladder for chunk-wise action prediction, a prefix rollout module for cross-chunk continuity, and dense video-history memory for temporally consistent conditioning. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that StreamingWAM improves action continuity across static and dynamic settings, achieving competitive performance while reducing steady-state replanning latency to 72.9 ms in simulation and 57.3 ms on the real robot. The method also produces smoother action transitions, while the streaming staircase reduces sensitivity to the execution horizon K.

AI.title_zh: StreamingWAM：基于分块阶梯流匹配的流式世界动作建模
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型（World Action Models，WAMs）通常构建于预训练的视频生成世界模型之上，已成为一种有望用于通用且开放式机器人控制的框架。然而，其在真实世界部署中常常面临不连续且抖动（jerky）的执行问题。现有方法通常通过提升推理效率或增强预测块之间的动作连续性来应对该问题，但未能同时解决这两项挑战。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 StreamingWAM，一种面向基于 WAM 的机器人控制的流式扩散（streaming-diffusion）框架。StreamingWAM 结合了用于分块动作预测的噪声阶梯（noise ladder）、用于跨块连续性的前缀展开（prefix rollout）模块，以及用于时间一致条件化的密集视频历史记忆。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0 以及真实世界机器人任务上的实验表明，StreamingWAM 在静态与动态设置下均提升了动作连续性，在取得有竞争力性能的同时，将仿真中的稳态重规划延迟降至 72.9 ms，在真实机器人上降至 57.3 ms。该方法还产生了更平滑的动作过渡，而流式阶梯降低了对执行时域 K 的敏感性。

title: Look Before You Move: Agent-Interface-Aligned Supervision for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
summary: Open-world mobile manipulation requires a robot to find an object, approach it, and move it to a target receptacle from a language instruction. Training vision-language model (VLM) agents for these tasks requires demonstrations of both action selection and active vision. Existing pipelines often convert planned trajectories into high-level action labels, but shortest-path progress provides limited supervision for deciding where to look. We introduce Agent-Interface Data Alignment (AIDA), a data collection pipeline in which a teacher directly selects and executes actions through the deployed agent's skill interface. For mobile manipulation, we design teachers that maintain target visibility, recover lost targets, and approach for picking or placing. We add template-based spatial reasoning supervision and use a shared harness to organize observations, history, and outputs during training and inference. The resulting agent, AIDA-OWMM, achieves 71.76% full-task success on 170 held-out OWMM episodes. Teacher sensitivity analysis shows that active-vision demonstrations improve student success. The simulation-trained agent achieves 38% end-to-end success on a real mobile robot without additional training. Applying AIDA to a navigation subset of EmbodiedBench further demonstrates the pipeline's utility for navigation tasks.

AI.title_zh: 先看再动：面向开放世界移动操作的对齐智能体接口的监督
AI.abstract_zh: 开放世界移动操作要求机器人根据语言指令找到一个物体、接近它，并将其移动到目标容器中。为这些任务训练视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体，需要动作选择与主动视觉两方面的示范。现有流程通常将规划好的轨迹转换为高层动作标签，但最短路径进展对于决定“看向何处”所提供的监督有限。我们提出智能体接口数据对齐（Agent-Interface Data Alignment, AIDA），这是一种数据采集流程，其中教师通过所部署智能体的技能接口直接选择并执行动作。针对移动操作，我们设计了能够维持目标可见性、找回丢失目标，并为抓取或放置而接近目标的教师。我们加入基于模板的空间推理监督，并使用统一的运行框架（shared harness）在训练和推理期间组织观测、历史与输出。由此得到的智能体 AIDA-OWMM 在 170 个留出的 OWMM 回合上取得 71.76% 的完整任务成功率。教师敏感性分析表明，主动视觉示范能提升学生的成功率。该在仿真中训练的智能体在无额外训练的情况下，在真实移动机器人上取得 38% 的端到端成功率。将 AIDA 应用于 EmbodiedBench 的导航子集，进一步证明了该流程对导航任务的实用性。

title: A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?
summary: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade .

AI.title_zh: 一个貌似合理的未来并非因果的未来：视频模型能生成世界如何展开吗？
AI.abstract_zh: 大规模视频生成模型日益被视为通向世界模型的一条有前景的路径，然而其捕捉因果连贯的物理动力学的能力仍然鲜为人知。现有评估在很大程度上强调视觉质量、提示遵循度或宽泛的物理合理性，而对于模型能否忠实实现完整的因果级联——即一个起始事件经由因果依赖的交互传播至一个终端结果——仍未有定论。我们提出 CausalCascade，一个以模拟器为基础的基准，其核心是 50 个事件丰富的 Blender 场景，配有结构化事件图、基于图的诊断性 VQA、三个层次的未来事件指定，以及 2,832 个受控反事实变体，并用它来评估九个图生视频（image-to-video）模型，配以运动层面、事件层面和反事实层面互补的诊断。在所评估的模型中，生成的运动在空间定位上比在正确的时空演化实现上更为可靠，而更丰富的未来事件指定提高了事件恢复率，但对物理实现的改善仍然有限。反事实评估进一步揭示了模型对物理干预的选择性响应较弱，而大多数经审查的失败是基础性的，出现在场景一致性或事件发生环节。总之，这些结果将因果级联生成定位为世界建模的一种过程级测试，并凸显出以下需求：联合地恢复预期的未来、忠实地实现其物理演化、选择性地响应物理干预，并随时间推移维持一个连贯的物理世界。代码与数据集可在 https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade 获取。

title: Structured Stateful Relational Scripts with a High-Quality Dataset for Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Video Generation
summary: Coherent multi-shot audio-visual video generation requires maintaining consistent identities while depicting evolving states and coordinating sounds across shot boundaries. Although dense captions describe individual shots in detail, they rarely specify which entities persist, how their states change, or which entities and actions produce sounds. To address this limitation, we propose Structured Stateful Relational Scripts (SSRS), a textual supervision representation that separates persistent entity and voice identities from shot-specific visual and auditory states. SSRS explicitly encodes sound-source bindings and temporal relations, while a global audio-visual event sequence connects local actions and sounds, including events that continue across shot boundaries. We further introduce MSAV-Script-100K, a large-scale dataset of curated multi-shot audio-visual videos paired with detailed SSRS annotations, enabling models to learn identity persistence, state transitions, and event continuity from structured supervision. Experiments demonstrate improvements in cross-shot consistency, adherence to specified state changes, and audio-visual alignment, highlighting the effectiveness of our SSRS and MSAV-Script-100K for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Our proposed dataset is available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/shenlehan/MSAV-Script-100K}{MSAV-Script-100K}.

AI.title_zh: 面向多镜头音视频视频生成的结构化有状态关系脚本与高质量数据集
AI.abstract_zh: 连贯的多镜头音视频视频生成需要在刻画不断演变的状态并跨镜头边界协调声音的同时，保持身份的一致性。尽管密集描述（dense captions）能够详细描述单个镜头，但它们很少指明哪些实体持续存在、其状态如何变化，或者哪些实体与动作产生了声音。为解决这一局限，我们提出结构化有状态关系脚本（Structured Stateful Relational Scripts, SSRS），这是一种文本监督表示，将持续存在的实体身份与声音身份同镜头特定的视觉状态与听觉状态分离开来。SSRS 显式编码声源绑定（sound-source bindings）与时间关系，而全局音视频事件序列则连接局部动作与声音，包括跨镜头边界持续的事件。我们进一步提出 MSAV-Script-100K，这是一个大规模数据集，由经过整理的多镜头音视频视频构成，并配有详细的 SSRS 标注，使模型能够从结构化监督中学习身份持续性、状态转换与事件连续性。实验表明，在跨镜头一致性、对指定状态变化的遵循以及音视频对齐方面均有改进，凸显了我们的 SSRS 与 MSAV-Script-100K 对于连贯多镜头音视频生成的有效性。我们提出的数据集可在 \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/shenlehan/MSAV-Script-100K}{MSAV-Script-100K} 获取。

title: EmoTrace-Bench: Diagnosing Emotional Expression in Text-to-Video Generation through Controlled Cues and Intensity
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to generate videos with targeted emotional expressions, yet existing evaluation methods mainly rely on holistic video-text alignment and provide limited insight into whether failures arise from target-emotion expression, intensity control, or specific affective cues. We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark that controls emotion intensity and selected affective cues in prompts and evaluates generated videos at multiple levels. EmoTrace-Bench contains 448 controlled prompts covering eight emotions, two intensity levels, and diverse cue conditions. Using 12 T2V models, we generate 5,376 videos and evaluate target-emotion presence, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual dimensions of emotional expression with an automated evaluator calibrated and validated against human annotations on a subset of the data. Results reveal substantial differences across models and prompt designs. Prompts that explicitly describe a character's emotional reaction are followed more reliably than prompts that describe only events or scenes, whereas adding more affective cues or using more explicit cinematic audiovisual language does not consistently improve emotional generation. These results illustrate how aggregate alignment scores may overlook localized differences in target-emotion expression, intensity control, and cue realization. EmoTrace-Bench provides a traceable and interpretable framework for diagnosing emotional video generation without modifying existing generation pipelines, and we release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

AI.title_zh: EmoTrace-Bench：通过受控线索与强度诊断文本到视频生成中的情感表达
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到视频（T2V）模型越来越多地被用于生成具有特定情感表达的视频，然而现有的评估方法主要依赖整体性的视频—文本对齐，对于失败究竟源于目标情感表达、强度控制还是特定情感线索，所能提供的洞见有限。我们提出 EmoTrace-Bench，这是一个细粒度的诊断基准，它在提示中控制情感强度和选定的情感线索，并在多个层面对生成的视频进行评估。EmoTrace-Bench 包含 448 条受控提示，覆盖八种情感、两个强度级别以及多样的线索条件。我们使用 12 个 T2V 模型生成了 5,376 个视频，并使用一个自动化评估器评估目标情感的存在、感知强度以及情感表达的十个视听维度，该评估器已在部分数据上依据人工标注进行了校准与验证。结果显示，不同模型和提示设计之间存在显著差异。明确描述角色情感反应的提示比仅描述事件或场景的提示得到更可靠的遵循，而增加更多情感线索或使用更明确的电影化视听语言并不能持续改善情感生成。这些结果表明，总体对齐分数可能会忽视目标情感表达、强度控制和线索实现方面的局部差异。EmoTrace-Bench 提供了一个可追溯且可解释的框架，用于在不修改现有生成流程的情况下诊断情感视频生成，我们发布了提示以及自动化评估规则。

title: World Modeling through Spectral Alignment
summary: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

AI.title_zh: 通过谱对齐进行世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 我们如何告诉一个世界模型应当保留哪些信息？我们通过谱表示学习（spectral representation learning）的视角研究这一问题。我们提出了 SpecWM，一个 JEPA 框架，它通过目标相似度核（target similarity kernel）显式指定观测之间期望的关系，并训练编码器在其嵌入几何中复现这些关系。不同的核提供不同的监督，从物理状态信息到仅需要轨迹内观测顺序的完全自监督时间核。我们刻画了该目标的全局最优解，建立了线性可恢复性以及对干扰信息不变性的条件，并在一个理想化设定下将时间核相似度与行为后继测度（behavioral successor measure）联系起来。在实证上，核的选择强烈控制着哪些物理量可从表示中恢复。更重要的是，时间谱对齐将 CEM 规划成功率相较于 LeWorldModel 从 OGBench Cube 上的 52% 提升至 68%，从 OGBench Scene 上的 49% 提升至 77%，从 CALVIN 上的 29% 提升至 51%。这些结果表明，显式指定表示几何提供了一种简单的方法，用以引导潜在世界模型为控制保留什么。

title: ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs
summary: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

AI.title_zh: ANTE：先预测，再执行——从可验证信念中为编码智能体学习内部世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的快速进展已使软件工程智能体能够处理复杂的编码任务。在容器化环境中，编码智能体接收工具响应或执行结果，并依据这些先前的输出来决定其后续动作。然而，大多数现有编码智能体从不向前预判：其策略不会预测动作的后果，而终局奖励也几乎无法将失败归因于某些早先的步骤，因此一次判断失误的编辑可能在任何信号到来之前就已不可逆地破坏仓库状态。近期的代码世界模型旨在应对这些挑战，但它们要么在强化学习（RL）之前训练完成后即被冻结，要么被简化为对环境的输出施加一个辅助的下一词元损失。我们提出 ANTE（Anticipate, Then Execute，先预测，再执行），一个智能体式 RL 框架，它通过真实执行来验证策略在动作前的预测，并将其转化为针对其动作与“信任或弃权”决策的逐步信用。借助在每次动作前陈述的内部信念，信念锚定策略优化（Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization，BAPO）通过将信用锚定在策略自身的预测上，把已确定的预测转化为逐步优势。为在推理时将训练得到的预测转化为更好的动作，从而促进有效的测试时扩展，ANTE-TTO（测试时优化）在无需外部评分器的情况下在候选动作中进行选择。ANTE 将 Qwen3-32B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的 pass@1 从 25.0% 提升至 57.2%，比在无信念状态下训练的匹配 GRPO 基线高出 6.2%；其世界模型的准确率在 RL 过程中从 44% 攀升至 69%，且所学得的预见能力可跨 harness 与分布外领域迁移。总而言之，我们的目标是构建一个代码世界模型，它知道已经发生了什么、当前成立什么，以及下一个动作将达成什么。

title: LERR-Nav: Learning to Coordinate Exploration, Recovery, and Reminiscing for Object Navigation
summary: Object Navigation in unseen environments remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as it requires agents to generalize visual and spatial reasoning to novel layouts. While recent advances in large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) have enhanced semantic mapping, spatial memory, and waypoint selecting for navigation, successful navigation requires more than selecting the next promising waypoint. A robot must also recognize stalled progress, escape unproductive behaviors, and revisit overlooked target cues. Addressing these challenges requires both specialized navigation strategies and a high-level policy that coordinates their execution. Motivated by the analysis of failed navigation episodes, we propose LERR-Nav, an object navigation framework that coordinates exploration, recovery, and reminiscing through a learned high-level policy. The framework comprises four complementary navigation strategies: value-function-guided exploration, LLM-guided exploration, recovery from stalled or repetitive behavior, and memory-guided reminiscing. To support history-aware coordination, we maintain the execution memory that preserves textual summaries of all strategy executions alongside a sliding window of map sequences. To learn the coordination policy, we initialize a high-level vision-language agent from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and train it through a two-stage curriculum. The first stage uses map-centric supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to establish spatial grounding. The second stage performs SFT on variable-length navigation segments to learn which navigation strategy to invoke next based on current maps and the hybrid execution memory. Experiments on HM3D and MP3D demonstrate state-of-the-art navigation performance, while ablation studies validate the contributions of individual components.

AI.title_zh: LERR-Nav：学习协调探索、恢复与回忆以进行物体导航
AI.abstract_zh: 在未见环境中的物体导航（Object Navigation）仍然是具身人工智能（embodied AI）中的一项基本挑战，因为它要求智能体将视觉与空间推理泛化到新的布局中。尽管近期大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的进展增强了用于导航的语义建图、空间记忆与路点选择，但成功的导航不仅仅需要选择下一个有前景的路点。机器人还必须识别出进展停滞、摆脱无效行为，并重新审视被忽视的目标线索。应对这些挑战既需要专门的导航策略，也需要一个协调其执行的高层策略。受对失败导航回合分析的启发，我们提出了 LERR-Nav，一个通过学习到的高层策略来协调探索、恢复与回忆的物体导航框架。该框架包含四种互补的导航策略：价值函数引导的探索、LLM 引导的探索、从停滞或重复行为中恢复，以及记忆引导的回忆。为了支持具有历史感知能力的协调，我们维护执行记忆（execution memory），它保存所有策略执行的文本摘要以及一个地图序列的滑动窗口。为了学习协调策略，我们从 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 初始化一个高层视觉语言智能体，并通过两阶段课程对其进行训练。第一阶段使用以地图为中心的监督微调（SFT）来建立空间基础。第二阶段在变长导航片段上执行 SFT，以学习基于当前地图和混合执行记忆接下来应调用哪种导航策略。在 HM3D 和 MP3D 上的实验展示了最先进的导航性能，而消融研究验证了各个组件的贡献。

title: Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models
summary: World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. To improve cross-instance optimization compatibility, TARA incorporates trajectory-aware contrastive alignment to encourage attacked representations from diverse video--trajectory instances to approach a shared adversarial region and then performs trajectory-aware task refinement to translate the aligned representation into task-level prediction errors. For reproducible evaluation, we develop a geometry-grounded tracking pipeline that provides physically plausible adversarial regions with temporally consistent trajectories on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and Something-Something V2. We further collect real-world print-and-recapture videos to validate attack effectiveness under physical deployment conditions. Together, the annotated benchmarks and real-world captured data form a reproducible testbed for future evaluation. Notably, our results reveal that a single printable adversarial texture can persistently disrupt world models and video understanding models under physical conditions, highlighting the fundamental security challenge.

AI.title_zh: 跨越视角与时间：面向世界模型与视频理解模型的轨迹可泛化物理攻击
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型与视频理解模型正日益部署于动态视觉环境中，然而其对物理对抗威胁的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们研究单一物理对抗纹理能否在观测视角沿不受控的物体—相机轨迹变化的不同真实世界场景中误导受害模型。我们发现，异构的视频语义与轨迹会导致用于优化对抗纹理的梯度对齐不佳。为解决这一问题，我们提出轨迹感知对抗对齐与精炼攻击（Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack, TARA），其引入轨迹感知优化，以捕捉打印纹理在真实世界场景下不断演变的几何变化。为提升跨实例优化的兼容性，TARA 引入轨迹感知对比对齐，促使来自多样视频—轨迹实例的受攻击表征趋近一个共享的对抗区域，随后执行轨迹感知任务精炼，将已对齐的表征转化为任务层面的预测错误。为便于可复现评估，我们开发了一条基于几何的跟踪流水线，在 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 和 Something-Something V2 上提供具有时间一致轨迹的物理上合理的对抗区域。我们进一步采集真实世界的打印—回拍视频，以验证物理部署条件下的攻击有效性。标注基准与真实世界采集数据共同构成了一个可复现的测试平台，以供未来评估使用。值得注意的是，我们的结果揭示，单一可打印对抗纹理能够在物理条件下持续干扰世界模型与视频理解模型，凸显了这一根本性的安全挑战。

title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

AI.title_zh: TempoKV：面向自回归视频生成的预测性KV缓存量化
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型能够实现长视频的流式生成，但由于KV缓存快速增长，会带来显著的内存开销。现有的KV缓存量化方法主要面向LLM设计，迁移到视频模型时效果不佳，因为视频模型中的激活具有不同的统计特性以及较强的时空冗余。我们观察到，视频KV缓存随时间在很大程度上是可预测的，并且存在明显的不对称性。Key（键）从其时间历史中高度可预测，而Value（值）主要依赖于当前Key，并且需要一小段先前Value的历史。基于这些观察，我们提出\textbf{\method}，一种用于AR视频生成的无训练预测性KV缓存量化框架。\method根据Key和Value各自不同的依赖关系对其进行预测，并仅以低精度存储残差。两个预测器都很轻量，通过在一小批BF16样本上进行线性回归一次性离线校准，并在不同提示词和生成运行中保持固定。在Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing和LongCat-Video-13B上的实验表明，在相当或更高的压缩率下，\method持续取得比现有KV缓存量化方法更高的生成质量，在整体质量与效率的最佳权衡下实现最高$6.71\times$的KV缓存压缩。我们的代码将在GitHub上发布。

title: ProWorld: Multi-View World Model with Proprioceptive Feedback for Closed-Loop Policy Evaluation
summary: Evaluating robot manipulation policies through repeated physical trials is costly. We study whether an action-conditioned world model can serve as a closed-loop test environment whose policy success rates track those on real robots. Beyond realistic video, the model must return the camera views and proprioceptive state needed for the policy's next action and preserve failed-action outcomes to avoid overestimating policy capability. We introduce ProWorld, a world model that jointly predicts multi-view video and robot state, then feeds both back to a frozen policy for repeated interaction. ProWorld comprises a shared transformer for joint video-state flow prediction and Shared-Time View Encoding to distinguish cameras while preserving temporal synchronization. To reduce interaction hallucinations that turn missed grasps into successful lifts, we augment training with failed interactions collected in high-fidelity simulation, reducing inflated success rates in the generated environment. ProWorld achieves the highest overall TriWorldBench score among the compared methods. Across three policies and four local manipulation tasks, it attains a Pearson correlation of 0.95 and a Spearman correlation of 0.94 between generated and real success rates. These results support joint visual-proprioceptive feedback and failure-aware training as a basis for world-model-based policy evaluation.

AI.title_zh: ProWorld：具有本体感觉反馈的多视角世界模型，用于闭环策略评估
AI.abstract_zh: 通过反复的物理试验来评估机器人操作策略代价高昂。我们研究一个以动作为条件的世界模型能否作为一个闭环测试环境，其策略成功率与真实机器人上的成功率保持一致。除了逼真的视频之外，该模型还必须返回策略下一步动作所需的相机视角和本体感觉状态，并保留失败动作的结果，以避免高估策略能力。我们提出 ProWorld，一个联合预测多视角视频与机器人状态的世界模型，随后将二者反馈给一个冻结的策略以进行反复交互。ProWorld 包含一个用于联合视频-状态流预测的共享 transformer，以及 Shared-Time View Encoding，用于在保持时间同步的同时区分各相机。为减少将抓取失败转变为成功提起的交互幻觉，我们用在高保真仿真中收集的失败交互来增强训练，从而降低生成环境中被夸大的成功率。在所比较的方法中，ProWorld 取得了最高的 TriWorldBench 总体得分。在三种策略和四项本地操作任务上，它在生成成功率与真实成功率之间达到了 0.95 的 Pearson 相关性和 0.94 的 Spearman 相关性。这些结果支持将联合视觉-本体感觉反馈与失败感知训练作为基于世界模型的策略评估的基础。

title: LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

AI.title_zh: LeHami：面向世界模型的辛潜动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）直接在潜空间中学习世界模型，但无约束的自回归预测器在长时程推演（long rollouts）中可能会收缩潜分布。我们提出辛哈密顿 JEPA（LeHami），它用一个以动作为条件的哈密顿流（Hamiltonian flow）替代标准预测器，该流作用在结构化潜状态 (q, p) 上，并使用精确辛的蛙跳步（leapfrog step）进行积分。这一构造在每一次推演步骤中保持相空间体积，并排除均匀收缩、渐近稳定不动点以及不同潜状态合并的可能性，且与学习到的参数或动作序列无关。我们从学习到的类位置表示的时序导数中获得类动量分量，从而为预测与控制提供显式的二阶状态。在保守与驱动视觉单摆环境中，LeHami 相比无约束的 JEPA 世界模型大幅改善了长时程速度预测，并在基座模型发生收缩的情况下经验性地保持潜体积恒定。所学习到的流还支持在未见过的亚帧步长（sub-frame step sizes）下进行精确积分以及数值时间反演。这些结果表明，几何结构如何能够提供与潜世界模型中的表示正则化互补的推理时保证。

title: ObsSpec: Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation
summary: Tool-using agents alternate between model generation and tool execution, waiting for each tool call to complete before starting the next generation. This sequential execution is costly during agentic reinforcement learning (RL), which requires large batches of multi-turn rollouts. We introduce ObsSpec, an observation speculation pipeline for agentic RL that uses a small world model to predict tool outputs while the environment executes, allowing the policy to begin its next generation early. ObsSpec retains speculative work only when the predicted and actual observations match exactly, making rollout collection lossless, while co-training keeps the world model up to date as the policy learns. On terminal-use tasks, predictions from a 0.6B world model exactly match actual observations in 66.4% of attempts and arrive roughly 16 times faster. Using these predictions, ObsSpec reduces agent latency by 9.3% and 14.2% for 8B and 32B policies. Across controlled experiments, we characterize the regimes in which ObsSpec reduces agent latency under shared policy resources. Finally, because ObsSpec overlaps policy generation with tool execution, it is architecturally compatible with existing techniques for accelerating RL. Code is available at https://github.com/kylemontgomery1/verl-recipe/tree/obsspec/obsspec.

AI.title_zh: ObsSpec：以观测推测加速智能体强化学习
AI.abstract_zh: 使用工具的智能体在模型生成与工具执行之间交替，需等待每次工具调用完成后才开始下一次生成。这种串行执行在智能体强化学习（RL）中代价高昂，因为后者需要大批量的多轮 rollout。我们提出 ObsSpec，一种用于智能体 RL 的观测推测（observation speculation）流水线，它使用一个小型世界模型在环境执行期间预测工具输出，从而使策略能够提前开始下一次生成。ObsSpec 仅在预测观测与实际观测完全一致时保留推测工作，从而使 rollout 收集无损，同时通过协同训练（co-training）在策略学习过程中保持世界模型的最新状态。在终端使用任务上，一个 0.6B 世界模型的预测在 66.4% 的尝试中与实际观测完全一致，并且到达速度约快 16 倍。利用这些预测，ObsSpec 将 8B 和 32B 策略的智能体延迟分别降低 9.3% 和 14.2%。通过一系列受控实验，我们刻画了在共享策略资源下 ObsSpec 降低智能体延迟的适用情形。最后，由于 ObsSpec 将策略生成与工具执行重叠，它在架构上与现有的 RL 加速技术兼容。代码见 https://github.com/kylemontgomery1/verl-recipe/tree/obsspec/obsspec。

title: Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments
summary: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors. In each task, the model must issue instructions, receive physical feedback from the environment, interpret the resulting state, and adapt its next action accordingly. This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution uncertainty. Through experiments with representative LLMs, we characterize their ability to translate linguistic reasoning into physical actions and identify common failure modes such as hallucinated state changes, poor recovery from unexpected outcomes, and unstable long-horizon plans. Our benchmark aims to provide a systematic foundation for evaluating LLMs as interactive agents that connect words, tools, and the physical world.

AI.title_zh: 从词语到世界：在交互式物理环境中对大语言模型进行基准测试
