AI.abstract_zh: 词语正日益成为行动的接口：大语言模型（LLMs）如今能够调用工具、操作设备，并做出影响物理世界的决策。然而，当前的基准测试大多通过静态文本回复、离线工具调用或模拟任务来评估 LLMs，从而留下了一个悬而未决的问题：它们在真实物理环境中的行动能力究竟如何。我们提出了一个基准，用于在闭环物理交互中测量 LLMs，其中模型控制一套连接到真实世界组件（包括机械臂、相机和传感器）的硬件装置系统。在每项任务中，模型必须发出指令、接收来自环境的物理反馈、解读由此得到的状态，并相应地调整其下一步动作。该设定评估的是语言理解之外的能力，包括具身感知（grounded perception）、动作规划、工具选择、空间推理、反馈驱动的纠正，以及对执行不确定性的鲁棒性。通过对具有代表性的 LLMs 进行实验，我们刻画了它们将语言推理转化为物理动作的能力，并识别出常见的失败模式，例如幻觉出的状态变化、对意外结果恢复不佳，以及长时程计划不稳定。我们的基准旨在为将 LLMs 作为连接词语、工具与物理世界的交互式智能体进行评估提供一个系统性的基础。

title: ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling
summary: Coding agents are increasingly evolving beyond reproducing what a world looks like toward constructing executable worlds that capture how a world works. This shift calls for executable world modeling, which integrates two core capabilities: world understanding, reasoning about the underlying structural, mechanical, and causal principles of a world, and executable realization, translating that understanding into a code-based system whose behavior emerges from physical interactions. However, existing benchmarks provide only fragmented evaluations centered on physical reasoning, visual fidelity, or behavioral correctness, leaving the integration of these capabilities insufficiently assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExeWorldBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark to comprehensively evaluate world understanding and executable realization through code-based 3D world construction. ExeWorldBench comprises three progressively challenging tasks: Mechanism Executability, which evaluates the realization of individual mechanisms from visual observations; Compositional Executability, which extends to multi-stage systems with spatial, mechanical, and causal dependencies; and Intent-Driven Executable World Synthesis, which requires constructing executable worlds from high-level goals and physical requirements. Extensive experiments on frontier models reveal substantial limitations in executable world modeling, offering insights into the development of more physically grounded and causally coherent world construction systems.

AI.title_zh: ExeWorldBench：基于代码的可执行3D世界建模基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 编码智能体正日益超越对世界外观的复现，转向构建能够捕捉世界运行方式的可执行世界。这一转变呼唤可执行世界建模，它整合了两项核心能力：世界理解，即推理一个世界底层的结构、机械与因果原理；以及可执行实现，即将这种理解转化为一个基于代码的系统，其行为由物理交互涌现而来。然而，现有基准仅提供围绕物理推理、视觉保真度或行为正确性的碎片化评估，致使这些能力的整合未得到充分评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 ExeWorldBench，据我们所知，这是首个通过基于代码的3D世界构建来全面评估世界理解与可执行实现的基准。ExeWorldBench 包含三项难度递进的任务：机制可执行性，评估从视觉观察中对单个机制的实现；组合可执行性，扩展到具有空间、机械与因果依赖关系的多阶段系统；以及意图驱动的可执行世界合成，要求从高层目标与物理需求出发构建可执行世界。在前沿模型上的大量实验揭示了可执行世界建模方面的显著局限，为开发更具物理基础与因果一致性的世界构建系统提供了洞见。

title: TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE_T2V.

AI.title_zh: TIDE：面向高效文本到视频提示优化的轨迹信息技能蒸馏
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到视频（T2V）模型对提示的具体性高度敏感，而迭代式提示优化通常仅在推理阶段通过反复生成视频并由视觉语言模型进行评估来提升生成质量。我们提出 TIDE，一个将这种高成本搜索过程蒸馏为可解释且可复用的提示重写技能（Skill）的框架。TIDE 将提示重写表述为一组以源条件为条件的规则模块，每个模块针对一个不同的语义维度。一旦完成蒸馏，冻结的技能会激活相关规则，并在单次 LLM 调用中生成正向和负向提示，随后仅进行一次 T2V 生成，无需测试时的视觉搜索或主干微调。TIDE 仅使用 100 条提示、历经 14 小时演化，即达到与计算开销高昂的基于搜索的方法相当的提示优化性能。此外，当迁移到此前未见过的视频生成模型时，TIDE 的表现优于专门为这些模型设计或训练的现有方法。代码见 https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE_T2V。

title: CatPortrait: Taming Video Generative Models for Portrait Animation via In-context Conditioning
summary: Recent video generative models have shown strong capability in synthesizing high-quality and temporally coherent videos. Yet, adapting them for controllable portrait animation remains nontrivial, as existing methods typically rely on architectural changes or extra conditioning modules, increasing complexity and reducing compatibility with pretrained models. We present CatPortrait, a simple and effective framework that enables controllable portrait animation via 3D face guidance as in-context conditioning. CatPortrait preserves the original video generation backbone and injects structured 3D facial guidance into the input space through spatial concatenation, allowing pretrained image-to-video models to animate portraits without sacrificing their pretrained priors. CatPortrait supports both video-driven and audio-driven portrait animation within a unified framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CatPortrait achieves competitive or superior results across both settings.

AI.title_zh: CatPortrait：通过上下文条件化驾驭视频生成模型实现人像动画
AI.abstract_zh: 近期的视频生成模型在合成高质量且时间连贯的视频方面展现出强大能力。然而，将其适配用于可控人像动画仍非易事，因为现有方法通常依赖于架构改动或额外的条件模块，增加了复杂性并降低了与预训练模型的兼容性。我们提出 CatPortrait，一个简单而有效的框架，通过将 3D 人脸引导作为上下文条件化（in-context conditioning），实现可控的人像动画。CatPortrait 保留原始视频生成主干，并通过空间拼接将结构化的 3D 人脸引导注入输入空间，使预训练的图生视频模型能够为人像制作动画，同时不牺牲其预训练先验。CatPortrait 在统一框架内同时支持视频驱动和音频驱动的人像动画。大量实验表明，CatPortrait 在两种设定下均取得了具有竞争力或更优的结果。

title: CFG-Policy: Unified Diffusion Policy Learning Framework via Classifier-free Guidance
summary: Diffusion policies are increasingly used in robotic control and manipulation, vision-language-action models, and world-model-based agents. Their ability to represent multimodal action distributions offers rich opportunities for exploration in reinforcement learning (RL). However, optimizing diffusion policies with RL can reduce the behavioral diversity and further limit their exploration capability. In RL post-training, directly fine-tuning a pretrained policy may also disrupt its acquired capabilities, while action-space residuals may lack the expressive power for multimodal exploration. Together, these issues reveal a common challenge across online and offline-to-online diffusion RL: improving task performance while retaining the behavioral diversity and capabilities needed for continued adaptation. We introduce CFG-Policy, a unified, plug-and-play framework that separates exploration and exploitation into two generative policies and combines their score or velocity fields during sampling through classifier-free guidance. For online RL, a frozen exploration branch sustains behavioral diversity while an exploitation branch learns from task rewards; for offline-to-online RL, a pretrained exploitation branch remains frozen while a trainable branch steers the composed behavior. CFG-Policy preserves the underlying RL objectives and improves performance with QSM and QVPO on 5 MuJoCo tasks and with Flow-SDE+PPO on 4 RoboTwin manipulation tasks. Project page is at https://zhy-liu.github.io/cfg-policy-page.

AI.title_zh: CFG-Policy：基于无分类器引导的统一扩散策略学习框架
AI.abstract_zh: 扩散策略正日益被用于机器人控制与操作、视觉-语言-动作模型以及基于世界模型的智能体。它们表征多模态动作分布的能力，为强化学习（RL）中的探索提供了丰富的机会。然而，用 RL 优化扩散策略可能会降低行为多样性，并进一步限制其探索能力。在 RL 后训练中，直接微调预训练策略也可能破坏其已获得的能力，而动作空间残差可能缺乏用于多模态探索的表达能力。综合来看，这些问题揭示了在线以及离线到在线扩散 RL 中的一个共同挑战：在提升任务性能的同时，保留持续适应所需的行为多样性与能力。我们提出了 CFG-Policy，一个统一、即插即用的框架，它将探索与利用分离为两个生成策略，并在采样过程中通过无分类器引导（classifier-free guidance）将其分数场或速度场进行组合。对于在线 RL，一个冻结的探索分支维持行为多样性，而一个利用分支从任务奖励中学习；对于离线到在线 RL，一个预训练的利用分支保持冻结，而一个可训练分支引导组合后的行为。CFG-Policy 保留了底层 RL 目标，并在 5 个 MuJoCo 任务上以 QSM 和 QVPO、在 4 个 RoboTwin 操作任务上以 Flow-SDE+PPO 提升了性能。项目页面为 https://zhy-liu.github.io/cfg-policy-page。

title: MORE: Learning Motion-Oriented Registers for Driving World Models and Planning
summary: By predicting future states, latent world models provide rich self-supervision for end-to-end driving, but often inherit dense features from pretrained visual encoders as their world-state interface. This creates a mismatch: visual pretraining produces information-rich, spatially dense features, but their adaptation for motion-conditioned world modeling and planning is deferred to downstream training. The dense grid also makes future prediction more computationally expensive as visual resolution increases. We therefore argue that video pretraining should directly learn state representations suited to downstream world modeling and planning, rather than relying on downstream training to adapt inherited visual features. We propose ***MORE***, a V-JEPA framework that learns **M**otion-**O**riented **RE**gisters during video pretraining as a shared state interface for driving world models and planning. MORE injects temporally aligned ego motion into a small set of registers and uses them as the sole context for masked patch prediction, channeling dense patch-level supervision through a compact state bottleneck. A complementary blockwise register-masking objective further shapes predictive structure in the register space. During downstream training, the same register space defines the future states predicted by the world model and provides shared scene memory for trajectory generation and scoring. On NAVSIM-v2, MORE outperforms the state of the art by 1.6 in EPDMS, while achieving superior efficiency with only 1/10 the inference latency of DriveLaW. These results support learning the state interface for world modeling and planning directly during video pretraining.

AI.title_zh: MORE：学习面向运动的寄存器（Registers）用于驾驶世界模型与规划
AI.abstract_zh: 通过预测未来状态，潜在世界模型为端到端驾驶提供了丰富的自监督信号，但通常将预训练视觉编码器中的稠密特征继承为自身的世界状态接口。这造成了一种错配：视觉预训练产生信息丰富、空间稠密的特征，而将其适配于以运动为条件的（motion-conditioned）世界建模与规划却被推迟到下游训练中。随着视觉分辨率提高，稠密网格也使未来预测的计算开销更大。因此，我们认为视频预训练应直接学习适合下游世界建模与规划的状态表征，而不是依赖下游训练来适配所继承的视觉特征。我们提出 ***MORE***，一个 V-JEPA 框架，在视频预训练期间学习**运**动**导**向**寄**存器（**M**otion-**O**riented **RE**gisters），作为驾驶世界模型与规划的共享状态接口。MORE 将时间对齐的自车运动（ego motion）注入一小组寄存器，并将其作为掩码块预测（masked patch prediction）的唯一上下文，从而通过紧凑的状态瓶颈传递稠密的块级监督。一个互补的分块寄存器掩码（blockwise register-masking）目标进一步在寄存器空间中塑造预测结构。在下游训练期间，同一寄存器空间定义了世界模型所预测的未来状态，并为轨迹生成与评分提供共享的场景记忆。在 NAVSIM-v2 上，MORE 在 EPDMS 上以 1.6 的优势超越当前最优方法，同时实现更优效率，其推理延迟仅为 DriveLaW 的 1/10。这些结果支持在视频预训练期间直接学习用于世界建模与规划的状态接口。

title: Scaling Latent Motor Adaptation to Coordinated Bimanual Manipulation
comment: Accepted at the IROS 2026 Bimanual Manipulation Workshop. 5 pages, 4 figures
summary: Robust manipulation under uncertain object dynamics and geometry remains a core challenge in real-world robotics. Policies trained under fixed assumptions often degrade when object mass, friction, scale, or shape vary. Embedding-based adaptation methods such as Rapid Motor Adaptation (RMA) address this by conditioning actions on latent representations of environment dynamics inferred from interaction history. We investigate whether this paradigm scales from single arm settings to coordinated bimanual manipulation, where higher dimensional control, coupled contacts, and shared object forces introduce additional complexity. We evaluate bimanual RMA on three contact-rich ManiSkill tasks with randomized YCB object properties. Bimanual RMA, using observation-action history and dual wrist depth images, retains privileged policy performance on bimanual picking and lifting, while an otherwise matched stationary PPO policy without latent conditioning achieves low success; all methods remain limited on long-horizon stacking. We further demonstrate direct sim-to-real transfer on a dual Franka lifting task without real-world finetuning. Together, these results suggest that latent conditioning provides useful structure for scaling robust control to coordinated bimanual systems, while longer horizon tasks require additional temporal structure.

AI.title_zh: 将潜在运动自适应扩展到协调双臂操作
AI.abstract_zh: 在物体动力学与几何形状不确定的情况下实现鲁棒操作，仍然是真实世界机器人学的一项核心挑战。在固定假设下训练的策略，当物体质量、摩擦、尺度或形状发生变化时，往往性能会下降。诸如快速运动自适应（Rapid Motor Adaptation, RMA）这类基于嵌入的自适应方法通过将动作条件化于从交互历史中推断出的环境动力学潜在表示来解决这一问题。我们研究了该范式能否从单臂设置扩展到协调双臂操作，后者中更高维的控制、耦合接触以及共享的物体受力引入了额外的复杂性。我们在三个接触丰富的 ManiSkill 任务上，使用随机化的 YCB 物体属性，评估双臂 RMA。双臂 RMA 使用观测-动作历史与双腕深度图像，在双臂抓取与举升任务上保持了特权策略的性能，而一个在其他方面匹配但无潜在条件化的静态 PPO 策略仅取得较低成功率；所有方法在长时程堆叠任务上仍然受限。我们进一步展示了在双臂 Franka 举升任务上的直接仿真到现实迁移，且未进行真实世界微调。综合来看，这些结果表明潜在条件化为将鲁棒控制扩展到协调双臂系统提供了有用的结构，而更长时程的任务则需要额外的时间结构。

title: MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

AI.title_zh: MHWA：多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归世界模型已成为实现样本高效决策的一种强大范式，然而其开环 rollout 往往表现出不断增大的漂移，即使在相对较小的规划时域内也会导致误差累积。分层时间抽象是一种自然的候选方案，可通过缩短有效预测时域来缓解此类漂移；然而，现有的分层设计可能引入额外的结构与概念复杂性，有时会使其难以控制，并限制其相对于扁平基线的收益。为此，我们提出了 MHWA（Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model，多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型），它采用一种跨步的高层上下文通道来降低全局上下文更新频率，从而有效抑制复合漂移的传播。关键在于，通过上下文感知路由，门控网络利用全局上下文与当前观测动态地重新配置低层专家混合（mixture of experts），从而实现灵活的高层-低层协调，有助于缓解静态分层中常见的干扰。在实证方面，使用 RLiable 的按游戏种子聚合，MHWA（77M 参数）在一个 14 游戏 Atari 子集上、使用 10% 子采样的离线数据、跨三个训练种子，取得了 0.884 的 IQM 人类归一化得分（HNS），优于参数匹配的 JOWA-70M 基线（0.529），并在使用近一半参数、每序列训练 FLOPs 减少 70.88% 的情况下，达到了与 JOWA-150M 数值上相当的性能。

title: LightVAE: Towards Compact and Efficient Video Autoencoders
comment: 24 pages, code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE
summary: Latent diffusion models enable high-quality video generation, but video VAE encoding and decoding remain computationally expensive. Existing methods use stage-specific lightweight operators, yet either constrain spatial and temporal computation jointly or remove temporal computation altogether, without distinguishing their compression sensitivities in pretrained Conv3D. To address these limitations, we present LightVAE, a compression framework that exploits redundancy in temporal modeling and network depth. LightVAE exactly reparameterizes eligible causal Conv3D layers into an aggregate spatial response and a difference-driven temporal correction. Based on their distinct compression sensitivities, temporal low-rank compression (TLR) keeps the aggregate spatial kernel dense and applies layer-specific low-rank approximation only to the temporal correction. An algebraically equivalent folded implementation converts the arithmetic savings into practical acceleration. LightVAE further uses width-preserving block pruning to reduce depth and probe-guided feature alignment, guided by feedback from a frozen teacher suffix, to recover quality after compression. The framework also extends to video encoders. Across three video VAE backbones and two GPU platforms, LightVAE consistently accelerates decoding. For the Wan VAE family, it achieves up to $2.24\times$ and $1.11\times$ the decoding throughput of state-of-the-art efficient VAE decoders on NVIDIA H100 and RTX~5090, respectively, with higher DAVIS PSNR and lower LPIPS. On MiniMax-H3, it achieves up to $2.97\times$ the original decoding throughput while retaining 99.51\% of the original model's overall VBench-2.0 score. Our code is available at https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE.

AI.title_zh: LightVAE：迈向紧凑且高效的视频自编码器
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在扩散模型（Latent diffusion models）使高质量视频生成成为可能，但视频 VAE 的编码与解码在计算上仍然代价高昂。现有方法使用阶段特定的轻量算子，但要么联合约束空间与时间计算，要么完全移除时间计算，而未区分它们在预训练 Conv3D 中的压缩敏感度。为解决这些局限，我们提出了 LightVAE，一个利用时间建模与网络深度中冗余的压缩框架。LightVAE 将符合条件的因果 Conv3D 层精确重参数化为一个聚合空间响应和一个由差分驱动的时间修正。基于二者不同的压缩敏感度，时间低秩压缩（temporal low-rank compression, TLR）保持聚合空间核为稠密，仅对时间修正施加逐层特定的低秩近似。一种代数等价的折叠实现将算术上的节省转化为实际加速。LightVAE 进一步使用保持宽度的块剪枝来减少深度，并使用探针引导的特征对齐，在冻结教师后缀的反馈指导下，以在压缩后恢复质量。该框架还可扩展至视频编码器。在三个视频 VAE 骨干网络和两个 GPU 平台上，LightVAE 均能一致地加速解码。对于 Wan VAE 系列，在 NVIDIA H100 和 RTX~5090 上，其解码吞吐量分别达到最先进高效 VAE 解码器的最高 $2.24\times$ 和 $1.11\times$，同时具有更高的 DAVIS PSNR 和更低的 LPIPS。在 MiniMax-H3 上，其解码吞吐量最高达到原始模型的 $2.97\times$，同时保留了原始模型整体 VBench-2.0 得分的 99.51\%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/ModelTC/LightVAE 获取。

title: AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation
summary: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

AI.title_zh: AcrossVAM2.0：面向参数高效视频扩散适配的冲突感知点监督
AI.abstract_zh: 显式点对应关系对于适配视频生成器颇具吸引力：它描述了可见表面如何运动，但可能覆盖大型预训练模型所学到的外观先验。我们在一个具有 5.01B 参数的文本到视频扩散 transformer 中研究了这一张力。ACROSSVAM2.0 结合了置信度加权的轨迹与可见性头（confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head）、零初始化的残差反馈，以及非对称 PCGrad——后者仅在共享 LoRA 参数上移除与主流匹配梯度（flow-matching gradient）相对抗的辅助分量。该设计在初始化时精确保留生成器，并在适配过程中保护其主更新。在一项训练 1,000 步、使用三个独立随机种子的四路消融中，完整方法在全部三个种子下都相对于匹配的仅流匹配续训降低了 KLT 前向-后向循环误差（种子级差异均值 -0.00711，SD 0.00505），同时稳健锐度（robust sharpness）在全部三个种子下均保持为正。一项扩展的 24 提示评估（216 个视频）相较于匹配对照产生了低 9.7% 的聚合 CoTracker3 循环误差，并在六个 VBench 维度上性能接近匹配；然而，种子级跟踪效应具有异质性，且 I3D-FVD 从 0.1824 退化至 0.2022。这些结果支持一个有边界的论断：冲突感知适配在不造成广泛感知退化的情况下改善对应一致性，但并未一致地提升视频质量。我们发布方程、伪代码、匹配输出、源表格以及工件溯源。

title: Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/.

AI.title_zh: Demiurge：通过自回归视频重渲染锻造可导航的4D世界
AI.abstract_zh: 近期视频扩散技术的进展使得从单段输入视频合成新视角视频成为可能，为世界建模、具身智能与机器人仿真提供了支撑。然而，现有方法独立处理各条相机轨迹，缺乏构建连贯、可导航的4D世界所需的跨轨迹一致性。我们提出 Demiurge，一个基于动态4D点云记忆缓存（dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache）构建的自回归视频重渲染流水线。它通过四个组件促进跨轨迹一致性：（1）外观视频扩散模型（appearance video diffusion model），以4D记忆为条件合成照片级真实感的新视角视频；（2）记忆一致的视频深度补全模型（memory-consistent video depth completion model），将已知区域深度与缓存几何对齐并补全缺失区域，缓解记忆更新过程中的尺度模糊与不连续问题；（3）记忆感知的双流扭曲（memory-aware dual-stream warping），为新视角合成提供高保真视觉引导与遮挡线索；（4）几何感知的视频精修（geometry-aware video refinement），提升感知质量。大量实验表明其达到了最先进的性能，并具备三项关键能力：在密集多视角轨迹上构建连贯的时空格点（spatiotemporal lattice）；在具有挑战性的相机运动下（包括输入视角无重叠的180度旋转）进行大视差视频重渲染；以及输出几何忠实的视频，可被直接优化为高质量3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）表示且伪影极少。项目页面：https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge_project_page/。

title: Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.

AI.title_zh: 竞争域至关重要：面向视频扩散Transformer免训练稀疏注意力的选择性头全局化
AI.abstract_zh: 免训练稀疏注意力是实现高效视频扩散Transformer推理的一条实用路径，然而现有方法通常将每个注意力头在每一查询行上的竞争域固定不变。此前工作主要关注在这一固定域内如何估计词元级重要性；而域本身是否应当适应头的异质性，仍未被充分界定。我们提出EG-Sparse，一个免训练框架，将低熵头路由至分组跨头池，同时为高熵头保留逐行局部选择，且仅使用稀疏流水线中已经物化的分数。一项受控诊断固定排序分数、仅改变竞争规则：分组跨头选择使低熵头的重建误差降低9.8%，而将高熵头强制置于全头全局池中则使其增加7.9%。在四种配置下，与强免训练稀疏注意力基线相比，EG-Sparse在提升视频质量的同时降低了注意力密度与GPU去噪延迟。机制消融进一步表明，选择性域适应优于统一、随机与固定域分配策略。这些结果支持将竞争域适应视为质心引导的免训练稀疏注意力中的一个独立设计维度。

title: TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance
summary: Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance. Building on this insight, we introduce TGuide, a framework that accelerates autoregressive video diffusion through a lightweight Anchor-Transport-Correct (ATC) predictor guided by historical sampling trajectories. Our ATC combines two complementary references: the current chunk's preceding-step features preserve its spatial structure, while the previous chunk's same-timestep features provide information at the target denoising stage. By integrating these references through spatial retrieval and adaptive correction, ATC improves velocity prediction accuracy despite the large gaps between denoising steps. To mitigate error accumulation across both denoising steps and video chunks, we train the predictor on its own autoregressive rollouts, allowing it to adapt to states shaped by its own earlier predictions. An optional confidence-aware scheduler further adjusts the quality-efficiency trade-off. Experiments on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and HY-WorldPlay show that TGuide preserves generation quality while achieving denoising speedups of up to $1.89\times$ over the original 4-step generators. On Self Forcing, TGuide generalizes from 81-frame training videos to 333-frame generation, approximately four times the training length, while exceeding the original model's VBench score.

AI.title_zh: TGuide：通过历史轨迹引导实现更快的自回归视频扩散
AI.abstract_zh: 当自回归视频扩散仅剩四步去噪时，能否进一步加速？现有的特征缓存方法在该情形下表现不佳，因为去噪时间步之间的特征变化很大，既破坏了直接复用，也破坏了轻量级预测器。我们观察到，在匹配的去噪时间步上，不同视频块（video chunk）之间的特征仍保持强相关性，这提供了一种互补的引导来源。基于这一洞见，我们提出了 TGuide，一个通过由历史采样轨迹引导的轻量级 Anchor-Transport-Correct（ATC）预测器来加速自回归视频扩散的框架。我们的 ATC 结合了两个互补的参考：当前块的前一步特征保留了其空间结构，而前一个块的同一时间步特征提供了目标去噪阶段的信息。通过空间检索与自适应校正来整合这些参考，ATC 尽管面临去噪步之间的巨大间隔，仍提升了速度预测的准确性。为缓解去噪步与视频块两方面的误差累积，我们在预测器自身的自回归 rollout 上训练它，使其能够适应由自身早期预测所形成的状态。一个可选的置信度感知调度器进一步调节质量—效率权衡。在 Self Forcing、Causal Forcing 和 HY-WorldPlay 上的实验表明，TGuide 在保持生成质量的同时，相较原始 4 步生成器实现了最高 $1.89\times$ 的去噪加速。在 Self Forcing 上，TGuide 从 81 帧训练视频泛化到 333 帧生成，约为训练长度的四倍，同时超过了原始模型的 VBench 分数。

title: Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. At inference time, we accelerate sampling by using accepted future-chunk predictions to skip full-window backbone executions. We equip the head with learnable embeddings to generate multiple candidates for the next chunk, and a learned verifier either selects a candidate or rejects all and falls back to standard autoregressive generation.

AI.title_zh: 前瞻性强制：为自回归长视频扩散学习向前看
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归视频生成器通过分块（chunk-wise）展开来合成长视频，但它们通常只被训练来预测最近的未来。这种有限的预测视野使得在长程展开中保持视频质量变得困难。为解决这一问题，我们引入了前瞻性强制（Prospective Forcing），这是一种多头预测框架，将长程预测信号注入自回归视频表示中。前瞻性强制构建于滚动窗口（rolling-window）生成器之上，附加了轻量级的、特定偏移（offset-specific）的预测头，这些预测头共享相同的条件信息，并独立预测不同未来时间偏移处的分块。通过将监督扩展到下一个分块之外，这些预测头促使共享历史表示保留对更长视野预测有用的信息，从而支持时间上一致的生成。在推理时，我们通过使用被接受的未来分块预测来跳过完整窗口的主干执行，从而加速采样。我们为预测头配备了可学习嵌入，以生成下一个分块的多个候选，并由一个学习到的验证器选择某个候选，或者拒绝所有候选并回退到标准的自回归生成。

title: AnyRank: Reliable Anytime Policy Ranking via Sequential Testing
summary: Due to the high cost of hardware experiments, robot policies are predominantly evaluated by comparing their empirical performance on a limited number of hardware trials. However, finite-sample statistical uncertainty can lead to erroneous conclusions, especially when ranking multiple policies using a fixed batch of evaluation data. We propose AnyRank: a sequential method for multi-policy ranking that (i) adaptively allocates trials to hard-to-separate policies, (ii) provides (partial) rankings at any stopping time while bounding the probability of an incorrect ranking, and (iii) optionally exploits prior information to prioritize hardware evaluations more efficiently. This prior information could be informed from expert intuition, a small set of held-out hardware evaluations, or from policy rollouts in a simulator or an action-conditioned video world model. Notably, the prior can be imperfect; while a strong prior can provide efficiency gains on hardware, any inaccuracies in prior policy rankings do not invalidate the statistical assurances of AnyRank. We achieve the aforementioned properties through novel theoretical contributions that combine sequential testing with multiple-hypothesis graphical testing approaches. Experiments in simulation and real-world policy evaluation benchmarks show that AnyRank requires up to 50% fewer hardware evaluations compared to existing statistically rigorous approaches, while guarding against the incorrect rankings produced by heuristic methods used by state-of-the-art benchmarks.

AI.title_zh: AnyRank：通过序贯检验实现可靠随时策略排序
AI.abstract_zh: 由于硬件实验成本高昂，机器人策略主要通过比较其在有限次数硬件试验上的经验表现来进行评估。然而，有限样本的统计不确定性可能导致错误结论，尤其是在使用固定批次评估数据对多个策略进行排序时。我们提出 AnyRank：一种用于多策略排序的序贯方法，它（i）自适应地将试验分配给难以区分的策略，（ii）在任意停止时间提供（部分）排序，同时限制错误排序的概率，并且（iii）可选地利用先验信息以更高效地优先安排硬件评估。该先验信息可来自专家直觉、一小组留出的硬件评估，或来自模拟器或动作条件视频世界模型中的策略 rollout。值得注意的是，先验可以是不完美的；虽然强先验可以在硬件上带来效率提升，但先验策略排序中的任何不准确都不会使 AnyRank 的统计保证失效。我们通过新颖的理论贡献实现上述性质，这些贡献将序贯检验与多假设图检验方法相结合。仿真实验和真实世界策略评估基准表明，与现有统计严谨的方法相比，AnyRank 所需的硬件评估次数最多可减少 50%，同时能够防止最先进基准所使用的启发式方法产生错误排序。

title: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon Robotic World Models
summary: Autoregressive robot video world models based on discrete visual tokens remain unreliable over long rollout horizons. Retaining the entire generated history does not necessarily improve prediction quality. We investigate a possible memory-role conflict in Full Context decoding: persistent scene information, recent visual-action states, and stale generated history compete for attention despite their different predictive roles. This perspective motivates ReCAP (Receding Context with Anchor Preservation), a training-free context-scheduling method for long-horizon robot video world models. ReCAP keeps the pretrained tokenizer, world model, and visual decoder frozen. It preserves the initial scene anchor and a contiguous window of recent complete visual-action blocks while evicting older generated history. The schedule preserves within-block structure and temporal order, requires no additional modules or parameter updates, and bounds active-context growth independently of rollout length. We evaluate ReCAP on RT-1, BridgeV2, LIBERO-90, and CALVIN using frozen autoregressive world models. Across evaluated environments and horizons, ReCAP improves visual fidelity, action-conditioned consistency, and robot structure preservation relative to Full Context. On BridgeV2, it reduces LPIPS by 63.3%. In the system benchmark at H=64, it reduces the logical KV footprint by 73.3% and p50 latency by 6.51%. Attention analyses show increased attention to retained recent states, while history interventions associate larger amounts of stale context with higher prediction error. These observations are consistent with the memory-role-conflict hypothesis, although they do not isolate it from context-length and position-handling effects. Our results support inference-time context scheduling as a practical approach to improving long-horizon robot video prediction and computational efficiency without retraining.

AI.title_zh: 为长时程机器人世界模型记住重要之事
AI.abstract_zh: 基于离散视觉 token 的自回归机器人视频世界模型在长 rollout 时程上仍然不可靠。保留整个生成历史并不必然提升预测质量。我们研究了全上下文（Full Context）解码中可能出现的一种记忆角色冲突：持续的场景信息、近期的视觉-动作状态以及陈旧的生成历史，尽管具有不同的预测作用，却在注意力上相互竞争。这一视角促成了 ReCAP（Receding Context with Anchor Preservation，带锚点保留的滑动上下文），一种面向长时程机器人视频世界模型、无需训练的上下文调度方法。ReCAP 保持预训练的分词器（tokenizer）、世界模型和视觉解码器冻结不变。它保留初始场景锚点以及一段连续的近期完整视觉-动作块窗口，同时逐出较旧的生成历史。该调度保留了块内结构和时间顺序，不需要额外的模块或参数更新，并使活跃上下文的增长与 rollout 长度无关地保持有界。我们在 RT-1、BridgeV2、LIBERO-90 和 CALVIN 上使用冻结的自回归世界模型评估 ReCAP。在所评估的环境和时程中，相较于 Full Context，ReCAP 提升了视觉保真度、动作条件一致性和机器人结构保持度。在 BridgeV2 上，它将 LPIPS 降低了 63.3%。在 H=64 的系统基准测试中，它将逻辑 KV 占用减少了 73.3%，将 p50 延迟降低了 6.51%。注意力分析显示，对保留的近期状态的注意力增加，而历史干预表明，更多陈旧上下文与更高的预测误差相关。这些观察结果与记忆角色冲突假说相一致，尽管它们并未将该假说与上下文长度和位置处理效应区分开来。我们的结果表明，推理时上下文调度是一种无需重新训练即可改善长时程机器人视频预测和计算效率的实用方法。

title: FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
summary: In autoregressive video generation, retaining all historical key-value (KV) states increases memory usage and per-step attention costs as videos grow longer. A fixed cache budget bounds these costs but raises the challenge of preserving historical content that supports consistent, high-quality generation. Existing methods control cache size through history selection or consolidation, yet deciding what to retain and how to limit the loss of useful content remains a shared challenge. Our analysis shows that spatial queries depend on different historical content and that higher current attention coverage does not necessarily yield better long-video quality. We introduce FrameFold, a training-free KV cache consolidation method that compares the content retrieved by the same recent historical queries before and after merging to guide both representative construction and merge selection. Exploiting temporal redundancy between adjacent historical entries, FrameFold merges their KV states into shared representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients in closed form by matching conditional attention responses, then selects the merge with the lowest remaining response distortion. Under matched KV cache budgets, experiments on Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and on LongLive at 120 seconds demonstrate improved consistency and visual quality. Continuous eight-minute Self Forcing rollouts further show less quality degradation than the baselines.

AI.title_zh: FrameFold：面向自回归长视频生成的响应引导式 KV 缓存整合
AI.abstract_zh: 在自回归视频生成中，保留所有历史键值（KV）状态会随着视频变长而增加内存使用量和每步注意力开销。固定的缓存预算可以限制这些开销，但也带来了保留支持一致、高质量生成的历史内容的挑战。现有方法通过历史选择或整合来控制缓存大小，但如何决定保留什么以及如何限制有用内容的损失仍是一个共同挑战。我们的分析表明，空间查询依赖于不同的历史内容，并且更高的当前注意力覆盖率并不必然带来更好的长视频质量。我们提出 FrameFold，一种免训练的 KV 缓存整合方法，它通过比较同一组近期历史查询在合并前后检索到的内容，来同时引导代表性构建与合并选择。利用相邻历史条目之间的时间冗余，FrameFold 将其 KV 状态合并为共享代表，同时保留完整的空间网格。它通过匹配条件注意力响应，以闭式形式拟合值合并系数，然后选择剩余响应失真最低的合并方案。在匹配的 KV 缓存预算下，在 30 秒和 60 秒的 Self Forcing 与 Causal Forcing 上以及在 120 秒的 LongLive 上的实验表明，一致性和视觉质量均有所提升。连续的八分钟 Self Forcing 展开进一步显示出比基线更小的质量退化。

title: Chunk-wise Model-based Policy Optimization
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning has shown superior sample efficiency by leveraging the learned latent dynamics either in the form of derivative-free planning/imagined rollout training or dynamics gradient-based policy updates. While these approaches achieve comparatively fast learning, they all suffer, to varying degrees, from issues of recurrent compounding errors, high inference-time latency, and instability in backward propagation through time (BPTT). In this work, we propose a model-based RL approach that uses the chunk world model as a differentiable training-time evaluator to optimize the chunk actor without recurrent model invocation. Through the collaborative chunk-wise prediction of the world model and policy, we can generate H-step hypothetical rollouts in a single forward pass and directly optimize value expansion, avoiding the costly and unstable BPTT. We evaluate our method on 19 challenging high-dimensional humanoid tasks from HumanoidBench and deploy our method to the real-world for quadruped bipedal walking. Project Website: https://song-wx.github.io/cmpo.github.io/

AI.title_zh: 分块式基于模型的策略优化
AI.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习通过以无导数规划/想象推演训练或基于动力学梯度的策略更新形式利用所学习的潜在动力学，已展现出优越的样本效率。尽管这些方法实现了相对较快的学习，但它们都在不同程度上受到循环累积误差、高推理时延以及随时间反向传播（BPTT）不稳定的问题困扰。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于模型的强化学习方法，该方法使用分块世界模型（chunk world model）作为可微的训练时评估器，在不进行循环模型调用的情况下优化分块演员（chunk actor）。通过世界模型与策略的协同分块预测，我们可以在单次前向传播中生成 H 步假设推演（H-step hypothetical rollouts），并直接优化价值展开，从而避免代价高昂且不稳定的 BPTT。我们在 HumanoidBench 的 19 个具有挑战性的高维人形任务上评估了我们的方法，并将我们的方法部署到真实世界用于四足与双足行走。项目网站：https://song-wx.github.io/cmpo.github.io/

title: Adversarial Gradient Forcing for Robust Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video generation models generate videos sequentially, with each new block conditioned on previously generated blocks. By training on the model's own rollouts, Self Forcing and its follow-up methods substantially mitigate exposure bias caused by the mismatch between training- and inference-time history distributions. However, these models still suffer from error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We identify a key underlying limitation: the model remains highly sensitive to errors in its generated history, allowing small deviations to be amplified through subsequent generations. We refer to this underexplored problem as the local history robustness gap. To address this gap, we introduce Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF), a framework designed to improve the robustness of few-step autoregressive video models to perturbations and accumulated errors in their own generated histories. AGF uses distribution matching gradients from future block predictions to select adversarial perturbations of self-generated histories. It then jointly trains the generator on the original and perturbed histories to improve the robustness of future generation. Extensive experiments show that AGF achieves the highest VBench Total score on 60-second video generation and the best visual quality on four-minute video generation. Notably, AGF achieves such long-horizon robustness while requiring only 5-second rollouts for training.

AI.title_zh: 面向鲁棒少步自回归视频生成的对抗梯度强制
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归视频生成模型按顺序生成视频，每个新块都以先前生成的块为条件。通过在模型自身的 rollout 上进行训练，Self Forcing 及其后续方法大幅缓解了因训练时与推理时历史分布不匹配而导致的暴露偏差。然而，这类模型在长时程生成过程中仍会出现误差累积。我们识别出一个关键的潜在局限：模型对其生成历史中的误差仍高度敏感，使得微小偏差会在后续生成中被放大。我们将这一尚未被充分探索的问题称为局部历史鲁棒性差距。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了对抗梯度强制（Adversarial Gradient Forcing, AGF），这是一个旨在提升少步自回归视频模型对其自身生成历史中的扰动与累积误差的鲁棒性的框架。AGF 利用来自未来块预测的分布匹配梯度，选取对自生成历史的对抗扰动。随后，它在原始历史与扰动历史上联合训练生成器，以提升未来生成的鲁棒性。大量实验表明，AGF 在 60 秒视频生成上取得了最高的 VBench Total 分数，并在四分钟视频生成上取得了最佳视觉质量。值得注意的是，AGF 在实现如此长时程鲁棒性的同时，仅需 5 秒的 rollout 进行训练。

title: InfraWorld: Motion-Aware World Modeling for Roadside 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting predicts future semantic occupancy in a fixed infrastructure coordinate system. Roadside scenes are globally structured yet locally evolving, requiring comprehensive scene-level context while precisely modeling sparse localized motion. However, existing forecasting paradigms struggle to tackle both requirements. To address this limitation, we propose InfraWorld, a world model formulating roadside occupancy forecasting as selective state evolution. InfraWorld maintains a dense BEV state for the complete scene and persistent motion queries for moving regions, assigning complementary states to global context and local dynamics. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Query Initiation (DQI) to initialize queries in regions supported by motion in the observed history. During rollout, the dense state is updated through Long--Short Temporal Fusion (LST), which combines short-term adjacent-frame continuity with long-term motion trends to preserve stable context while capturing scene evolution. Motion-Aware Query Injection (MAQI) then refines the queries and injects confidence-weighted query information into corresponding BEV tokens, enabling targeted dynamic updates without perturbing global context. Together, InfraWorld concentrates predictive capacity on evolving traffic regions. Extensive experiments on the InfraOcc and Occ3D--nus datasets demonstrate that InfraWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance for roadside 4D occupancy forecasting while retaining its effectiveness under ego-centric settings. Code will be released.

AI.title_zh: InfraWorld：面向路侧4D占用预测的运动感知世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 路侧4D占用预测在固定的基础设施坐标系中预测未来的语义占用。路侧场景在全局上具有结构、在局部上不断演化，既需要全面的场景级上下文，也需要对稀疏的局部运动进行精确建模。然而，现有的预测范式难以同时应对这两项要求。为解决这一局限，我们提出InfraWorld，一种将路侧占用预测表述为选择性状态演化的世界模型。InfraWorld为完整场景维护一个稠密的BEV状态，并为运动区域维护持续的运动查询，从而为全局上下文与局部动态分配互补的状态。具体而言，我们提出动态查询初始化（Dynamic Query Initiation, DQI），在观测历史中存在运动支撑的区域初始化查询。在推演（rollout）过程中，稠密状态通过长—短时序融合（Long--Short Temporal Fusion, LST）进行更新，该方法将短期相邻帧连续性与长期运动趋势相结合，以在捕捉场景演化的同时保持稳定的上下文。随后，运动感知查询注入（Motion-Aware Query Injection, MAQI）对查询进行细化，并将置信度加权的查询信息注入相应的BEV token中，从而实现有针对性的动态更新而不扰动全局上下文。综上，InfraWorld将预测能力集中于正在演化的交通区域。在InfraOcc与Occ3D--nus数据集上的大量实验表明，InfraWorld在路侧4D占用预测上达到了当前最优性能，同时在自车中心（ego-centric）设置下仍保持其有效性。代码将发布。

title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code, rules, lessons, data and evolve reports: https://github.com/agentic-loops-x/Reels-RSI
summary: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.

AI.title_zh: Reels-RSI：面向代码渲染解说视频的程序级自我改进
AI.abstract_zh: 解说视频——一道已解出的几何题、天空为何是蓝色、一个王朝如何覆灭——通常只是像素级视频生成的又一个目标。我们认为它们是一类不同的产物：一个由确定性渲染器转化为帧的程序（脚本、分镜和逐帧动画代码）。程序可以被阅读、做差分（diff）、测试和审计；像素只能被观看。Reels-RSI 是一个面向任意智能体框架（agent harness）的开源卷轴导演（reel director）；它的自我改进发生在程序层面，而非权重或提示词中。每一次修订轮次都会连同代码快照一起被记录；一次复盘会将每项检查发现与修复它的差异配对，并提出经验教训；一条可被静态检查捕获的教训会被编译为一条规则，并附带一个必失败示例和一个必通过示例，因此记忆是经过单元测试的；而今天学到的一条规则会作用于它之前制作的所有内容。一个受约束、以基准测试为门槛的步骤让智能体能重写导演的行动手册（playbook），只有当在留出主题上的盲式成对判断偏好它时才予以保留；没有人类决策，任何内容都不会进入记忆。在 111 条卷轴上——一项实地研究、两次行动手册演化、一次 2x2 记忆消融、一个更弱的导演、一条 48 条卷轴的学习曲线，以及一项评判者可靠性研究——我们发现：在实地中学到的规则在它存在之前创作的帧中捕获了四个潜在缺陷，而在其之后创作的内容中一个都没有；规则对强导演而言是一种审计（八条未加防护的卷轴，无违规），对较弱导演而言是一种防护（未加防护时三十次违规，对比五次）；教训会缩短修订循环，但不会产生复利效应，也不会改变评判者；并且第一次重写所得的 11--1 判定是我们投票设计中的一种位置偏差（评判者有 62--81% 的时间选择第二个展示的卷轴），掩盖了那些用十三条事实换取技巧的脚本。我们记录了偏好信号的四种失效模式、每种模式由哪项检查捕获，以及相应的修复。代码、规则、教训和数据均已公开。

title: FreeCHROMA: Generative Chroma Keying from Unaligned Background References
summary: In film production, chroma keying composites an approved foreground performance into a new environment, but conventional workflows require coordinated background plates and dedicated harmonization. Recent generative methods often require pre-aligned backgrounds, focus on background-conditioned foreground relighting, or represent the environment only through an edited first frame. These restrictions limit background selection, scene composition, and camera motion while adding preparation or editing effort. We present FreeCHROMA, which adapts a pretrained video diffusion model in a parameter-efficient manner for generative video compositing from one to three unaligned background references. The model integrates the foreground into the referenced environment, preserving foreground identity, motion, and fine visual details while generating a spatiotemporally coherent background. Foreground-background harmonization occurs within the same generation process, without a separate relighting stage. Optional text instructions help disambiguate complex spatial relationships and camera behavior. To train the model, we construct pseudo-paired data from readily available real monocular videos through foreground-background separation and augmentation with existing foundation models. The original videos serve as training targets, while automated processing and quality verification enable scalable data construction. Across reference fidelity, foreground preservation, scene integration, harmonization, and overall video quality, FreeCHROMA consistently outperforms recent compositing and conditional video-generation baselines, with particularly clear gains under camera motion. FreeCHROMA relaxes the constraints of existing tools to enable end-to-end generative chroma keying from unaligned inputs, with exploratory experiments demonstrating its potential in robotics.

AI.title_zh: FreeCHROMA：基于未对齐背景参考的生成式色键抠像
AI.abstract_zh: 在电影制作中，色键抠像（chroma keying）将已获认可的前景表演合成到新环境中，但传统工作流需要协调一致的背景板（background plates）以及专门的协调处理（harmonization）。近期的生成式方法通常需要预先对齐的背景，侧重于以背景为条件的前景重打光，或仅通过经过编辑的首帧来表示环境。这些限制削弱了背景选择、场景构图和相机运动的灵活性，同时增加了准备或编辑的工作量。我们提出 FreeCHROMA，它以参数高效的方式对预训练视频扩散模型进行适配，从而基于一到三个未对齐的背景参考实现生成式视频合成。该模型将前景整合到所参考的环境中，在保持前景身份、运动和精细视觉细节的同时，生成时空连贯的背景。前景-背景协调在同一生成过程中完成，无需单独的重打光阶段。可选的文本指令有助于消解复杂的空间关系和相机行为的歧义。为训练该模型，我们通过前景-背景分离并借助现有基础模型进行增强，从易于获取的真实单目视频中构建伪配对数据。原始视频作为训练目标，而自动化处理与质量验证使数据构建具备可扩展性。在参考保真度、前景保持、场景整合、协调以及整体视频质量方面，FreeCHROMA 持续优于近期的合成与条件视频生成基线，在相机运动下优势尤为明显。FreeCHROMA 放宽了现有工具的约束，实现了从非对齐输入进行端到端生成式色键抠像，探索性实验展示了其在机器人领域的潜力。

title: ANASSA: From High-Level Framework to Low-Level Architecture for Spatial Agentic AI
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Design Science Research (DSR) study
summary: Agentic AI systems operating over geospatial data require more than autonomous reasoning and tool use; they must also support explicit orchestration, spatial validation, governance, provenance, failure handling, and human decision authority. Prior work introduced ANASSA, an agentic AI orchestration framework for spatial intelligence that established high-level components and responsibility boundaries for governed agentic execution (arXiv:2609.14824). However, the framework did not specify how those high-level responsibilities should be systematically decomposed into an implementation-facing low-level architecture. This paper addresses that gap by applying Design Science Research (DSR) to refine the ANASSA framework from high-level architectural (HLA) responsibilities into a low-level architecture (LLA). The resulting design preserves the responsibility boundaries of the foundational framework while translating them into executable architectural structures, including 47 logical roles, versioned task graphs, capability-based agent selection, typed contracts, explicit runtime states, spatial validation mechanisms, governance controls, failure and recovery paths, and provenance records. The architecture is demonstrated through an end-to-end execution trace and analytically evaluated for requirements traceability, internal consistency, responsibility preservation, and technology independence. The resulting high-level-to-low-level design provides an implementation-facing bridge between the ANASSA framework and future system implementations, defining how governed spatial agentic workflows can be made inspectable, reconstructable, and testable without binding the architecture to a specific AI model, geospatial platform, communication protocol, or deployment environment.

AI.title_zh: ANASSA：从空间智能体 AI 的高层框架到低层架构
AI.abstract_zh: 运行于地理空间数据之上的智能体 AI 系统不仅需要自主推理与工具使用，还必须支持显式编排、空间验证、治理、溯源、故障处理以及人类决策权威。已有工作提出了 ANASSA，一个面向空间智能的智能体 AI 编排框架，该框架为受治理的智能体执行确立了高层组件与职责边界（arXiv:2609.14824）。然而，该框架并未说明这些高层职责应如何被系统地分解为面向实现的低层架构。本文通过应用设计科学研究（Design Science Research, DSR）来弥补这一空白，将 ANASSA 框架从高层架构（high-level architectural, HLA）职责精化为低层架构（low-level architecture, LLA）。由此得到的设计在保留基础框架职责边界的同时，将其转化为可执行的架构结构，包括 47 个逻辑角色、带版本的任务图、基于能力的智能体选择、带类型的契约、显式运行时状态、空间验证机制、治理控制、故障与恢复路径以及溯源记录。该架构通过一条端到端执行轨迹进行了演示，并针对需求可追溯性、内部一致性、职责保持性与技术独立性进行了分析性评估。由此得到的高层到低层设计在 ANASSA 框架与未来系统实现之间提供了一座面向实现的桥梁，界定了如何使受治理的空间智能体工作流可被检视、可被重构并可被测试，同时不将架构绑定于特定的 AI 模型、地理空间平台、通信协议或部署环境。

title: Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos
summary: World-action models inherit broad visual and physical priors from video pre-training. However, standard within-video next-frame prediction allows them to rely on appearance shared between the context and future, rather than learning interactions that transfer across scenes and embodiments. We introduce WATCH, a cross-video pre-training that learns from task-paired human demonstrations collected across diverse environments. Conditioned on the video and actions of one demonstration, the model jointly predicts another demonstration's actions and future frames from its current observation. Predicting one demonstration from another encourages the model to learn task-relevant interactions that transfer across scenes and demonstrators. Our pre-training shows that these capabilities can be learned from readily scalable human-human pairs alone, without requiring matched human-robot demonstrations. Analyses before robot post-training show improved motion alignment across embodiments and better action and video prediction on unseen robots, with representations closer to those learned from robot pairs. After robot post-training, WATCH improves MimicDroid in-context success from 40.9% to 68.3% with Cosmos Policy and from 59.8% to 77.7% with Cosmos3, with the largest gains on the unseen levels. Gains persist under context-free post-training across robot embodiments. WATCH outperforms within-video pre-training and co-training baselines, supporting cross-video prediction as a scalable approach to learning transferable world-action representations.

AI.title_zh: 从任务配对的人类视频中学习可迁移的世界-动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 世界-动作模型从视频预训练中继承了广泛的视觉与物理先验。然而，标准的视频内下一帧预测使它们能够依赖上下文与未来之间共享的外观，而不是学习可跨场景与具身迁移的交互。我们提出 WATCH，一种跨视频预训练方法，它从跨多样环境收集的任务配对人类演示中学习。以一段演示的视频与动作为条件，该模型联合预测另一段演示的动作以及从其当前观测出发的未来帧。由一段演示预测另一段演示，促使模型学习可跨场景与演示者迁移的任务相关交互。我们的预训练表明，这些能力可以仅从易于扩展的人类-人类配对中学习获得，而无需匹配的人类-机器人演示。机器人后训练之前的分析显示，跨具身的运动对齐得到改善，在未见过的机器人上动作与视频预测更好，且表征更接近于从机器人配对中学到的表征。在机器人后训练之后，WATCH 将 MimicDroid 的上下文内成功率在使用 Cosmos Policy 时从 40.9% 提升至 68.3%，在使用 Cosmos3 时从 59.8% 提升至 77.7%，且在未见过的关卡上增益最大。这些增益在跨机器人具身的无上下文后训练下依然保持。WATCH 优于视频内预训练与协同训练基线，支持将跨视频预测作为学习可迁移世界-动作表征的一种可扩展方法。

title: CoPlanVLM: Coordinated Path Planning for a Robot Team using Vision Language Models
summary: We present CoPlanVLM, which uses a Vision Language Model (VLM) to translate a single natural-language instruction and image into coordinated paths for a team of two robots. While VLMs offer a flexible, natural-language interface for commanding robot teams, their weak spatial reasoning has greatly limited VLM-based path planning. CoPlanVLM improves the VLM's spatial reasoning and path planning abilities through three components: (1) an image overlay marking both free space and obstacles, (2) task classification that selects the most appropriate low-level planner and reasoning prompt for each instruction, and (3) task-specific chain-of-thought reasoning that prompts the VLM to identify key objects, allocate roles, and verify routes are collision-free before committing to a plan. Together, these components enable the team to complete complex coordinated maneuvers requiring both robots and divide large tasks between robots to increase efficiency. CoPlanVLM also supports detailed maneuvers involving specific routes, loops, and coverage of large areas, as well as tasks requiring directional reasoning such as north/south or left/right. We validate CoPlanVLM in both Gazebo simulation and on physical Turtlebot 4 hardware. CoPlanVLM attains an average success rate of 84.4% compared to 50.0% for the closest baseline. On trials where both methods succeed, CoPlanVLM's paths are 27% shorter on average. Project code is available at https://github.com/AICPS/CoPlanVLM.

AI.title_zh: CoPlanVLM：使用视觉语言模型为机器人团队进行协同路径规划
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 CoPlanVLM，它使用视觉语言模型（VLM）将单条自然语言指令和图像转化为由两台机器人组成的团队的协同路径。虽然 VLM 为指挥机器人团队提供了灵活的自然语言接口，但其薄弱的空间推理能力极大地限制了基于 VLM 的路径规划。CoPlanVLM 通过三个组成部分提升 VLM 的空间推理与路径规划能力：（1）标记自由空间和障碍物的图像叠加层；（2）任务分类，为每条指令选择最合适的底层规划器和推理提示；（3）任务特定的思维链推理，提示 VLM 在确定规划之前识别关键物体、分配角色并验证路线无碰撞。这些组成部分共同使该团队能够完成需要两台机器人协同的复杂机动，并在机器人之间划分大型任务以提高效率。CoPlanVLM 还支持涉及特定路线、环路和大型区域覆盖的详细机动，以及需要方向性推理（如南/北或左/右）的任务。我们在 Gazebo 仿真和实体 Turtlebot 4 硬件上验证了 CoPlanVLM。CoPlanVLM 的平均成功率达到 84.4%，而最接近的基线为 50.0%。在两种方法均成功的试验中，CoPlanVLM 的路径平均短 27%。项目代码可在 https://github.com/AICPS/CoPlanVLM 获取。

title: PILOT: Guiding Long-Horizon World-Model Planning for Robot Manipulation with Visual Subgoals and Policy Priors
summary: Latent world-model planning has shown promising results in goal-conditioned robotic manipulation, but remains challenging for long-horizon planning due to limited temporal guidance and inefficient action search. A distant visual goal provides little guidance for preparatory actions, while uninformed action sampling makes local optimization inefficient. We propose PILOT (Policy-Initialized Local Optimization with Temporal subgoals), which uses a video model to generate intermediate visual subgoals and a learned policy to initialize the cross-entropy method (CEM). CEM refines candidate action sequences toward each subgoal using an action-conditioned world model in a receding-horizon control loop. In our primary real-robot evaluation across four UR5e manipulation tasks, PILOT achieves 68.8% success, compared with 55.0% without policy initialization, 13.8% for policy-only execution, and 0.0% for direct final-goal planning. Simulation results show that these gains persist over longer horizons: PILOT exceeds direct execution of the same policy by 30 percentage points on long Push-T tasks and by 22 percentage points on LIBERO-10. Policy initialization also accelerates local optimization: on Push-T, CEM matches the cost reached by generic initialization after 10 iterations in only 4 iterations and reduces the final planning cost by 24.1% under the same sampling budget. These results show that combining temporal subgoals with policy-guided action search improves both long-horizon task execution and local planning efficiency. Videos are available on the webpage: https://pilot-planner.github.io/.

AI.title_zh: PILOT：以视觉子目标与策略先验引导机器人操作的长时域世界模型规划
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型规划在目标条件机器人操作中已显示出良好结果，但在长时域规划中仍面临挑战，原因在于时间引导有限且动作搜索效率低下。一个远处的视觉目标难以为预备性动作提供指导，而无信息先验的动作采样使局部优化效率低下。我们提出 PILOT（Policy-Initialized Local Optimization with Temporal subgoals，带时间子目标的策略初始化局部优化），它使用视频模型生成中间视觉子目标，并使用学习到的策略初始化交叉熵方法（CEM）。CEM 在滚动时域控制回路中，利用动作条件世界模型将候选动作序列朝每个子目标细化。在我们主要的真实机器人评估中，涵盖四个 UR5e 操作任务，PILOT 达到 68.8% 的成功率，相比之下，无策略初始化为 55.0%，仅执行策略为 13.8%，直接最终目标规划为 0.0%。仿真结果表明，这些增益在更长的时域上仍然存在：在长 Push-T 任务上，PILOT 超过同一策略的直接执行 30 个百分点，在 LIBERO-10 上超过 22 个百分点。策略初始化还加速了局部优化：在 Push-T 上，CEM 仅用 4 次迭代即达到通用初始化在 10 次迭代后所达到的成本，并在相同采样预算下将最终规划成本降低 24.1%。这些结果表明，将时间子目标与策略引导的动作搜索相结合，可同时改善长时域任务执行与局部规划效率。视频可在网页上获取：https://pilot-planner.github.io/。

title: Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots
summary: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

AI.title_zh: 在行动中学会看见：面向机器人的预测性好奇心
AI.abstract_zh: 人类和动物并非从一组固定的数据中学习视觉：它们会移动、交互，并从自身行动的视觉后果中学习。受这一发展性观点的启发，我们研究机器人能否通过由好奇心驱动的交互主动收集经验来改进视觉学习。我们提出 DySCOVER，一个用于主动机器人视觉学习的自监督框架。机器人观察 RGB 帧，学习一个对它们进行编码与重建的视觉自编码器，并训练一个循环世界模型，以当前状态和动作为条件预测下一视觉潜在状态。智能体的策略仅使用内在奖励进行训练：重建误差鼓励视觉上新颖的观察，而世界模型的误差则鼓励那些后果尚不可预测的转移。这种预测误差使策略偏向更复杂的轨迹，从而以超出仅由视觉新颖性所鼓励的观察来丰富智能体的经验集合。我们以机械臂作为具身智能体进行的实验表明，加入预测性好奇心相比仅使用视觉好奇心能改进视觉模型。在初始条件、经验容量、具身形态和场景内容的各种变化下，加入预测性好奇心都持续改进了视觉学习。这些结果表明，预测性好奇心能够超越仅基于重建的好奇心，改进主动视觉学习。

title: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
summary: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

AI.title_zh: GeoFix：面向4D一致生成的几何修复
AI.abstract_zh: 视频扩散模型日益被用作4D生成的先验，但生成的视频往往缺乏几何一致性。近期方法通过设计几何奖励进行后训练来解决这一问题，但这可能损害纹理与细节，因而需要辅助的外观奖励并进行细致的奖励平衡。为应对这一挑战，我们提出GeoFix，一个统一框架，仅使用单一几何奖励即可提升几何一致性与视觉质量，适用于训练阶段与推理阶段的奖励对齐。我们的奖励度量静态场景区域中的跨视角深度一致性，针对结构不一致性，而不直接约束外观或惩罚有效的物体运动。关键在于，即便在真实视频和4D数据集中，深度一致性也会随相机视场重叠度增加而提高，这使得较小的相机运动可能被误判为更好的几何。我们通过针对这种依赖重叠度的趋势对奖励进行校准来考虑这一效应。GeoFix在WorldScore 3D一致性上取得39%的提升，在VBench质量分上取得4%的提升。

title: Latent World Action Model for GUI Agents
summary: Pixel-space world models have recently emerged as a promising approach for GUI agents, predicting future screens prior to execution and subsequently re-perceiving them for action selection. However, this two-stage paradigm faces two key challenges in GUI environments: (L1) the high computational cost of pixel reconstruction and (L2) the need to reconstruct large and diverse appearance-level details beyond what is required for action selection. In practice, this screen-generation objective can induce an identity shortcut problem, where future-state prediction largely preserves the current state rather than capturing action-induced changes. In this work, we reformulate GUI world modeling by shifting the prediction target from full-screen reconstruction to action-induced future information in latent space. Concretely, we leverage a large multimodal model as the latent world model, whose shared representations support two dedicated heads for both action selection and predictive transition modeling. The action head directly translates these latent representations into action selection, while the transition head captures action-conditioned future information. To mitigate the identity shortcut, we further introduce an action-aware contrastive objective that encourages the transition representations to capture discriminative action-induced changes. Extensive experiments across offline and online GUI settings show that our method achieves up to 31.9% and 40.6% relative gains in success rate over pixel-space world models, respectively, while substantially reducing inference latency by up to 98.9%. Our code is available at https://github.com/sjyu001/latent2world.

AI.title_zh: 面向 GUI 智能体的潜在世界动作模型
AI.abstract_zh: 像素空间世界模型近来作为一种有前景的 GUI 智能体方法而出现，其在执行前预测未来屏幕，随后重新感知这些屏幕以进行动作选择。然而，这种两阶段范式在 GUI 环境中面临两个关键挑战：（L1）像素重建的高计算成本，以及（L2）需要重建超出动作选择所需的大量且多样的外观层面细节。在实践中，这种屏幕生成目标可能引发身份捷径（identity shortcut）问题，即未来状态预测在很大程度上保留当前状态，而非捕捉由动作引起的变化。在这项工作中，我们通过将预测目标从全屏重建转向潜在空间中的动作诱发未来信息，重新表述了 GUI 世界建模。具体而言，我们利用一个大型多模态模型作为潜在世界模型，其共享表示支持两个专用头，分别用于动作选择和预测性转移建模。动作头直接将这些潜在表示转化为动作选择，而转移头则捕捉以动作为条件的未来信息。为缓解身份捷径，我们进一步引入了一个动作感知对比目标，鼓励转移表示捕捉具有判别性的动作诱发变化。在离线与在线 GUI 设置下进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法相较于像素空间世界模型，在成功率上分别取得了高达 31.9% 和 40.6% 的相对提升，同时将推理延迟大幅降低至多 98.9%。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/sjyu001/latent2world 获取。

title: Token-Budgeted Candidate Retrieval for 3D Scene-Grounded VLMs: Category Names vs. Pairwise Geometry
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical World AI (non-archival)
summary: Under a fixed context budget, which objects and relations should a 3D scene-grounded VLM see first? On ScanNet indoor referring benchmarks (Dai et al., 2017), matching the query to object category names outperforms pairwise geometry scoring at every reported K. The gaps are largest at high recall. Analytic pairwise cues beat per-object cue scoring and query-agnostic kNN graphs, including on paraphrases. MiniLM and BGE-small still score higher on those splits. We evaluate token-budgeted candidate retrieval with axis-aligned boxes, a token-ratio metric, training-free baselines, two small encoders that match q to each object's category name, and QCRR (Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval), a deterministic pairwise-geometry scorer. Across ScanRefer gt_val plus a custom 20% scan-id split of Nr3D and Sr3D (35,504 queries; not official ReferIt3D val), additive noun matching reaches R@10 0.864 on ScanRefer against QCRR's 0.626; MiniLM and BGE-small reach 0.911 to 0.913 on ScanRefer and 0.941 to 0.947 on Nr3D. A corrected 3DGraphLLM harness (native Acc@0.25 0.67 on the full graph, n=300 ScanRefer queries) shows that context selection changes downstream accuracy under a matched object budget (Random 0.44, QCRR 0.56, MiniLM 0.67, oracle 0.70). Semantic retrieval beats hand-designed geometry on that harness. We will release the protocol, retriever implementations, and per-query outputs so new selectors can be swapped in without rewriting the analysis.

AI.title_zh: 面向三维场景接地的VLM的Token预算候选检索：类别名称与成对几何之比较
AI.abstract_zh: 在固定的上下文预算下，一个面向三维场景接地的VLM应当优先看到哪些物体与关系？在ScanNet室内指代基准（Dai et al., 2017）上，将查询与物体类别名称进行匹配，在每一个所报告的K值上都优于成对几何评分。差距在高召回率时最大。解析式成对线索优于逐物体线索评分以及查询无关的kNN图，包括在改述（paraphrase）上也是如此。MiniLM与BGE-small在这些划分上仍然得分更高。我们评估了使用轴对齐框的Token预算候选检索、一个token比例指标、无需训练（training-free）的基线、两个将查询q与每个物体的类别名称进行匹配的小型编码器，以及QCRR（Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval，查询条件关系检索）——一个确定性的成对几何评分器。在ScanRefer gt_val加上Nr3D与Sr3D的自定义20% scan-id划分（35,504条查询；非官方ReferIt3D验证集）上，加性名词匹配在ScanRefer上达到R@10 0.864，而QCRR为0.626；MiniLM与BGE-small在ScanRefer上达到0.911至0.913，在Nr3D上达到0.941至0.947。一个经过修正的3DGraphLLM测试框架（在完整图上原生Acc@0.25为0.67，n=300条ScanRefer查询）表明，在匹配的物体预算下，上下文选择会改变下游准确率（Random 0.44，QCRR 0.56，MiniLM 0.67，oracle 0.70）。在该测试框架上，语义检索优于人工设计的几何。我们将发布该协议、检索器实现以及逐查询输出，以便新的选择器无需重写分析即可替换接入。

title: Observation-Referenced Tissue Deformation Forecasting with Tool-Driven and Residual Dynamics
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: Forecasting tissue deformation from future instrument motion could support predictive planning and increasingly autonomous surgical systems. We study this problem using a scene-specific differentiable surface model fitted to an observed tool-tissue interaction window. Rather than forecasting absolute simulated positions, we introduce an \textit{observation-referenced} formulation that anchors each tissue point to its last valid observation and adds only the deformation induced by the known, preplanned future tool trajectory. This reduces sensitivity to reconstruction, initialization, and persistent simulation offsets while preserving the predicted deformation response. The physical model uses differentiable, mesh-free position-based dynamics with scene-specific rigidity, attachment, region scale, and grasp coupling. We further introduce an optional \textit{observation-referenced residual model} combining graph-spectral spatial modes with periodic harmonic dynamics for structured motion not explained by the tool input. We evaluate the framework retrospectively on 12 surgical manipulation clips from three datasets. Observation referencing provides the largest gain, with a median within-clip error ratio of $0.598$ relative to the corresponding absolute simulation forecast. The optional periodic residual further improves forecasting when the remaining motion exhibits periodic structure. These results support observation-referenced deformation prediction as a practical building block for future surgical world models, digital twins, and generative simulators that must predict how tissue evolves under instrument actions.

AI.title_zh: 以观测为参照、由工具驱动与残差动力学预测组织形变
AI.abstract_zh: 根据未来器械运动预测组织形变，可为预测性规划以及日益自主的手术系统提供支持。我们使用拟合到观测到的工具—组织交互窗口的场景特定可微表面模型来研究这一问题。我们并非预测绝对仿真位置，而是引入一种\textit{以观测为参照}（observation-referenced）的表述，将每个组织点锚定到其最近一次有效观测，并且仅加入由已知的、预先规划的未来工具轨迹所诱导的形变。这降低了对重建、初始化以及持续存在的仿真偏移的敏感性，同时保留了所预测的形变响应。该物理模型使用可微、无网格的基于位置的动力学，并包含场景特定的刚性、附着、区域尺度以及抓取耦合。我们进一步引入一个可选的\textit{以观测为参照的残差模型}，它将图谱空间模态与周期性谐波动力学相结合，用于建模无法由工具输入解释的结构化运动。我们在来自三个数据集的12个手术操作片段上对该框架进行回顾性评估。以观测为参照带来了最大的增益，相对于相应的绝对仿真预测，其片段内误差比的中位数为$0.598$。当剩余运动呈现周期性结构时，可选的周期性残差进一步改善预测。这些结果支持将以观测为参照的形变预测作为未来手术世界模型、数字孪生以及生成式模拟器的实用构建模块，这些模型必须预测组织在器械作用下的演化方式。

title: Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function
summary: Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more. Finally, we discuss the safety implications of our visualizations and some shortcomings of current reinforcement learning agents that will prevent us from building truly advanced machine intelligence.

AI.title_zh: 可视化智能体价值函数中的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 无模型强化学习算法是否实际上可能在学习环境的一个模型？在这项工作中，我们采用反事实干预（counterfactual interventions），在保持关于某一状态的一切不变、仅做一项有针对性的改变的情况下，探索近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimization，PPO）智能体的价值函数是否形成了 Crafter 环境的世界模型。尽管仅被训练以优化奖励，我们发现价值函数学习到了诸如支配钻石何时可被收集的规则、水和食物对健康的影响、关于物品栏的启发式规则等概念。最后，我们讨论了我们所做可视化在安全方面的启示，以及当前强化学习智能体的一些缺点，这些缺点将阻碍我们构建真正先进的机器智能。

title: TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

AI.title_zh: TrajCFG：通过去噪轨迹反馈实现的逐Token无分类器引导
AI.abstract_zh: 无分类器引导（CFG）通常对所有潜在token施加一个共享的缩放系数，尽管它们的速度预测在采样过程中演化方式各不相同。我们提出轨迹自适应无分类器引导（Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance，TrajCFG），这是一种面向流匹配模型的免训练方法，利用引导速度方向的历史变化来自适应地实现逐token引导。TrajCFG将该反馈映射为有界的缩放系数，对较大的方向变化赋予更强的引导，对更一致的方向赋予更弱的引导。它结合了相邻步反馈与按区间归一化的更长跨度反馈，复用标准CFG预测，无需额外的模型评估。受控诊断实验与消融实验考察了方向反馈、逐token分配以及历史跨度融合的作用。在文本到视频、图像到视频、文本到音频视频、文本到图像以及图像到3D生成上的实验表明，该方法在多个骨干模型上相较基础采样器均有提升。在文本到视频生成中，TrajCFG在三个骨干模型上分别将VBench Total分数相较各自评估中最强基线提升了0.30-0.75分。这些结果支持将历史方向反馈作为一种具有广泛适用性的细粒度引导分配信号。项目页面见 https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/。

title: Scenes as an Attack Surface: Uncovering Scene-Grounded Safety Failures in MLLMs
summary: Existing jailbreak attacks have exposed serious safety weaknesses in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Most prior attacks rely on specially constructed visual inputs to carry or support harmful intent. In this paper, we uncover a different vulnerability: task-relevant scene semantics alone can shift an MLLM from refusal to compliance, even when the visual input introduces no additional attack instructions and the original task intent remains unchanged. We formalize this failure as a scene-grounded visual safety vulnerability and introduce SceneSafetyBench to investigate it across eight risk categories and nine white- and black-box MLLMs. Our analysis reveals that this failure is associated with how task-relevant visual evidence influences downstream safety representations, suggesting that visual grounding alone cannot fully explain the observed safety shift. Building on this finding, we propose Scene-Grounded Attacks (SGA), which preserve the original task while constructing validated scene-grounded queries and combining their independent responses. Across nine target MLLMs, SGA achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 86.17%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.55 percentage points and achieving the highest ASR on eight models. Our results identify scene semantics as an overlooked attack surface in MLLMs and highlight a growing tension between stronger visual grounding and robust multimodal safety alignment.

AI.title_zh: 场景作为攻击面：揭示多模态大语言模型中基于场景的安全失效
AI.abstract_zh: 现有的越狱攻击已暴露出多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中严重的安全弱点。此前大多数攻击依赖特制的视觉输入来承载或支持有害意图。在本文中，我们揭示了一种不同的脆弱性：仅凭与任务相关的场景语义，就能使 MLLM 从拒绝转为服从，即使视觉输入并未引入任何额外的攻击指令，且原始任务意图保持不变。我们将这一失效形式化为基于场景的视觉安全脆弱性，并提出 SceneSafetyBench，在八个风险类别以及九个白盒和黑盒 MLLM 上对其进行研究。我们的分析表明，这一失效与任务相关视觉证据影响下游安全表征的方式有关，这提示仅凭视觉 grounding 无法完全解释所观察到的安全偏移。基于这一发现，我们提出基于场景的攻击（Scene-Grounded Attacks，SGA），其在保留原始任务的同时构造经过验证的基于场景的查询，并组合其独立响应。在九个目标 MLLM 上，SGA 取得 86.17% 的平均攻击成功率（ASR），比最强的基线高出 8.55 个百分点，并在八个模型上取得最高 ASR。我们的结果将场景语义识别为 MLLM 中被忽视的攻击面，并凸显出更强的视觉 grounding 与稳健的多模态安全对齐之间日益加剧的张力。

title: Two-Stage Multi-modal Learning for Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation: From Physical Alignment to Scene Aggregation
comment: Main paper (10 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing(TASLP 2026)
summary: Embodied Audio-Visual Navigation (AVN) requires an agent to locate sound targets by jointly leveraging visual and auditory cues. While prior work has achieved notable success with static sound sources, real-world scenarios often involve moving targets, giving rise to the more challenging problem of \textbf{Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation (D-AVN)}. Existing approaches largely rely on semantic auditory features, which limits generalization to unheard sound categories and hinders fine-grained spatial reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose a novel \textbf{Two-Stage Multi-modal Learning} framework for D-AVN. In the Physical Alignment stage, the proposed \textbf{Intensity-Calibrated Geometry Encoder (ICGE)} performs physics-informed alignment of sound intensity with visual geometry to capture category-agnostic spatial correspondence. In the Scene Aggregation stage, a Transformer-based \textbf{Cross-Modal Scene Aggregator (CMSA)} dynamically integrates multi-modal features to construct a robust state representation for policy learning. Extensive experiments on Replica and Matterport3D demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art success rates, while significantly improving generalization and navigation efficiency in complex environments and under unheard sound scenarios.

AI.title_zh: 面向动态视听导航的两阶段多模态学习：从物理对齐到场景聚合
AI.abstract_zh: 具身视听导航（Embodied Audio-Visual Navigation, AVN）要求智能体通过联合利用视觉与听觉线索来定位声音目标。尽管已有工作在静态声源上取得了显著成功，但现实场景中常涉及移动目标，从而引出了更具挑战性的问题——\textbf{动态视听导航（Dynamic Audio-Visual Navigation, D-AVN）}。现有方法大多依赖语义听觉特征，这限制了对未听过声音类别的泛化能力，并阻碍了细粒度的空间推理。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种面向 D-AVN 的新型\textbf{两阶段多模态学习}框架。在物理对齐阶段，所提出的\textbf{强度校准几何编码器（Intensity-Calibrated Geometry Encoder, ICGE）}将声音强度与视觉几何进行物理信息引导的对齐，以捕捉与类别无关的空间对应关系。在场景聚合阶段，基于 Transformer 的\textbf{跨模态场景聚合器（Cross-Modal Scene Aggregator, CMSA）}动态整合多模态特征，以构建用于策略学习的鲁棒状态表示。在 Replica 和 Matterport3D 上的大量实验表明，我们的方法取得了当前最优的成功率，同时在复杂环境和未听过声音场景下显著提升了泛化能力与导航效率。

title: Refuses in Chat, Complies with Arms: LLM Refusal Does Not Survive Robot Control
summary: Frontier language models reliably refuse to explain how to cause physical harm. We ask whether this refusal survives when the same models control a robot. We introduce RoboHarm, a physical AI safety benchmark of harmful robot instructions, and test seven frontier models on it. We hold each model fixed and vary only the interface, from text to Code as Policies to vision agents that command end-effector poses or joint angles. In a MuJoCo simulation twin of a bimanual YAM arm robot, refusal falls from 73% of text requests to 18-25% once the model controls the robot, even when it is told what the objects are. On the physical robot, six models with end-effector control refused 18% of 612 trials against 19% in sim, and three with joint control refused 41% of 252 against 31%. GPT-5.6 Sol refused every text request and none of its trials on the real robot. Case studies of the robot transcripts show that models miss the hazard, name it without inferring its consequences, or act despite recognizing it, and their refusals often hinge on uncertainty about what an object is rather than on the harm of the action. Safety alignment learned in text thus fails to generalize to action, leaving current models with a poorly understood safety gap in the physical world.

AI.title_zh: 聊天中拒绝，机械臂前顺从：LLM 的拒绝在机器人控制中无法存续
AI.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型会可靠地拒绝解释如何造成身体伤害。我们追问：当同样的模型控制一台机器人时，这种拒绝是否仍然存续。我们提出 RoboHarm，一个由有害机器人指令构成的物理 AI 安全基准，并在其上测试了七个前沿模型。我们保持每个模型不变，仅改变接口，从文本到 Code as Policies，再到可命令末端执行器位姿或关节角度的视觉智能体。在一台双臂 YAM 机械臂机器人的 MuJoCo 仿真孪生体中，一旦模型控制机器人，拒绝率便从文本请求的 73% 降至 18–25%，即使告知其物体是什么时也是如此。在物理机器人上，六个使用末端执行器控制的模型在 612 次试验中拒绝了 18%，而仿真中为 19%；三个使用关节控制的模型在 252 次试验中拒绝了 41%，而仿真中为 31%。GPT-5.6 Sol 拒绝了每一次文本请求，而在真实机器人上没有拒绝任何一次试验。对机器人转录记录的案例研究显示，模型或未察觉危险，或指出危险却未推断其后果，或虽识别出危险仍采取行动，且它们的拒绝往往取决于对某物体是什么的不确定性，而非取决于该行为的伤害性。因此在文本中学到的安全对齐无法泛化到行动，使当前模型在物理世界中留下一个理解不足的安全缺口。

title: LabInstruct: Benchmarking Situated Instructional Video Generation for Lab Procedures
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) aim to automate the full experimental loop, from scientific decision-making to physical execution. Ideally, AI-generated plans could be carried out directly by robotic systems, but reliable automation remains difficult in complex, open-world laboratory environments, where experiments often involve fine-grained manipulation, long-horizon procedures, and substantial variation across tasks and setups. Humans therefore remain an important execution interface between AI-generated plans and physical experiments, creating a need for clear and effective human-facing experimental guidance. Because laboratory procedures are inherently visual, spatial, and dynamic, video is particularly well suited to communicating apparatus configurations, manipulation actions, temporal dependencies, and state changes. Recent advances in video generation now make it possible to synthesize experimental demonstrations directly from an initial workspace image and a natural-language instruction. However, whether such models can reliably communicate real laboratory procedures has not been systematically studied. We introduce LabInstruct, a benchmark for situated instructional video generation in real laboratories. LabInstruct contains 204 tasks across 5 scientific disciplines, with real reference executions and structured annotations of objects, actions, contacts, and state transitions. Evaluating 8 frontier image-to-video models, we find that visually plausible generations frequently remain procedurally incorrect, revealing a substantial gap between visual realism and the reliability required for experimental instruction.

AI.title_zh: LabInstruct：面向实验流程的场景化教学视频生成基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 自驱动实验室（SDL）旨在实现从科学决策到物理执行的完整实验闭环自动化。理想情况下，AI 生成的方案可以由机器人系统直接执行，但在复杂、开放世界的实验室环境中，可靠自动化仍然十分困难，因为实验往往涉及细粒度操作、长时程流程以及任务与装置设置之间的显著差异。因此，人类仍然是 AI 生成方案与物理实验之间的重要执行接口，这就产生了对清晰且有效的人向实验指导的需求。由于实验室流程本质上是视觉性、空间性和动态性的，视频尤为适合传达装置配置、操作动作、时序依赖关系与状态变化。视频生成领域的最新进展现已使得从初始工作区图像和自然语言指令直接合成实验演示成为可能。然而，此类模型能否可靠地传达真实实验室流程，尚未得到系统性研究。我们提出 LabInstruct，一个面向真实实验室场景化教学视频生成的基准测试。LabInstruct 包含横跨 5 个科学学科的 204 项任务，配有真实参考执行以及关于物体、动作、接触与状态转换的结构化标注。在评估 8 个前沿图像到视频模型后，我们发现视觉上看似合理的生成结果往往在流程上仍不正确，从而揭示了视觉真实感与实验指导所需的可靠性之间存在显著差距。
